jobs.title: Bioanalytics & Data Integration Project Manager
jobs.description:
Position Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Data Science Project Manager to lead complex data science and data integration initiatives supporting critical bioanalytical workflows within a regulated pharmaceutical research environment. The successful candidate will drive the development and implementation of data solutions that enhance operational effectiveness, support strategic decision-making, and enable compliant integration of scientific data across laboratory and business systems.

This role requires a strong combination of project leadership, data science acumen, stakeholder management, and knowledge of regulated environments, including FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GxP, and GDPR requirements. The individual will partner closely with scientific, informatics, and operational teams to develop scalable data frameworks, integration strategies, and analytical capabilities that support evolving business needs.

Key Responsibilities:

Project Leadership

• Lead complex data science and analytics initiatives from concept through implementation.
• Develop project frameworks, roadmaps, timelines, and governance structures to ensure successful program execution.
• Coordinate cross-functional teams, including laboratory operations, informatics, data science, and business stakeholders.
• Manage project risks, dependencies, communications, and deliverable tracking.

Data Science & Analytics

• Design and oversee development of data solutions supporting bioanalytical and scientific workflows.
• Lead the development and validation of complex SQL queries and Python-based data processing solutions.
• Support data extraction, transformation, validation, and integration activities across multiple data sources.
• Ensure data quality, traceability, and regulatory compliance throughout the data lifecycle.

Data Integration & Digital Transformation

• Develop strategies for integrating laboratory instruments and scientific systems into enterprise platforms such as LIMS.
• Support the design of data integration models and methodologies across PDMB and related organizations.
• Identify opportunities to automate workflows and improve data accessibility, consistency, and usability.
• Collaborate with technical teams to establish scalable data architectures and integration frameworks.

Business Intelligence & Strategic Planning

• Support development and evolution of departmental performance dashboards and Common Operating Picture capabilities.
• Identify key performance indicators (KPIs) and supporting metrics aligned with organizational priorities.
• Provide analytical insights that inform operational, strategic, and portfolio decision-making.
• Develop reporting frameworks that enable leadership visibility into performance and business outcomes.

Compliance & Quality

• Ensure all solutions align with FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GxP, GDPR, and corporate data governance requirements.
• Partner with Quality and Compliance teams to support validation and audit readiness activities.
• Maintain appropriate documentation, testing records, and change management controls.

Basic Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Bioinformatics, Engineering, Statistics, or related discipline.
• 5+ years of experience leading data-focused projects in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or highly regulated industry.
• Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional technical projects.
• Strong proficiency with SQL and data querying methodologies.
• Working knowledge of Python for data extraction, transformation, and analytics.
• Experience implementing data solutions in regulated environments.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Authorization to work in the United States indefinitely without restriction or sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Advanced degree (M.S., MBA, or Ph.D.) in a relevant field.
• Experience supporting bioanalytical, laboratory, or research operations.
• Knowledge of laboratory systems, including LIMS, ELN, or scientific instrumentation platforms.
• Familiarity with data visualization and reporting platforms (Power BI, Tableau, Spotfire, etc.).
• Understanding of enterprise data architecture and integration technologies.
• Experience operating within FDA-regulated environments.

This role is a full-time, permanent position Monday-Friday 1st Shift. Candidates currently located within commutable distance to West Point, PA are encouraged to apply.

Excellent full-time benefits include:

• Comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options
• Life and disability insurance
• 401(k) with company match
• Paid vacation and holidays
• Eligibility for yearly goal-based bonus & merit-based increases

jobs.title: Manager, Marketing
jobs.description:
At Morgan & Morgan, the work we do matters. For millions of Americans, we’re their last line of defense against insurance companies, large corporations or defective goods. From attorneys in all 50 states, to client support staff, creative marketing to operations teams, every member of our firm has a key role to play in the winning fight for consumer rights. Our over 6,000 employees are all united by one mission: For the People.

Summary

Morgan & Morgan is the largest plaintiff’s law firm and legal media buyer in the country. Our Brooklyn office is the marketing backbone of the company, with the freedom to solve problems your own way and have the resources of an established company behind you.

The Marketing Strategy department is hiring a Marketing Manager who reports to the Senior Director of Marketing and owns marketing performance across dedicated personal injury litigation areas, including and not limited to: maritime, medical malpractice, nursing home and workers’ compensation.

Each of these areas reaches a different person, at a different moment, with a different path from first call to signed case. When results move, the cause might be the message, the media, or what happens after the phone rings. This role works out which it is, then works with creative, paid media, web, product, operations and intake to fix it.

This position is onsite 4 days/week in Brooklyn, Friday's remote.

What you will own:

• Performance, end to end. Spend, cost per intake and conversion to signed case for your litigation areas. You own the outcome, not only the media line.

• Diagnosis before spend. When an area underperforms, find out where in the funnel it breaks before recommending more or less money, and take the fix to the team that owns that step.

• Testing. Write the hypothesis, agree how a test will be judged before it launches, and report what you learned, including when the answer is that it did not work.

• Budget and forecast. Build the annual plan for your areas with the media planning team, track pacing monthly, and back any proposed change in spend with numbers.

• Intake partnership. Share what marketing is sending intake, learn what comes back, and use it to improve both lead quality and volume.

• Creative and messaging briefs. Tell creative who each area needs to reach and what should make them call.

• Reporting to leadership. A regular readout that leads with the answer, shows the numbers, and says plainly what is still uncertain.

What success looks like

• First 90 days: you can explain the funnel for each of your four areas, with numbers, and name the biggest problem in each.

• First 6 months: a testing roadmap is running and the first results have been read out, whether positive or not.

• First year: you own the plan and forecast for your areas, and leadership uses your readouts to make spend decisions.

Qualifications:

• 4+ years in marketing or digital media management, including direct accountability for a budget and an outcome metric such as cost per acquisition or cost per lead.

• A bachelor’s degree from an accredited university.

• Hands-on analysis: you build your own reports and forecasts in Excel or Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, scenario models). SQL or a BI tool such as Power BI or Tableau is a plus.

• Experience with both brand and direct response marketing, and an understanding of how they work together.

• Judgment under uncertainty: you can make a call with incomplete data and say what would change your mind.

• A record of moving work forward through people you do not manage, with clear communication and the presence to present to senior leaders.

• Close attention to detail in numbers, briefs and plans.

Nice to have

• Marketing in a regulated industry such as legal, healthcare, insurance or financial services.

• Experience with call-driven or lead-generation funnels, where an intake or sales team sits between the ad and the outcome.

• Planning across many local markets at once.

The developer will support requirements across both EIDS and DHMSM and should be comfortable working across multiple teams, stakeholders, and priorities. The role requires someone who can understand a business need, determine the right technical approach, and independently deliver a practical and maintainable solution. The ideal candidate is an experienced Power Apps developer who also understands how reporting, automation, data, and program processes fit together in a complex enterprise environment.

Responsibilities:

Power Apps Development

• Design, develop, enhance, and maintain advanced Microsoft Power Apps solutions

• Design solutions that are scalable, maintainable, and easy for program teams to use

• Apply sound practices for application security, permissions, data access, and lifecycle management

Power Automate and Workflow Automation

• Develop Power Automate workflows to connect applications, data, and business processes

Power BI Development and Reporting

• Create clear visualizations that translate program data into useful information for leadership and delivery teams

• Support reporting requirements that complement Power Apps and broader Power Platform solutions

Azure DevOps Integration

• Use Microsoft Azure DevOps as a data source and integration point for Power Platform solutions

• Develop applications and reporting that support portfolio management, delivery tracking, backlog management, and performance measurement

• Apply a strong technical understanding of Azure DevOps data structures, work items, and reporting capabilities

• Help connect Azure DevOps information with Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI where appropriate

Cross-Program Support

• Support Power Platform needs across both EIDS and DHMSM

• Work with stakeholders across multiple teams to understand, prioritize, and deliver requirements

• Balance competing priorities and adjust work as program needs change

• Build solutions that can be used across teams when common requirements or opportunities exist

SAFe and Portfolio Context

• Design applications and reporting aligned with SAFe concepts, particularly portfolio management and execution tracking

• Support leadership visibility into priorities, capacity, schedules, dependencies, and delivery

• Apply SAFe and portfolio context when designing solutions so that applications and reporting are relevant to actual program operations

Collaboration and Enablement

• Work closely with program teams, analysts, product owners, and leadership to gather and refine requirements

• Translate business needs into clear technical solutions without requiring stakeholders to define the technical approach

• Demonstrate solutions, incorporate feedback, and refine applications as requirements evolve

• Provide documentation and guidance to support adoption and long-term maintenance

• Help teams transition to new applications, reporting, and automated workflows

Requirements:

• U.S. citizenship and ability to obtain and maintain a Common Access Card (CAC) and required access to DHA systems and environments.

• Strong demonstrated experience designing and developing Microsoft Power Apps, including complex applications used by business or program teams

• Experience integrating Power Apps with Power Automate, Microsoft 365, Power BI, Azure DevOps, and other data sources

• Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and improve Power Apps performance, usability, and maintainability

• Experience building Power BI dashboards using multiple data sources

• Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders

Desired Skills:

Established in 1999, T-Rex Solutions, LLC is a proven mid-tier business providing data-centric mission services to the Federal government as it increasingly tries to secure and leverage the power of data. At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Enterprise Account Executive – Financial Services

Why We Have This Role

Our Enterprise Account Executive team is a group of highly driven individuals dedicated to closing experience gaps across the world’s leading financial institutions. In the modern Financial Services sector—spanning retail banking, wealth management, commercial banking, insurance, and fintech—digital transformation, client retention, regulatory compliance, omnichannel service, and advisor/employee experience are top priorities. Our SaaS platform empowers global financial institutions to capture real-time customer feedback, elevate digital and branch interactions, and drive action with pre-built Experience Management (XM) programs.

How You’ll Find Success

• Proven Deal Closer: Strong track record of consistently exceeding quota and acquiring high-value enterprise financial accounts.

• Internal mobility opportunities (Qmobility) across global teams and territories.

• Partner cross-functionally with internal teams (Professional Services, Solutions Engineering, SME Leads, and Customer Success) to orchestrate collaborative, high-impact enterprise sales cycles.

• A validated top performer with a proven track record of breakthrough sales results.

• 5–10+ years of direct enterprise SaaS sales experience, preferably targeting Banking, Financial Services, Insurance (BFSI), or Fintech sectors.

• Bachelor’s degree or higher required.

• Demonstrated mastery of the MEDDPICC / MEDDIC sales process.

• Strong proficiency in Salesforce.com and sales forecasting hygiene.

• Experience developing complex business cases and ROI models focused on account retention, digital adoption, risk mitigation, and client lifetime value.

• Proven track record of navigating long, complex contract negotiations with highly regulated financial enterprises.

• Ability to travel up to 50% as needed for key client meetings, executive briefings, and industry summits.

These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. • You have a proven track record and success in converting qualified leads through cold outbound

• You are agile, you learn quickly and you embrace challenges

• You thrive in in-person hands-on training

What’s in it for you?

• PTO: 20 paid time off days, 5 sick days and 2 floating holidays + 12 national holidays

• 401 K eligibility + matching

• Talent Acquisition Manager will contact you for a first chat

• You will then meet with Jake, our BDR Manager

• You will complete a case study and present to Jake, BDR Manager and Nico, Head of Sales - US.

• You will meet our CRO

• The final step will be a one-on-one meeting with our Co-Founder & CEO

• Welcome to DataDome!

Compensation: Base salary of $60,000–$65,000 per year, OTE $30,000 plus uncapped commission. Total earnings potential is based on performance.

DataDome stops cyberfraud and bots in real time, outpacing AI-driven fraud from simple to sophisticated across your sites, apps, and APIs. Named a Leader in the Forrester Wave for Bot Management, the DataDome platform is built on a multi-layered AI engine that focuses on intent, not just identity. Because it’s not about knowing who’s real, it’s about what they intend to do. With thousands of AI models that adapt to every fraudulent click, signup, and login, DataDome blocks fraud in less than 2 milliseconds, without compromising performance. DataDome is fully automated and integrates seamlessly into any tech stack. Backed by a 24/7 SOC team of advanced threat researchers, DataDome stops over 400 billion attacks annually. Experience protection that outperforms with DataDome.

jobs.description:
Walden Security is recruiting highly professional, prior law enforcement officers for the Court Security Officer (CSO) position.  Applicants must have 3 years of verifiable experience with a recognized law enforcement agency. CSOs will provide armed security in Washington, DC.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Includes the following and other duties may be assigned:

Perform entrance control: Enforce the District’s entry and identification system which includes operating security screening equipment to detect weapons, contraband, and prohibited items, checking items such as handbags, briefcases, computers, packages, baby carriages, wheelchairs, etc.

Perform roving patrol: Patrol facilities and grounds of the facility in accordance with applicable post orders.

Perform stationary post assignments: Stand guard at stationary posts which include (but are not limited to) monitoring closed-circuit television, duress alarm systems and other security equipment.

Perform escort duties: When directed, provide armed escort services for officials, personnel, and other designated individuals.

Perform garage parking and pedestrian control: Where applicable, direct traffic and control lights on properties, as described in the post orders and/or standard operating procedures.

Enforce law and order: Enforce federal law while in the performance of assigned duties. This includes (but is not limited to) detaining any person attempting to gain unauthorized access to Government property, or a court proceeding(s), or attempting to commit acts that imperil the safety and security of Government employees, property, and the public.

Prepare reports and records: Prepare various reports and records regarding contract performance issues, such as labor hours worked, accidents, fire, bomb threats, unusual incidents, or unlawful acts that occurred within the court facility area.

Requirements

Education and/or Experience: High school diploma or general education degree (GED). At least three (3) calendar years of verifiable experience as a certified law enforcement officer or its military equivalency (Master-at-Arms, CGPD, Security Forces Specialist, etc.); all three (3) years must have occurred within the last seven (7) years. The experience must have included general arrest authority.

Language Skills: Must have the ability to read, write, speak, and understand English. Must possess the ability to understand, explain, interpret, and apply rules, regulations, directives, and procedures.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations: Must have a valid driver's license from state of residency and a safe driving record for the past five years; must receive clearance from the Department of Justice. Must have completed or graduated from certified Federal, state, county, local or military law enforcement training academy and able to provide certification as proof.

Other Qualifications: Must be at least 21 years of age; Ability to pass a pre-employment drug screen and criminal background check.

jobs.title: Security Lead
jobs.description:
Pay: $60-65k annually

About Carvana

If you like disrupting the norm and are looking to join a company revolutionizing an industry then you will LOVE what Carvana has done for the car buying experience. Buying a car the old fashioned way sucks and we are working hard to make it NOT suck. I mean, have you seen our vending machine?!

We are looking for people who are excited to thrive in an environment of impactful change. Team spirit is evident at Carvana and everyday we let our passions and creativity foster innovation. We take big swings, set ambitious goals, and challenge each other to make data- and process-driven decisions in everything we do. Here are a few of our stories! We’ve been changing the game since 2013, and we’re not taking our foot off the gas now. Want more of the story? Check out our background here.

About the team and position

As a Functional Lead, you will be an integral part of the Safe and Secure Team executing programs and processes at our Headquarter facilities to ensure our team members and assets are protected. At our front desks, our Safe & Secure Associates are the face of Carvana to our employees, vendors, and visitors. As a Functional Lead, you’ll be the direct supervisor of these Associates which includes supervising their day-to-day activities as a team, providing training and coaching on proper protocols/procedures, and continuously upholding a high level of performance.

You will be a leader in Safe & Secure and act as a representative of Carvana to both internal and external partners in routine meetings and day-to-day activities.  The ideal candidate for this role is passionate about developing and maintaining effective security and safety policies. This role requires the ability to articulate and demonstrate desired behavior, provide timely, effective, and actionable feedback, and to motivate others to balance urgency and quality.

What you’ll be doing

• Oversee day-to-day activities of assigned team; identify team’s strengths and weaknesses; determine areas of opportunity and the appropriate steps to improve.

• Identify and evaluate trends, evaluate outcomes, and develop plans to accomplish team tasks and objectives.

• Engage assigned team, provide appropriate coaching, development and performance management; offer feedback and demonstrate desired skills.

• Create a work and team environment that inspires positive communication, team cohesion, and adherence to Carvana’s Values.

• Proactively communicate information to team members, providing clear understanding of expectations, performance measures, and goals.

• Prevent and resolve conflict among team members.

• Monitor and ensure adherence to systems, policies, procedures, and performance standards.

• Maintain staff by recruiting, selecting, orienting, and training employees.

• Positively reinforce and monitor progress toward team goals.

• Timely and effectively communicate information to other relevant teams and stakeholders.

• Support leadership and participate in implementation and execution of team/department initiatives, and strategies.

• Escalate significant high risk issues to senior-level management as necessary and provide recommendations to ensure our teams are safe and our business operations are maintained.

• Ensure the safety of our associates by monitoring and developing solutions that meet all local, state and federal requirements.

• Implement, execute, and directly lead our Incident Management program at our HQ locations.

• Plan and Lead the Incident Management Program for the site, focusing on sustainable awareness and effective preparedness. Key facilitator in an emergency situation for the site.

• Directly lead the processes related to our Safe & Secure Technology that supports our HQ locations Ensure equipment is properly functioning, that issues are addressed, and that our processes relating to badge access, server room controls, monitoring alerts, and overall health of the program are running like a well oiled machine.

• Ensure the team properly records all incidents, ensures system information is accurate and actionable. Complete after action reviews to determine root causes of reported safety incidents and make improvement recommendations to the Manager, Corporate Security.

• Implement and monitor visitor and vendor check-in processes, providing regular team member training and coaching.

• Implement and conduct risk assessments of our HQ facilities.

• Work with the Safe and Secure Operations Center leadership to provide support when business needs require.

• Assign work and hold team members accountable to expectations and deliverables.

• Ensure the team always has appropriate staffing that meet relevant KPIs and goals.

• Be available and onsite during business hours that could occasionally exceed 40 hours in a week.

• Occasionally be available outside of traditional business hours, as needed.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

What you should know/have

• High School Diploma or equivalent.

• 3+ years experience in physical security operations and/or loss prevention.

• 1+ years experience directly supervising/managing a team.

• Demonstrated ability to coach team members to deliver a consistent, top-notch customer service experience.

• Experience working closely and communicating effectively with a diverse set of stakeholders in an ever-changing, rapid growth environment with tight deadlines.

• Demonstrated ability to take initiative in a constantly-changing work environment while maintaining flexibility and a collaborative attitude.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Able to help create, develop and implement process improvement(s).

• Crisis Management Leadership experience.

• Valid driver’s license and insurable DMV required.

We’d love it if you also have

• A Bachelor’s degree (or higher) from an accredited college or university, ideally in business, criminal justice, crisis management, security operations.

• Experience with project management software.

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets.

What we’ll offer in return

• Full-Time Salaried position.

• Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.

• 401K with company match.

• A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more..

• A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy both physically and mentally.

• Access to opportunities to expand your skill set and share your knowledge with others across the organization.

• A company culture focused on high performance and bar-raising, with vast opportunity to learn and grow.

jobs.title: Head of Legal Engineering
jobs.description:
Why Blee:

Blee is an AI-first marketing content compliance platform. PayPal, NerdWallet, and Brex already trust us. We're YC-backed, founded by an ex-Adobe marketing ops leader and former lawyer, and we're defining a category that didn't exist two years ago—across Fintech, Financial Services, CPG, Travel, and Life Sciences..






With offices in San Francisco and New York, we value in-person work but offer remote-opportunities for the right people. No matter where you join us, you can expect quarterly off-sites and opportunities to join other offices when you feel it’s important. You’ll be joining a team that values clarity, ownership, and shared responsibility—and is focused on building something that genuinely improves how teams work.



The Role

This is the Head of Legal Engineering role for an attorney who wants to shape how legal judgment works inside an AI product. Legal Engineering sits at the center of Blee's platform: it decides how legal requirements and customer guidance become rules our AI can apply reliably, and it judges whether those rules perform well in practice. You will own this function and take it to the next level. That means making our methods sharper, our quality loop more rigorous, and our legal frameworks able to scale across a fast-growing base of enterprise customers.



What You’ll Do

 - Lead Legal Engineering. Set the function's direction, priorities, and standards, and grow the team as Blee scales.

 - Own Blee's legal logic. Shape how legal and regulatory requirements become reliable, scalable AI review across our customer base.

 - Build Blee's voice in the market. Represent Blee externally through speaking, writing, events, and other thought leadership on AI, legal, and compliance.

 - Work directly with customers’ legal and compliance teams. Join customer calls to understand their specific content analysis requirements and translate them into how Blee’s AI evaluates content.

 - Enable Implementation and Customer Success. Give our customer-facing teams the legal and compliance context they need to implement Blee effectively, support customers, and know when to escalate questions.

 - Drive AI quality. Measure and continuously improve the accuracy and reliability of Blee's AI review.

 - Keep our legal logic current. Make sure Blee keeps pace with changing regulations, customer guidance, and best practices.

 - Represent legal and compliance in product development. Partner with Product to make sure Blee reflects how legal and compliance teams actually work.

 - Raise the bar. Set the standards and best practices that keep Blee's legal work consistent, high quality, and scalable.

 - Support Blee's legal function. Work alongside Blee's in-house legal team on company legal matters, including reviewing and negotiating commercial agreements.



Who You Are

 - A lawyer with sharp judgment. You can read unclear guidance, see where it conflicts, and decide how it should apply.

 - Fluent in AI. You use AI tools every day, understand what they can and can't do, and get excited about making them work better rather than being skeptical of them.

 - Clear and credible with legal and compliance leaders. You're comfortable presenting to GCs, CCOs, and senior marketing stakeholders.

 - A systems thinker. You look past the individual question to the framework behind it, and you design approaches that hold up across many customers, regulations, and use cases.

 - Data-driven about quality. You look for patterns instead of chasing individual flags, and you measure whether your changes actually helped.

 - A leader who raises the standard. You're excited to take a high-impact function and make it stronger as Blee grows.
   



Who You'll Work With

You will work closely with Blee's product, implementation, customer success, AI engineering, and legal teams. You'll also work regularly with the legal, compliance, and marketing teams at some of the world's largest organizations. 




Requirements

 - JD and active bar admission in at least one U.S. jurisdiction

 - 5+ years of legal experience, including significant work in advertising and marketing law, consumer protection, or regulatory compliance, at a law firm, in-house, or at a regulator

 - Hands-on experience reviewing marketing and advertising materials for claims, disclosures, and substantiation

 - Working knowledge of relevant frameworks, such as FTC advertising and endorsement guidance, UDAP/UDAAP, and financial-services marketing rules (e.g., FINRA 2210, the SEC Marketing Rule, Reg Z/DD)

 - Real experience using AI in your legal work, and readiness to walk through specific tools, workflows, and results during interviews

 - A strong analytical and writing record: you can explain complex legal reasoning in structured, plain language

 - Experience leading people or cross-functional initiatives



Nice to have:

 - Experience in legal technology, legal operations, or at a venture-backed company

 - Experience writing product requirements, designing test cases, or evaluating AI or model output

 - Familiarity with regulated industries such as financial services, fintech, insurance, or healthcare

We have offices in New York and San Francisco and value in-person collaboration, but we're open to remote for the right person. Wherever you're based, expect bi-annual off-sites and the chance to spend time in our other offices when it matters.



What You’ll Get:

jobs.description:
At RES, we’re looking for purpose-driven individuals who are passionate about restoration and sustainability, and who want their work to make a lasting environmental impact. Our team members go above and beyond, bringing initiative, integrity, and a strong work ethic to every project. Collaboration is key—we thrive on teamwork, open communication, and diverse perspectives. In a field that constantly changes, we value those who are resilient, adaptable, and resourceful in the face of challenges. If you're intellectually curious, eager to learn, and ready to help restore ecosystems and protect natural resources, you’ll find your place here.

RES is looking for a Client Solutions Associate to join our team.

As a Client Solutions Associate at RES, you’ll help drive growth and impact by supporting client outreach, internal coordination, and market research. This is an early-career role ideal for someone eager to learn the business of ecological restoration while developing communication, sales, and strategic skills. You’ll work closely with senior members of the Client Solutions team and collaborate across departments—including land, design, regulatory, and construction—to help shape successful, long-term partnerships. [INSERT TRAVEL ARRANGEMENTS AND MAIN PROJECTS]

Why You’ll Love This Job

• You’ll grow your career in purpose-driven work. From the start, you’ll contribute to projects that restore land and water and help solve some of today’s most complex environmental challenges.

• You’ll build connections across teams and industries. You’ll engage with experts in ecology, engineering, policy, and construction—while learning how RES supports clients in achieving regulatory and environmental goals.

• You’ll gain skills that last. Whether it’s understanding contract structures, creating presentation materials, or reading market signals, you’ll develop a foundation in business development, strategy, and client engagement.

• You’ll be part of a high-performing, supportive team. We’ll help you succeed through mentorship, structured learning, and real-world experience in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

A Day in the Life

You’ll start your morning reviewing market activity and updating a list of prospective leads in coordination with your regional Client Solutions Manager. Later, you might attend a virtual internal call to learn more about an upcoming stream restoration project, then help prepare a short presentation or proposal for a potential client.

Throughout the week, you’ll work on tracking leads, organizing data in Excel, preparing outreach materials in PowerPoint, or researching key regulatory drivers and trends. You’ll support internal meetings across functions and begin developing a deeper understanding of RES’s services, the restoration business model, and how deals are structured—from concept to contract.

We would love to talk to you if you have many of the following:

• Bachelor’s degree (BS/BA) in environmental science, business, communications, marketing, or a related field

jobs.title: Manufacturing Associate I (Contract)
jobs.description:
At Alamar, we are passionate about enabling our customers to make scientific discoveries that translate into clinical outcomes and benefit patients. Our team is growing quickly as we develop innovative approaches to measure critical protein biomarkers from liquid samples that can enable the earliest possible detection of disease. We believe the next frontier in biology is enabled by measuring proteins at higher sensitivity in highly multiplexed assays at the push of a button, which is something only Alamar can do. As we build our team, we seek collaborative, driven, intellectually curious people committed to solving complex challenges. Our culture rewards accountability and cross functional teamwork because we believe this enables the kind of breakthrough thinking that will accelerate our mission.

We are seeking a disciplined, detail-oriented, and highly motivated Manufacturing Associate I for a temporary assignment supporting the formulation and manufacture of biological and chemical reagents. The role will also handle temperature-sensitive, high-concentration antigens where strict contamination control, aseptic technique, accurate pipetting, and careful temperature management are critical to maintaining material integrity and preventing cross-contamination. Experience in reagent formulations under Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) and Good Documentation Practice (GDP) in a regulated industry is highly preferred.

Responsibilities:

• Formulate biological and chemical reagents in accordance with manufacturing batch records (MPRs), standard operating procedures, and other applicable Quality System policies.

• Perform antigen reconstitution, dilution, mixing, aliquoting, and storage activities using approved procedures and designated equipment.

• Maintain temperature-sensitive materials under specified storage and handling conditions throughout manufacturing activities.

• Assist with other high-priority manufacturing activities, including special builds, filling, labeling, and packaging, as assigned.

• Complete MPRs and associated manufacturing records accurately and in accordance with Good Documentation Practices (GDP).

• Track and maintain inventory of consumables and raw materials required for manufacturing.

• Participate in general laboratory maintenance such as basic equipment calibration and maintenance, general cleaning of facility, cleaning of labware, and routine laboratory housekeeping.

• Support troubleshooting to investigate and resolve manufacturing issues.

• Support routine inventory cycle count.

• Maintain a safe working environment and comply with all applicable laboratory safety practices.

Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Biological Science, Biochemistry, Chemistry, Bioengineering, or a related field with one to two years of experience in reagent manufacturing.

• Demonstrated proficiency with micropipettes and routine molecular biology laboratory techniques.

• Demonstrated ability to follow detailed SOPs, MPRs, and work instructions and maintain complete and accurate records.

• Understanding of aseptic technique and prevention of cross-contamination. Direct experience handling proteins, antibodies, antigens, or other temperature-sensitive biological materials is strongly preferred.

• Ability to perform calculations and accurately execute small-volume liquid handling, dilutions, aliquoting, and material reconciliation.

• Strong attention to detail, organization, and problem-solving skills, with the judgment to stop work and escalate unexpected conditions.

• Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills.

• Experience in an ISO 13485, GMP, or other regulated environment is preferred.

jobs.title: Commercial Contracts Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT NOOKS

Nooks is pioneering Classified-Infrastructure-as-a-Service (CIaaS) — designing, building, and operating Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities (SCIFs) and other secured, classified environments for the defense and national security community. We work with the agencies, contractors, and mission-driven organizations that keep the nation safe, delivering the physical infrastructure that makes classified work possible. We’re growing fast, operating across multiple markets, and building a company that takes both the mission and the business seriously.

About the Role

You own the contract cycle for Nooks’ commercial contracts: reviewing, redlining, and negotiating agreements with third parties from first draft through signature, including amendment and revisions as needed. Nooks needs these agreements to reach signature faster, without conceding terms under deadline pressure. You deliver both by drafting the contracts playbook with outside counsel and working every deal against it. You report to the VP of Growth, take legal direction from outside counsel, and work as a full-time individual contributor.

At Nooks, we move fast. While you’ll have clear ownership over your core responsibilities, startup life means priorities can shift. We’re looking for a proactive problem-solver who is comfortable with ambiguity and ready to lean in wherever the team needs them most to drive us forward.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Negotiation

• Review, redline, and negotiate commercial customer agreements, including service agreements, Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs), and teaming agreements, against approved playbook positions.

• Decide non-material terms within guidelines and escalate material terms, such as price and duration, to the VP of Growth with a recommendation.

• Draft and negotiate amendments, extensions, and renewals of executed commercial agreements, keeping each change consistent with current playbook positions.

Playbook and Enablement

• Draft the commercial contract playbook, setting standard, fallback, and walk-away positions for approval by the VP of Growth and outside counsel.

• Maintain commercial templates and the playbook, proposing updated positions when negotiation patterns or counsel guidance show a standard no longer holds.

• Train the Growth team on playbook positions so routine terms get resolved in the sales conversation rather than in your review queue.

Deal Support and Reporting

• Prepare contract content for proposals, including terms, exceptions, and representations and certifications, and contribute broader proposal content when a pursuit requires it.

• Maintain a complete record of every commercial agreement you handle through a contracts lifecycle management tool, including executed versions, approvals, key dates, and renewal triggers.

• Track and report contract cycle time and playbook deviations to the VP of Growth, identifying which terms or steps slow deals.

• Review all commercial customer, vendor, and supplier agreements for the company.

The Skillset

• Five or more years reviewing, redlining, and negotiating commercial agreements with substantial independence.

• Working command of core commercial terms: liability limits, indemnification, insurance, termination, service levels, and payment.

• Track record negotiating directly with customer legal and procurement teams, holding positions while keeping deals moving.

• Ability to understand the business requirements and translate that into terms in the agreement

• Experience drafting or maintaining contract templates or playbooks with defined standard and fallback positions.

• Plain-language writing that explains contract risk to non-lawyers and frames clear escalation recommendations.

• Comfort working independently, while soliciting direction from Legal, Growth, and Government delivery functions across the business.

• J.D. or Paralegal certification, highly preferred.

• Experience contracting with defense contractors or other cleared-industry customers.

• Experience managing a Contracts process using a Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) system or structured contract repository, a plus.

Compensation & Benefits

Yearly bonus structure and equity ownership, premium health coverage, 401(k) employer contribution, flexible time away.

Eligibility & Clearance

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. An active security clearance is preferred but not required.

Location-Specific Addendums

You work independently your agreements cover  across every location and lifecycle phase. No commercial contract playbook exists today, so you build the standard first and then hold every deal to it. Expect occasional travel for company events and select customer negotiations.

What Success Looks Like in This Role

An approved commercial contract playbook governs every customer negotiation, and the Growth team resolves routine terms without routing them to you. Commercial agreements reach signature on a predictable cycle time that you track and report, and deals no longer stall in contract review. Deviations from approved positions are rare, documented, and escalated before signature rather than discovered after. Every executed commercial agreement, amendment, and renewal sits in a complete record with key dates tracked. Leadership relies on you to tell them, before a deal closes, exactly which terms Nooks is accepting and why.

Cross-Functional Expectations

You partner daily with the Growth team and negotiate directly with customer legal and procurement teams. You execute on outside counsel’s legal direction and bring material terms to the VP of Growth for decision. Pricing, government contracts, regulatory flow-down clauses, and security classification requirements sit with other owners; you route them rather than resolve them.

Salary Range for all departments

Salary Range

$123,000—$136,000 USD

The firm's complementary core offerings—market making, client execution services, and trading venues give Virtu a competitive advantage in developing and applying innovative tools that deliver efficiencies and performance across the organization.

THE ROLE

Virtu's Risk Management team is a globally connected and fast-paced group, responsible for the framework that routes retail equity orders to market. Sitting at the intersection of trading and engineering, the team plays a central role in how Virtu manages risk in real time, across markets and around the clock.

As markets move toward 23/5 trading, overnight coverage has become a core part of how this framework operates globally. In this role, you'll support live systems during Asia hours, acting as the first line of defense while our US teams are offline, thinking like a trader when markets move, and like an engineer when the system needs to evolve. It's a hands-on, coding-intensive role with real ownership over production systems, that blends disciplined risk management with the deeper work of building and improving the systems behind it.

• Monitor automated trading and risk infrastructure, identifying and resolving issues in real time and escalating issues when needed

• Develop new strategy features and deploy code changes through the team's standard review process

• Design, run, and report on retail routing experiments

• Shape the team's priorities based on what you see overnight, and help support the shift to 23/5 trading

• Partner with traders and developers across regions to strengthen system resilience as overnight coverage expands

• Develop a deep, hands-on understanding of risk systems, order flow, and market structure

THE CANDIDATE

• 3+ years of experience at a financial institution

• Bachelor’s Degree in a quantitative field preferred

• Strong experience with Python

• Experience working with large datasets in SQL

• Knowledge of US equity market structure (venues, smart order routing, order types, trade reporting) a plus

• Experience with Java or C++ a plus

• Statistical analysis experience a plus

• Calm under pressure in fast-moving, time-sensitive environments

• Strong attention to detail and a track record of accurate, high-quality work

• Excellent problem-solving and communication skills

• Team player with flexibility in time commitment

Salary Range: $175,000 - $225,000 (salary range is exclusive of bonuses, benefits or other categories of compensation)

THE PROCESS

After passing an application screening, candidates will be sent an online programming test via email from a service called HackerRank as a first step of the process.

jobs.title: Senior Corporate Accountant
jobs.description:
We are seeking a hands-on Corporate Accountant or Senior Corporate Accountant to support our growing business and take ownership of core accounting and financial operations.

This role is ideal for someone with strong accrual accounting experience who is comfortable managing day-to-day bookkeeping, financial reporting, month-end close, and accounting operations in a fast-paced environment.

You will play a key role in maintaining accurate financial records, supporting internal controls, and ensuring smooth accounting operations across our business and subsidiaries. You will also support accounting transitions and integration efforts related to mergers and acquisitions.

We are open to candidates at both the Accountant and Senior Accountant levels, depending on experience and ability to independently manage accounting responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage day-to-day accounting operations, including accrual-based bookkeeping, journal entries, account reconciliations, and general ledger maintenance.
• Own and support the month-end and quarter-end close processes, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting.
• Prepare and post journal entries for intercompany and subsidiary transactions.
• Perform monthly bank reconciliations and maintain accurate financial records across multiple entities.
• Manage accounting activities related to commissions, expenses, accruals, and other operational transactions.
• Prepare, analyze, and reconcile financial statements, including profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements.
• Maintain compliance with U.S. GAAP and support the development of effective internal accounting controls.
• Support accounting integration and financial transitions related to mergers and acquisitions.
• Identify opportunities to streamline month-end close processes, improve efficiency, and strengthen financial reporting.
• Partner with internal leadership, including finance and credit risk teams, to support operational and financial needs.
• Assist with pro forma financial analysis, financial planning, and other ad hoc accounting projects as needed.
• Take ownership of accounting processes and ensure continuity during business transitions.

• 2+ years of relevant accounting experience; candidates with more extensive experience will be considered for the Senior Accountant level.
• Strong hands-on experience with accrual-based accounting and bookkeeping is required.
• Solid understanding of U.S. GAAP, general ledger accounting, and financial statement preparation.
• Experience with month-end close, journal entries, bank reconciliations, and account reconciliations.
• Ability to understand and interpret P&L statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements.
• Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.
• Experience with accounting software such as QuickBooks, NetSuite, Xero, or similar platforms.
• Experience managing accounting operations independently or taking ownership of multiple accounting functions.
• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working with multiple entities or subsidiaries.
• Background in small or medium-sized businesses, startups, or public accounting.
• Experience supporting M&A transactions, accounting integrations, or business transitions.
• Experience with commission accounting, internal controls, and accounting process improvements.
• Demonstrated ability to improve or accelerate month-end close processes.

Our Core Values

At the heart of everything we do are two values that guide how we work and grow together:

Candor – We believe in open, honest, and respectful communication. Candor helps us solve problems faster, build stronger relationships, and keep our focus on what truly matters. We encourage every team member to speak up, share ideas, and challenge assumptions.

Impact – We measure success not by effort alone, but by the results we create. Whether it’s streamlining accounting processes, producing accurate financial insights, or enabling better decisions, we prioritize work that drives meaningful outcomes for our company, our customers, and our team.

jobs.title: Senior People Business Partner
jobs.description:
ABOUT TRIBE AI

At Tribe, we're on a mission to help enterprises realize the value of AI for their business. Every large enterprise wants to use AI to transform how they operate — but many don't have the capabilities to do it. That gap is our opportunity.

We're an AI-native services company that helps enterprises build and deploy best-in-class AI products that deliver real business impact. We partner closely with OpenAI and Anthropic, giving us rare visibility into the most advanced models, roadmaps, and GTM strategies in the world.

We're hiring a Senior People Business Partner to help build that: coaching managers, building the enablement that makes good management repeatable, supporting managers and employees through the moments that matter, and helping shape the culture of a distributed, services-based company, all in service of a business that is well supported through its people.

You'll be a senior collaborator across our people partner function, owning employee relations for the managers and teams you support. You'll also build the programs and policy behind it: spotting patterns, building proactively to address them, and driving adoption so new programs take hold. You're a strategic, relationship-minded partner who sees a need, raises it, and brings a solution, and you're comfortable getting into the details.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING


MANAGER PARTNERSHIP & ENABLEMENT

 - Partner with a defined set of managers and leaders on team health, performance, and growth

 - Run regular manager check-ins and coach managers on leading their teams well

 - Build and run manager enablement: the toolkit, training, and resources that make good management repeatable


PERFORMANCE & TALENT

 - Partner with the People Operations Lead on our AI-native, evidence-based performance process, from design through manager support and calibration

 - Support leveling and promotion practices as the company grows

 - Support managers in setting clear expectations and developing their teams


ONBOARDING PARTNERSHIP

 - Partner with managers and new hires through the first 30, 60, and 90 days: setting expectations, checking in, and making sure both sides are set up to succeed


EMPLOYEE RELATIONS

 - Own employee relations for the managers and teams you support, with care and consistency

 - Handle sensitive moments and conversations with long-term judgment


CULTURE, LEARNING & LISTENING

 - Help build culture in a distributed, services-based company: remote work principles, connection, and the rituals that make us feel like one team

 - Build our learning and development approach, working with external partners for skills training

 - Run the listening mechanisms that tell us how managers and employees are doing, and turn what you hear into action


PROGRAM, POLICY & CHANGE

 - Build and run people programs and policy, from design through rollout

 - Identify patterns and themes across managers and teams, and proactively action-plan to address them

 - Lead change management that drives adoption, so new programs and policy take hold

 - Tie people programs to business outcomes and show their impact


ORG & TALENT

 - Advise on team structure, role design, and workforce planning alongside the People Operations Lead and Finance

 - Partner with Talent on leveling and onboarding of senior hires, and with account and staffing leads on growth paths


ABOUT YOU

 - 7+ years in HR business partnering at a high-growth company

 - Depth of experience in performance management, organizational development, and manager enablement

 - Depth in employee relations, with the judgment to know when to bring in the right expertise

 - Evidence-based: you use data and specifics to make people decisions and defend them

 - A builder with a record of designing programs that stick, who names it when one doesn't and iterates thoughtfully and quickly

 - Change management experience that drives adoption, not just launch

 - Business acumen: you understand how the business works and tie people work to outcomes

 - You see a need, raise it, and bring a solution

 - You value close partnership and collaboration

 - Fluent with AI tools in your own work, with a point of view on how they change people programs

 - Experience supporting distributed teams across countries, with working knowledge of employment law in the places you've supported


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience building manager training or a learning and development program from scratch

 - Exposure to compensation and rewards, such as leveling, bands, and comp cycles

 - Experience with Rippling or a comparable HRIS


WHY JOIN US

 - Impact: You shape how managers manage at a company that is scaling several-fold

 - Ownership: You help build the partnering function rather than inherit it

 - Opportunity: Rethink how people partnering works in an AI-native company, and define what it looks like in practice

 - Scope: Manager partnership, employee relations, culture, and learning in the same role

 - Culture: A team that prizes intellectual growth, learning, and being challenged in a supportive environment


LOCATION

Remote (EST time zone preferred)

jobs.title: Strategic Communications Manager
jobs.description:
Antora Energy delivers affordable, reliable energy to industry, data centers, and the grid. Our thermal batteries turn low-cost electricity into always-on heat and power, without supply-constrained critical minerals or multi-year construction timelines.

We are growing our company with people who put team and mission first, value connection through laughter and joy, and work with humility and openness. We are committed to building a diverse, passionate, and creative team dedicated to a future powered by abundant, clean, low-cost energy.

Position Summary

Antora is hiring a Strategic Communications Manager to tell our story clearly and persuasively. This role sits at the intersection of communications, commercial, and policy (it's not a PR or social-media-first role). You'll shape how customers, communities, and policymakers understand what Antora does and why it matters. That means learning the substance fast, judging what each audience needs to hear, and making the decks, one-pagers, and other content that deliver it.

You might come from a communications background, or you might have experience in consulting, policy, campaigns, marketing, or something else entirely. Either way, you excel at making complicated things clear, and you're eager to jump in wherever the company needs help: a community meeting, a conference, or a cross-functional project. You'll use AI as a partner to produce better content faster and take on more than one person normally could. You'll also own the tools and workflows that keep our content accurate and make it easier for the rest of the company to tell our story.

Roles & Responsibilities

• Build and adapt Antora's decks, one-pagers, and other materials for each audience and use case, from a quick pass on an existing deck to new materials for a market we haven't pitched before.

• Produce and edit written content, talking points, posts, thought leadership, videos, and graphics that tell Antora's story at the right depth for each use case, from making a big-picture pitch to explaining a nuance in energy market dynamics.

• Support cross-functional priorities across the company, bringing sharp judgment and polished materials to high-stakes events, new partnerships, and strategic projects.

• Support the policy and commercial teams on community engagement, policy initiatives, and demonstrating Antora's value to utilities and grid operators.

• Drive execution of announcements and executive communications, including launch plans, website updates, partner coordination, speaker prep, and executive social media.

• Run and expand our AI-assisted communications workflows, help teammates use AI to produce their own communications, and maintain the single source of truth for the facts those workflows depend on.

Key Qualifications

• 3+ years in communications, marketing, consulting, policy, campaigns, or a related role, with a track record of making complicated things clear. We care more about what you've built and how fast you learn than how many years of experience you have.

• Experience building content from scratch and owning it end to end, across formats and for different audiences.

• Strong writing and editing skills, paired with judgment on what to surface and what to leave behind.

• Appetite to take on whatever the company needs, from strategic priorities to the details that make them work, and the ability to move fast across many projects and shifting priorities.

• Comfort with basic design, including the ability to build a clean deck or one-pager and direct a designer when needed.

• Deep use of AI tools, including workflows you've built, and a habit of pushing what they can do.

• Experience getting up to speed on new subjects quickly and working directly with subject matter experts to get the details right.

• Genuine interest in Antora's mission and a collaborative, low-ego approach.

Additional Qualifications Desired

• Strong understanding of the energy sector, energy technology, and energy markets.

• Experience managing corporate or executive social media channels.

• Experience with graphic design or video production.

• Exposure to policy, political, or community engagement work.

Work Location:  Hybrid preferred - San Jose, CA

Salary Range:  $113,000 USD - $135,000 USD

Salary Basis:  Annual

Please note that the salary range listed above reflects Antora Energy's estimated pay for this position. The actual salary offered will be within the posted range and determined based on several factors including but not limited to a candidate's experiences, credentials and expertise, as they pertain to the position's requirements.

In addition to a competitive base salary, Antora Energy’s Total Rewards program includes equity compensation in the form of stock options, a premium health benefits package with life and disability insurance, a 401K plan with employer contributions, flexible spending accounts, and an industry leading paid-time-off policy that features flexible and inclusive holiday observance, as well as paid volunteer time off.

When it comes to stopping climate change, we need everyone. We believe that having a diversity of backgrounds and experiences strengthens all of us, and we strive to create an environment where every one of us is empowered to create meaningful change.

GCM Grosvenor is hiring a Business Analyst (BA) Intern in the Technology Product & Strategy department of a dynamic alternative investment management firm. The BA will work closely with the Product Manager, vendors, and engineering teams to deliver technology solutions that:

• Drive efficiency in our business operations and investment decision-making

• Enhance employee experience and engagement via emerging technologies

• Data and detail-oriented decision-making with affinity for tinkering with data and reporting tools.

ABOUT THE FIRM

GCM Grosvenor (Nasdaq: GCMG) is a global alternative asset management solutions provider with approximately $97 billion in assets under management across private equity, infrastructure, real estate, credit, and absolute return investment strategies.

The firm has specialized in alternatives for more than 54 years and has a diverse, engaged team of approximately 560 professionals serving a global client base. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Platform
jobs.description:
About Ditto:

Ditto is redefining how data moves at the edge. Our mission is to make it seamless for developers to build resilient, real-time applications, regardless of network conditions. Whether you're in a stadium, airplane, or remote military base, Ditto's peer-to-peer sync engine ensures devices stay connected and data stays consistent, even without internet. With more than $145 million in funding and trusted by organizations like Chick-fil-A, Delta Airlines, and the U.S. military, Ditto powers mission-critical experiences across aviation, retail, travel, hospitality, defense, and more. As a globally distributed, fast-growing startup, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that reflects the wide range of perspectives needed to solve the world’s hardest connectivity problems.


ABOUT THE POSITION

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you are the technical tip of the spear. FDEs are elite, versatile engineers who work shoulder-to-shoulder with our most critical users to solve complex challenges in real time. Your primary mission is to radically decrease the time-to-value of our software by integrating it directly into the user's operational environment.

Because you see firsthand how our technology performs in the wild, you will also act as a crucial conduit, feeding technical insights and feature requirements back to our core product engineering team. This role requires a highly adaptable problem-solver who is comfortable moving fast, navigating ambiguity, and figuring things out quickly in high-stakes environments.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Implement the Core Aggregation Node: Lead the on-site architecture, deployment, and configuration of our central data hub within SOCOM's highly secure, distributed cloud environment.

 - Architect and Manage GovCloud Infrastructure: Stand up, harden, and operate production workloads on AWS GovCloud at high impact levels, ensuring full compliance with security and accreditation requirements.

 - Deploy and Maintain Container Orchestration: Own the lifecycle of Kubernetes clusters (including RKE2/K3s variants) across cloud and on-premise environments, managing upgrades, scaling, monitoring, and incident response.

 - Engineer Secure Cross-Domain Data Flows: Architect and troubleshoot data synchronization pipelines that traverse Cross Domain Solutions (CDS) and data diodes, ensuring secure, policy-compliant, unidirectional data transfer between classification levels.

 - Bridge the Gap: Translate the unique, edge-case operational realities you observe (e.g., ATO constraints, network segmentation at the SOCOM enterprise level, cross-domain latency) into actionable technical requirements for the core product development team.

 - Lead Technical Customer Engagement: Work directly with operational users and Government technical stakeholders to understand mission workflows, integration needs, environmental constraints, and deployment readiness. Communicate technical progress, dependencies, and issues in coordination with the Program Manager.

 - Analyze and Validate Requirements: Translate customer needs into documented operational and technical requirements, including data sources, interfaces, connectivity, security constraints, and measurable acceptance criteria. Validate requirements with customers and coordinate feasibility and prioritization with Product, Engineering, and Program Management.

 - Provide Tier 2/3 Technical Support: Provide advanced troubleshooting and sustainment engineering for the APFIT program under development and test. Reproduce issues, collect diagnostic evidence, identify root causes, implement authorized fixes or workarounds, and coordinate product defects with core Engineering through verification and closure. Keep Program Management informed of customer impact, remediation status, and escalation needs.

 - Support Operational Validation: Support scheduled integration, test, demonstration, deployment, and operational validation events. Develop technical test procedures, document results, and track deficiencies against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria.

 - Document and Transition the Capability: Maintain integration documentation, configuration baselines, deployment procedures, and troubleshooting guides. Provide technical knowledge transfer supporting Government operation and support of the accepted capability.


WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - Clearance Requirement: Must hold an active TS/SCI clearance (Due to federal security clearance requirements, U.S. Citizenship is strictly required for this role).

 - 5+ years of experience in platform engineering, DevOps, site reliability engineering (SRE), or cloud infrastructure engineering. This includes hands-on experience deploying, configuring, and troubleshooting complex systems in live production environments.

 - 2+ years of technical experience with container orchestration platforms and cloud-native architectures in secure environments, including CI/CD pipeline design and infrastructure-as-code tooling.

 - Demonstrated experience with AWS GovCloud or equivalent FedRAMP-authorized cloud platforms at IL4/IL5/IL6, including a deep understanding of the compliance, networking, and architectural constraints of operating at these impact levels.

 - A highly adaptable, problem-solving mindset, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, move fast, and balance immediate operational fixes with long-term technical fidelity.

 - Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. As the crucial bridge between the operational edge and our core development team, you must be able to translate complex, edge-case technical realities and user workflows into clear, actionable requirements for product engineers.

 - Demonstrated experience leading customer discovery sessions and translating operational needs into clear, testable technical requirements.

 - Experience diagnosing complex applications, data synchronization, integration, and networking issues, including coordinating escalations and fixes with software engineering teams.

 - Proven ability to communicate technical constraints, tradeoffs, and remediation plans to customers while coordinating scope and delivery commitments with Program Management.




NICE TO HAVES

 - Hands-on experience with Cross Domain Solutions (CDS) and data diodes, including architecting or troubleshooting unidirectional data flows between unclassified and classified networks.

 - Experience with the Authority to Operate (ATO) process, including STIG implementation, vulnerability management, and working with ISSMs/ISSOs to achieve and maintain accreditation.

 - Familiarity with SOCOM-specific or SOF-centric IT environments, including an understanding of the SOCOM enterprise network architecture and its unique operational requirements.

 - Experience with GitOps workflows (e.g., ArgoCD, Flux) for managing Kubernetes deployments in air-gapped or disconnected environments.

 - Previous experience with event streaming or data messaging platforms (e.g., Kafka, NATS, RabbitMQ) in high-security environments.

 - Previous experience working directly with DoD, IC, or SOCOM customers, with an understanding of navigating classified network environments.

 - A background in systems programming (e.g., Rust, Go, or C++) alongside standard scripting, allowing for deep optimization of platform services.


THE BENEFITS OF BUILDING WITH US

We offer competitive salaries and meaningful equity. We believe everyone on the team should have a stake in what we’re building. Benefits vary by region to make sure you're covered in the ways that matter most. In the US, that includes health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, plus a 401(k) and flexible spending accounts. 

Regardless of where you live, everyone at Ditto can utilize flexible time off. And while we work remotely, our Atlanta office is always open if you ever want a place to work or meet up with teammates.




APPLY ANYWAY

At Ditto, we know game-changers don’t always come wrapped in a “perfect” resume. Years of experience? Every single bullet point checked? Meh. That’s not what drives us.

What does matter?

 - Grit.

 - Curiosity.

 - Adaptability.

 - And a genuine spark for what we’re building.

So if you’re fired up about our mission but not sure you tick every box - hit that apply button anyway. Use your application to show us how you’ll make an impact here.

We’re always on the lookout for exceptional humans who want to grow, stretch, and build something meaningful with us.


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Ditto is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Ditto is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let us know.
