jobs.title: Senior Manager, RCM Optimization & Strategy
jobs.description:
About Us

InStride Health’s mission is to deliver specialty anxiety and OCD care that works for every kid, teen, young adult, and family who needs it. Through this mission, we are expanding access to insurance-based care, increasing engagement in treatment, and improving treatment outcomes. We are doing this by combining research-backed clinical care and innovative technology to eliminate the major problems with care today: difficulty finding providers, months of waiting to be seen, arduous onboarding processes, and inconsistent use of evidence-based therapies and outcomes tracking. Our vision is to become the nation’s most trusted provider of pediatric anxiety and OCD care.

Team InStride Health: Our Core Values

• Give Heart: We lead with heart, treating patients and their families the way we want our loved ones to be treated.

• Work Smart: We find smarter ways to solve hard problems and fix the broken mental health system by leveraging technology, diversity of thought, and innovation.

• Have Humility: We leave our egos at the door, empowering our team to collaborate, celebrate diversity, and adopt a growth mindset.

• Embrace Community: We all belong. We are in this together, and we never worry alone. We believe in each other and recognize that every voice matters.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Manager, RCM Optimization & Strategy to find and fix the root causes of denials, front-end rejections, and revenue leakage across InStride’s Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) operations. Reporting directly to the Senior Director of RCM, this high impact senior individual contributor role serves as the strategic bridge between core RCM workflows (billing, cash posting, AR, and patient collections), Payor Operations, and the analytics and technology that power them. You will own billing system setup and payor billing logic, lead root-cause analysis on denials and underpayments, and build the KPI framework the RCM team uses to measure performance. This is an individual contributor role: rather than managing the billing and AR team, you will equip the team and the Senior Director of RCM with the insights, workflows, and system fixes that make their work faster and more accurate.

You will collaborate closely with the RCM team, Payor Operations, Licensing & Credentialing, Authorization & Eligibility, Clinical Admissions, Clinical Operations, and IT to reduce front-end errors, streamline complex workflows, resolve systemic payor issues, and maximize collections. As InStride’s RCM function scales, this role may have the opportunity to grow into people leadership. This is a fully remote position.

Responsibilities:

• Analyze end-to-end RCM workflows, from pre-billing through denial resolution and patient collections, to eliminate manual processes, remove operational bottlenecks, and address revenue leakage. Design, test, and implement streamlined workflows in partnership with the Senior Director of RCM.

• Own billing system setup and configuration across InStride’s RCM platforms (Apero, Sigma, and Mahler), including payor billing logic, fee schedules, and contract terms, to minimize revenue leakage and maximize contract yield.

• Build, maintain, and continuously refine RCM KPI dashboards (such as clean claim rate, denial rate, days in AR, claim lag, appeals, and collection rate) and share insights with the Senior Director of RCM and the team.

• Perform routine audits of billing engine rules, rule logic, and fee schedules to ensure ongoing compliance with payor guidelines and coding updates.

• Lead deep-dive root-cause analyses on claim denials and underpayments, and recommend durable fixes to the Senior Director of RCM and partner teams.

• Serve as the internal checkpoint for claims escalations raised by the billing and AR team: confirm that internal options (such as credentialing and member eligibility checks) and appeal pathways have been exhausted, and that escalation files are complete (such as member ID), before issues go to the payor.

• Partner with Technology teams to implement automation that streamlines claim submission, denials management, and revenue capture.

• Partner with Payor Operations on systemic payor issues related to claim submission and resolution, including issues that require escalation to health plans.

• Manage internal and clearinghouse configuration rules to resolve pre-claim edits and front-end rejections upstream.

• Lead recurring coordination with Licensing & Credentialing on downstream claims issues and with Authorization & Eligibility on eligibility-driven claim errors (such as an incorrect billable payor), and partner with Patient Access and Clinical Operations to reduce intake-driven denials.

• Lead change management when deploying new billing tools, software integrations, or workflow changes, partnering with the Senior Director of RCM to train and support the team.

• Deliver executive-level RCM insights, progress updates, and financial performance reporting to the Senior Director of RCM and executive leadership.

What You Need to Succeed in the Role

• 6+ years of progressive healthcare revenue cycle management experience, with at least 3 years in an analytical, optimization, or process improvement capacity.

• Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Finance, Business Analytics, or a related field or 10+ years in healthcare RCM.

• Proven track record of using complex data sets to streamline RCM operations, reduce claim denials, and recover lost revenue.

• Strong project management background with demonstrated success leading cross-functional tech or process improvement projects.

• Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to translate complex revenue cycle data into clear, actionable insights for diverse teams.

• Highly collaborative mindset with proven ability to build effective relationships across clinical, operational, and technical leadership.

• Working knowledge of insurance payor policies, billing guidelines, and claims submission requirements.

• Familiarity with CPT and ICD-10 codes and how they impact billing and reimbursement.

• Hands-on experience with payor contract analysis, fee schedule audits, and underpayment identification and recovery.

• Experience configuring billing platforms; experience with Apero, Sigma, Mahler, or similar RCM software preferred.

Additional Preferred Qualifications

• ​​Behavioral health or telehealth billing background.

• Previous experience in a fast-paced, high-growth, or startup healthcare environment.

• Hands-on experience building custom clearinghouse rules and robotic process automation (RPA)/AI solutions.

• Advanced technical mastery in SQL, BI reporting platforms (e.g., Looker, Power BI), EHR/PM systems, and clearinghouse rule builders.

• Passion for pediatric mental health and expanding access to high-quality care.

The expected annual salary for this role is between $130,000-$145,000. Actual starting salary will be determined on an individualized basis and will be based on several factors including but not limited to specific skill set, work experience, etc.

Why Join Our Team

jobs.title: Production Manager - Night Shift
jobs.description:
About Carvana

At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period. To make sure our car’s are in
first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website. Using our Carvana Certified 150-point inspection process, we’re able to verify that every vehicle meets our rigorous mechanical and cosmetic standards. We strive to provide only the highest quality vehicles to our customers in our mission to deliver a no-hassle, better car buying experience. We are actively looking for passionate and talented individuals who can help us deliver on that promise.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Keep reading below to see what we’re looking for!

Position Overview:

This is a supervisory position in an Inspection Center overseeing a team carrying out daily operations within a Carvana Inspection Center.. The Reconditioning Manager oversees all aspects of the vehicle reconditioning process and directs at least five leads and up to 70 front line associates in a lean manufacturing environment. This role will be responsible for maintaining a culture of continuous improvement and high associate engagement while meeting quality, production, and cost objectives.

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

What you’ll be doing:

• Oversee day-to-day operations within the Inspection Center.

• Provide mentoring and accountability to direct reports and succession planning through appropriate coaching, leadership development and training, and performance management.

• Participate in the development and execution of strategic plans, goals, and objectives, ensuring alignment with those of the company.

• Ensure adherence to operating standards, systems, policies, procedures, and performance standards.

• Create a work and team environment that inspires positive communication, team cohesion, and adherence to Carvana’s Values.

• Maintain supervisory staff by recruiting, selecting, orienting, and training employees.

• Ensure progression path training and certification processes are consistently executed.

• Train and mentor leads and associates by providing competency-based feedback.

• Ensure adequate production capacity levels for each line and assist with production planning.

• Ensure compliance with all health and safety and loss prevention guidelines.

• Provide vision and guidance to the reconditioning team in meeting performance metrics.

• Positively reinforce and engage the team regarding quality, production and cost objectives.

• Participate in and lead problem solving and continuous improvement efforts.

What the job requires:

To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

• 5 years of management experience either in automotive or a lean manufacturing environment.

• Knowledge of lean manufacturing principles.

• Experience leading and developing associates.

• Proven ability to obtain project deliverables and company metrics.

• Ability to read, write, speak and understand English.

• Must be at least 18 years of age.

• Valid unrestricted driver’s license with a clean driving record in the last 3 years.

• Ability to maintain high volume and high-quality content in a fast-paced environment.

• Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills.

• Ability to work with and through teams to achieve results

• Strong analysis and decision making ability.

• Proficient computer skills.

• Ability to work overtime and on weekends.

• Ability to walk up to three miles each day.

• Requires standing for extended periods of time with frequent stretching, reaching, walking, stooping, pushing, and/or pulling in an environment that may be cold, hot, noisy, and wet and may have fumes or odors due to vehicle maintenance.

• Must be able to lift up to 40 pounds independently; majority of lifting from knee to shoulder heights; other lifting required from various levels.

• Requires use of safety equipment and PPO that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment.

This job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Compensation: $95,000 to $100,000

jobs.description:

What We Do

Everyone at Agility Robotics is a stakeholder and a partner. Enterprise Applications at Agility has a diverse range of functions, including support of MRP/ERP solutions, RFQ/RFP of in use or new products to align business teams, systems architecture, PLM, and scaling our manufacturing operations.

We are seeking a Senior Enterprise Applications Engineer to be responsible for the administration, configuration, enhancement, and ongoing support of the organization's enterprise application portfolio, with primary ownership of the NetSuite ERP platform. In this role, you will partner with business stakeholders to design and implement scalable solutions that improve operational efficiency while ensuring platform stability, performance, and user adoption. You will oversee system configuration, customizations, workflows, integrations, and release management, ensuring all changes are aligned with business objectives and follow established governance and change management processes. You will also be accountable for maintaining compliance with security, regulatory, and audit requirements, enforcing data governance standards to preserve the integrity and quality of enterprise data, and ensuring seamless integration between NetSuite and other business-critical systems. Working closely with IT, Security, Finance, and business teams, you will drive continuous improvement, optimize enterprise processes, and ensure the application ecosystem remains secure, reliable, and scalable to support the organization's long-term growth.

Responsibilities

• Partner with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements, translating them into scalable technical solutions that improve business processes across the enterprise applications landscape.

• Design, configure, and maintain NetSuite workflows, customizations, forms, saved searches, dashboards, roles, and other platform capabilities to meet evolving business needs.

• Design, implement, and support integrations between NetSuite and other enterprise platforms, ensuring reliable, secure, and efficient data exchange.

• Ensure enterprise applications comply with organizational security standards, regulatory requirements, audit controls, and Segregation of Duties (SoD) policies.

• Maintain and evolve the enterprise application architecture by evaluating current capabilities, identifying opportunities for standardization and modernization, reducing technical debt, and ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, well-integrated, and aligned with the organization's technology strategy.

• Collaborate with Security, Infrastructure, and Architecture teams to evaluate new solutions, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and optimize the overall enterprise application ecosystem.

• Develop and maintain system documentation, configuration standards, support procedures, and knowledge articles while providing guidance and training to business users and support teams.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience administering, configuring, and supporting enterprise applications, with significant hands-on experience in NetSuite ERP.

• Proven experience gathering business requirements and translating them into scalable technical solutions and application enhancements.

• Strong understanding of NetSuite configuration, workflows, roles, permissions, saved searches, dashboards, SuiteFlow, and general platform administration. Experience with SuiteScript is preferred.

• Experience designing, implementing, and supporting integrations between enterprise applications using APIs, middleware, or integration platforms.

• Knowledge of enterprise architecture principles, application lifecycle management, and software development/change management best practices.

• Experience implementing and maintaining data governance standards, master data management practices, and ensuring data quality across integrated systems.

• Strong understanding of security best practices, role-based access controls (RBAC), Segregation of Duties (SoD), audit controls, and regulatory compliance requirements such as SOX.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously while balancing operational support, enhancements, and strategic projects.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills with the ability to resolve complex application issues.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across IT, Finance, Operations, Security, and other business functions.

• Experience documenting business processes, solution designs, technical configurations, and support procedures.

• Self-motivated with a continuous improvement mindset and a passion for optimizing business processes through technology.

Bonus Qualifications

• Experience developing custom solutions using SuiteScript 2.x (JavaScript) to automate business processes and extend NetSuite functionality.

• Proficiency with SuiteQL for advanced reporting, analytics, and efficient data extraction.

• Experience using the SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF) to manage NetSuite configurations and customizations through source control and CI/CD deployment practices.

jobs.title: Consumer Experience Campaign Specialist
jobs.description:
The Role

Plexus Worldwide is seeking a Consumer Campaigns Specialist to coordinate and execute campaigns that help consumers discover the value of our products, get started, reorder, and stay engaged. This role develops clear, relevant communications across the consumer journey and works with Marketing, Digital, Product, Field Development, Customer Service, and Analytics to bring campaigns to life.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong writing and campaign coordination skills with curiosity about consumer behavior and a drive to improve retention.

Employee Value Proposition

Help build the next generation of consumer engagement at Plexus. You will shape communications at important moments in the consumer journey, contribute to more personalized campaigns, and see how your work affects customer relationships, retention, and growth.

Key Performance Objectives

• Establish a reliable consumer campaign process and calendar, keeping priorities, owners, approvals, and launch dates clear.

• Execute targeted campaigns that improve onboarding, product education, reorder, retention, and win-back.

• Develop communications that encourage retail customers to become VIP customers.

• Use consumer insights and campaign results to improve messaging, timing, and engagement.

Performance Accountabilities

Campaign Planning and Execution

• Coordinate consumer campaigns from brief through launch, managing timelines, audience requirements, creative assets, approvals, and deployment.

• Maintain the campaign calendar and align communications with key moments across the consumer journey.

• Write and refine consumer-focused messaging that is clear, helpful, and consistent with campaign objectives.

Cross-Functional Coordination

• Partner with Marketing, Digital, Product, Field Development, Customer Service, Analytics, and other teams to align campaigns with consumer needs and business priorities.

• Coordinate reviews, communicate status, resolve open items, and confirm campaigns are ready to launch.

• Support targeted pathways for onboarding, product education, reorder, retail-to-VIP conversion, loyalty, and win-back.

Measurement and Improvement

• Monitor engagement, conversion, reorder, retention, and consumer response trends.

• Prepare campaign recaps and recommend improvements to messaging, segmentation, timing, and delivery.

• Support testing, personalization, and automation as consumer engagement capabilities grow.

• Work occasional evenings, weekends, or holidays as business needs require.

Performance Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Marketing, or a related field; equivalent related experience considered.

• Experience: At least three years of experience in marketing campaigns, lifecycle marketing, customer engagement, digital marketing, or CRM communications. Four years of experience with consumer lifecycle or retention campaigns preferred.

• Campaign Execution: Ability to coordinate campaigns across channels, manage details and deadlines, and move work through review and launch.

• Writing and Communication: Strong writing skills and the ability to create clear, relevant communications for different consumer audiences.

• Consumer Insights: Understanding of lifecycle stages, segmentation, onboarding, reorder behavior, and retention; ability to use campaign results to recommend improvements.

• Collaboration and Judgment: Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to work effectively across teams and changing priorities.

• Work Location: Ability to work onsite in Scottsdale, Arizona.

Founded in gut health. Experts in microbiome. Plexus Worldwide®, headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, is a renowned direct-selling company recognized as a top employer. Over the past 18 years, Plexus has dedicated itself to promoting hope, health, and happiness through its scientifically backed, innovative dietary supplements, weight management products, and personal care products, sold primarily through Plexus Brand Ambassadors. As a six-time Best Places to Work awardee, Blue Zone-approved employer, and an AZ Most Admired Company, Plexus prides itself on its robust organizational culture and commitment to community support and philanthropy. Our team is driven by a shared mission to empower individuals to achieve their health and wellness goals while offering additional income through the sale of products. Join us to be part of a team that values people, innovation, wellness, and community impact.

• 401 (k) with company match and immediate vesting.

To learn more about Plexus Worldwide, please review our careers page at www.plexusworldwide.com/careers.

jobs.title: Multimedia Reporter, Space
jobs.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for.

The Science desk of the New York Times is looking for a creative, energetic reporter to cover the world of space exploration. We’re looking for a heartbeat of stories that capture the wonder, the successes and failures, the big dreams and big personalities of the space world, whether at private space companies like SpaceX or in the orbit of NASA. The ideal candidate will be an accomplished multimedia journalist who can report and produce both text and video. You are adept at moving quickly on breaking news including launch coverage and other fixtures of the daily beat, but also able to identify stories with visual potential and eager to pursue a wide array of types of stories, including developing ambitious visual enterprise stories.

This is an in-office position and includes regular attendance in a New York Times bureau four days each week. There may also be flexibility to work remotely per departmental guidance.

Responsibilities:

• Pitch, report and produce news, enterprise and explanatory stories in both text and video, including on-camera reporting.

• Contribute to live and developing-news coverage, including launches, mission milestones, anomalies and breaking developments.

• Help to develop well-structured scripts for linear videos and combine text and visuals in multimedia formats.

• Monitor wires, local and regional outlets, social media feeds and other sources for developing storylines and reporting opportunities that help explain the beat and advance ongoing storylines, keeping us ahead of national competitors.

• Cultivate existing sources and develop new ones to land exclusive stories to cover this beat authoritatively.

• Work collaboratively across the newsroom including with editors, video producers, video and photo editors and motion graphics colleagues to develop stories from pitch through publication.

• Ensure visual accuracy, fair representation and rigorous fact-checking.

• Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

• This role reports to the Space Editor.

Basic Qualifications:

• 5+ years of experience covering space or science-related topics

• Experience covering complex subjects with elegance, sensitivity and fairness

• A portfolio that demonstrates you are well-versed in a range of topics, and have a growing circle of sources across storylines

• Demonstrated understanding of the video production process and creative instincts that go beyond traditional text formats

• A willingness to be flexible as the news demands and the newsroom's needs evolve

• An openness to trying new storytelling approaches, and a demonstrated ability to communicate clearly

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience working as a reporter in high-pressure, deadline-driven newsrooms

• Experience covering live events, launches, breaking news or rapidly developing stories

• A strong understanding of Times style and standards

• Proven experience leading field productions, writing scripts and crafting compelling narratives.

• On-camera experience

• Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro

• Ability to shoot video

REQ-020785

Additional Compensation and Benefits

Benefits may include medical, dental and vision benefits, Flexible Spending Accounts (F.S.A.s), a company-matching 401(k) plan, employee stock purchase plan, paid vacation, paid sick days, paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement and professional development programs.

jobs.title: Lead Digital Hardware Engineer
jobs.description:
Digital Hardware Engineer

About the Team:

The STR Sensors Division specializes in the development of advanced sensor systems, with a particular focus on airborne and surface-based radar, space-based sensing, electronic warfare, and underwater acoustics. This position is within the Space Missions and Sensing (SMS) Sector of the Sensors Division.

STR’s Space Missions and Sensing (SMS) Sector’s mission is to develop and apply innovative technology to space-based sensing, space control, and counter-sensing. Within the SMS Sector, the Space and Counter Space (SCS) team is at the forefront in electronic warfare technologies.  Our team strives to bring critical and transformational capabilities to the warfighter through creative ideas and techniques.  To realize the value, the team develops both engineering and operational prototypes to demonstrate capabilities in real world environments.

We take pride in our ability to address warfighter operational needs. Our core team includes principal investigators, program managers, signal processors, SW developers, FPGA expertise, RF and Electromagnetic engineers, and mechanical design experts.  Our facilities support on site build and test (benchtop, anechoic chamber, and over the air).  We collaborate with a dynamic group of research engineers across STR, academic researchers, and industry partners to develop practical and effective solutions to RF sensing and counter-sensing challenges.

Driven by our strong performance the work is expanding.  We are seeking individuals with program management experience and interest in being part of a system of systems work program encompassing both new capabilities and operational prototype systems. If you're seeking an opportunity to apply your program management skills while contributing to a work program strategic vision, we invite you to join us.

The Role:

The SMS Sector is seeking a Digital Hardware Engineer.  This role will be supporting engineering development, integration, and demonstration efforts for complex electronic systems.  Candidate will collaborate with a dynamic engineering development team leading system and subsystem prototype efforts for complex digital circuit cards and modules.  The successful candidate must have strong technical aptitude, communication skills and ability to work well across the engineering team.

to lead small teams to design, develop, integrate and test novel sensing and counter sensing systems for radar, electronic warfare, and signal processing systems.  This position offers significant opportunities for career growth within a fast-paced and rapidly expanding company.

What you will do:

• Design of complex high speed digital circuit card assemblies across a range of platforms and form factors, including custom boards, test boards, evaluation-kit integration, and COTS system-on-modules (SoMs) integrated into custom carrier boards.

• Lead and work with small, multi-disciplinary teams to design, build, and test hardware systems. Systems are predominantly field deployable prototypes with the objective of transitioning to low-volume product systems.

• Lead the team to quantify goals, system performance objectives, metrics, dependencies, and risks to guide your work.

• Support test and troubleshooting of systems, modules, and sub-assemblies of digital modules.

• Perform signal-integrity, power-integrity, and timing analysis, and define stackups and design constraints to meet performance, reliability, and manufacturability requirements.

• Generate and review test procedures, drawings, engineering specifications, reports, and other documentation.

• Conduct digital system performance trade studies and analyses of proposed architectures to develop, derive, and verify requirements. Conduct performance analysis through simulations and real-world testing to validate system performance.

• Interface with government sponsors and suppliers as necessary.

• Mentor peers and more junior engineers in areas of expertise.

Who you are:

• This position requires the ability to obtain a security clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is required by U.S. Government. Active Secret Clearance HIGHLY PREFERRED.

• BS in Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical discipline

• PhD + 2 years, MS + 5 years, or BS + 7 years of experience in digital circuit card design assemblies and working with design, build, integration and test of complex electronic systems.

• Experience defining digital interfaces, clocking schemes, and system architecture for hardware built around microcontrollers, FPGAs/SoCs, and data-converter ICs.

• Experience with high-speed digital interfaces (e.g., PCIe, SerDes, Ethernet, DDR) and with signal-integrity analysis.

• Experience working with CAD based schematic capture and simulation tools such as Altium Designer.

• Familiarity collaborating on RF systems and subsystems.

• Proficiency in MATLAB and/or Python and/or other higher-level languages

• Strong Mathematical, troubleshooting, written, and verbal communication skills

Even Better:

• Advanced degree in Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical discipline

• Excellent problem-solving skills, judgement, and analytical capability

• Motivated self-starter with leaderships kills and ability to effectively work in a team environment

• Ability to apply novel, innovative and interdisciplinary approaches to challenging engineering problems

• Ability to create and present briefings to customers and senior management to provide both high-level and deep technical solution explanations

Join us and be part of a team that's making an impact at the forefront of technology and innovation.

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $174.000 to $225.000

The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

STR is a growing technology company with locations near Boston, MA, Arlington, VA, near Dayton, OH, Melbourne, FL, Carlsbad, CA, Atlanta, GA, and Denver, CO. We specialize in advanced research and development for defense, intelligence, and national security in: cyber; next generation sensors, radar, sonar, communications, and electronic warfare; and artificial intelligence algorithms and analytics to make sense of the complexity that is exploding around us.

STR is committed to creating a collaborative learning environment that supports deep technical understanding and recognizes the contributions and achievements of all team members. STR is not just any company. Our people, culture, and attitude along with their unique set of skills, experiences, and perspectives put us on a trajectory to change the world. We can't do it alone, though - we need fellow trailblazers. If you are one, join our team and help to keep our society safe! Visit us at www.str.us for more info.

jobs.description:
JOB POSITION:  Industrial Technician

Hours: On the DuPont schedule rotation, 4 days on, 3 off, 3 on, four off etc.. dupont schedule - Search

Are you interested in becoming an experienced Overhead Crane Service Technician? Join Konecranes, one of the world’s largest material handling companies. We're seeking skilled individuals with electrical and mechanical expertise, comfortable working at extreme heights. Our service technicians, the heart of our industry, thrive in a safety-first environment. You'll troubleshoot 480 3-phase motors, address crane issues, and collaborate with clients and facility directors to meet service needs across the United States.

Principal Responsibilities:

• Conduct inspections, maintenance, and repairs on electric overhead traveling cranes and hoists at customer locations.
• Provide on-call service as part of a rotation, including after-hours support.
• Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical, structural, and electronic issues on-site.
• Perform post-repair audits to ensure safety features are functional.
• Document findings and recommend corrective actions, including safety notifications to customers.
• Consult with customers on repair and safety issues, offering recommendations for material handling improvement.
• Produce electronic documentation using company tools, obtaining customer signatures.
• Stay updated on industry codes and regulations (OSHA, ANSI, CMAA, HMI).
• Complete service reports and other required documents accurately and promptly.
• Communicate with the Field Operations Manager and Service Coordinator following established practices
• Maintain company-issued equipment, vehicles, and assets in proper working order.
• Operate tools, equipment, and vehicles, reporting deficiencies to the supervisor.
• Follow established safety rules and procedures, including customer guidelines.
• Participate in monthly safety meetings.
• Perform other responsibilities as assigned by the supervisor.

jobs.title: Cultivation Associate - Flower
jobs.description:
At Curaleaf, we’re redefining the cannabis industry with a strong commitment to quality, expertise, and innovation. As a leading global cannabis provider, our brands—including Curaleaf, Select, and Grassroots—offer premium products and services in both medical and adult-use markets.

Join us at Curaleaf to be part of a high-growth, purpose-driven company that champions corporate social responsibility through our Rooted in Good initiative, supporting community outreach and positive change. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, drive innovation, and help shape the future of cannabis.

Title: Cultivation Associate - Harvest
Pay Rate: $18.50
Location: Ravena, NY
Job Type: Full Time | Non-Exempt
Shift: Monday- Friday | 7:00am - 3:30pm

Who You Are:
You’re excited to build a well-rounded skill set in cannabis cultivation and eager to learn every aspect of the garden. With training and guidance, you’ll gain hands-on experience across the entire production cycle, including plant care, environmental monitoring, harvesting, and more. You bring curiosity, reliability, and a team-focused mindset, making you a key part of a cultivation operation that thrives on shared knowledge and cross-training.

What You’ll Do:

As a Cultivation Associate at Curaleaf, you’ll be cross-trained to support the full plant life cycle, from clone to harvest, helping to grow premium cannabis while maintaining top-quality standards. Your day-to-day will include:

• Performing daily plant care such as cutting, rooting, transplanting, watering, feeding, trimming, staking, and pruning to keep plants healthy

• Tracking humidity, moisture, and temperature to maintain ideal growing conditions and meet quality goals

• Inspecting plants for leaf health, bloom size, pests, or disease and removing any that don’t meet standards

• Assisting with harvest by cutting plants, trimming, removing flowering tops, weighing products, and recording inventory in the electronic tracking system

• Supporting the curing process by hanging and dry-racking flowers, monitoring climate conditions, labeling and weighing products, and entering inventory data

• Operating and maintaining lighting, irrigation, and climate-control systems while stocking supplies and keeping all cultivation areas and tools clean and sanitized

• Pitching in during high-demand periods to help prepare and package products, including premium extraction items

• Following state regulations and security procedures by accurately labeling plants and entering inventory information

What You’ll Bring:

• You have a natural green thumb and a genuine passion for working with plants, with experience harvesting in a professional or home setting (gardening counts!)

• You thrive in a fast-paced, team environment, collaborating with others while fostering a positive and professional atmosphere

• You bring sharp attention to detail, ensuring quality and consistency in every task

• You are reliable and detail-oriented, with strong documentation, inventory, and organizational skills that help you stay on top of a tight schedule

• You have solid math and measurement skills and the ability to operate a scale with confidence

• You have a high school diploma, GED, or equivalent

Even Better If:

• You bring knowledge of growing technologies such as lighting, irrigation, soil, and nutrients, along with hands-on experience in landscaping, horticulture, or agriculture

• You understand different cannabis strains and their unique growing needs

Physical Requirements

• Ability to stand, sit, and walk for extended periods of time (8-10 hours per shift)

• Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds regularly and occasional lifting of heavier items with assistance

• Frequent and repetitive use of hands and wrists for extended periods of time

• Repetitive bending, squatting, and reaching

• Ability to climb ladders or step stools to access plants or equipment

• Ability to use required PPE when required, such as masks, hair nets, beard covers, respirators, boot covers, scrubs, non-slip shoes, and Tyvek suits as necessary

Environmental Conditions

• Exposure to environments with high humidity, varying temperatures, and strong odors (such as cannabis)

• Exposure to soil, water, fertilizer, dust, pollen and plant pathogens

• Exposure to cleaning solvents, such as high volumes of isopropyl alcohol

• Exposure to loud noises, including but not limited to air compressors, packaging equipment, and alarms

• Exposure to CO2 manufacturing procedures at OSHA approved CO2 levels

New York Hiring Range

$18.50—$18.50 USD

What We Offer:

• Career Growth Opportunities

• Competitive Pay and Benefits

• Generous PTO and Parental Leave

• 401(K) Retirement Plan

• Life/ Disability Insurance

• Community Involvement

• Referral Bonuses and Product Discounts

Benefits vary by state, role type, and eligibility.

jobs.description:
As a Product Owner, Supply Chain & Procurement (Business Solutions – Corporate Core Finance), you will own the vision, roadmap, and prioritized backlog for SAP S/4HANA capabilities that support procurement, inventory, and related finance processes. You will work closely with business stakeholders, SAP functional teams, engineers, QA, data teams, and delivery partners to deliver scalable, user-centered solutions across procure-to-pay and connected order-to-cash workflows.

This role combines strong product ownership with a working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Materials Management, Sales and Distribution, and Finance/Controlling integrations. You will focus on improving business outcomes such as purchasing compliance, process efficiency, invoice automation, spend visibility, inventory accuracy, financial controls, and user experience.

Drive Product Outcomes

• Own, maintain, and prioritize the product backlog for supply chain, procurement, and related finance capabilities.
• Define the customer and business problems to solve, desired outcomes, and success measures—not only the features to deliver.
• Translate business objectives into prioritized epics, user stories, process flows, acceptance criteria, and incremental release plans.
• Balance customer value, business impact, technical feasibility, risk, compliance needs, and delivery timelines.
• Break large initiatives into smaller releases that enable continuous delivery, learning, and measurable improvement.
• Define and monitor key performance indicators for adoption, process efficiency, procurement compliance, spend visibility, inventory accuracy, and user satisfaction.

Lead Discovery and Process Design

• Lead discovery and requirements-gathering sessions with procurement, supply chain, finance, warehouse, sales, customer service, and IT stakeholders.
• Understand current-state workflows, pain points, and control requirements needs across procure-to-pay and connected order-to-cash processes.
• Facilitate future-state process design, identify gaps and dependencies, document decisions, and build alignment on scope and priorities.
• Use stakeholder feedback, operational data, and system insights to validate assumptions before significant investment.
• Identify opportunities to improve workflows through SAP capabilities, process simplification, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled solutions.
• Maintain a strong understanding of core procurement, inventory, finance, and cross-functional business processes.

Enable Strong Delivery

• Partner with SAP functional consultants, engineers, QA, integration teams, data teams, and business process owners to refine solutions and remove ambiguity.
• Define requirements for integrations among SAP S/4HANA MM, SD, FI/CO, warehouse operations, tax, payment, logistics, customer, supplier, and third-party systems.
• Validate end-to-end business and accounting impacts across requisition-to-payment, inventory, sales-order-to-billing, and financial reporting processes.
• Participate in and lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, demos, retrospectives, and other Agile delivery ceremonies.
• Prioritize defects, enhancements, and change requests based on business impact, urgency, risk, compliance, and roadmap value.
• Support implementation activities including master-data readiness, data migration, testing, cutover planning, release readiness, hypercare, and post-launch stabilization.
• Coordinate business testing by defining test scenarios, test data, acceptance criteria, and success measures for end-to-end processes.
• Support system integration testing, user acceptance testing, regression testing, defect triage, and business sign-off.

Build Alignment and Trust

• Act as the liaison between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams.
• Communicate product strategy, roadmap priorities, progress, trade-offs, risks, and dependencies clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
• Maintain organized product documentation, business-process materials, requirements, decisions, and release information in Confluence.
• Use Jira and Slack effectively to manage backlog transparency, delivery workflow, stakeholder communication, and issue resolution.
• Support change management through training materials, process documentation, release communications, stakeholder demonstrations, and adoption feedback.
• Build trusted relationships across Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Technology, and external implementation partners.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Finance, Supply Chain, Business, or equivalent experience.
• 3+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Analyst, SAP functional delivery professional, or similar role in a technology-driven organization.
• Experience owning and prioritizing a product backlog in an Agile delivery environment.
• Experience delivering SAP S/4HANA procure-to-pay, materials management, inventory, finance integration, or related enterprise capabilities.
• Strong knowledge of procurement processes, including requisitioning, purchasing, approvals, receiving, inventory, invoice verification, supplier management, and payment workflows.
• Working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA MM and FI/CO integration concepts; familiarity with SAP SD and order-to-cash processes preferred.
• Experience supporting SAP implementations, including testing, data migration, cutover, or post-go-live stabilization.
• Experience collaborating with engineering, QA, design, data, integration, and SAP functional teams.
• Effective stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
• Comfortable working with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Strong ability to write clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process documentation, and business requirements.
• Strong presentation, written, and verbal communication skills.
• Highly detail-oriented with excellent organizational, prioritization, and problem-solving skills.
• Strong judgment in managing priorities, resources, risks, dependencies, and delivery trade-offs.
• Experience using Jira, Confluence, and Slack.

Desired Characteristics

• Experience with SAP SD configuration and integration concepts, including order-to-cash, pricing, billing, customer master data, and financial postings.
• Familiarity with SAP MM configuration concepts, including purchasing organizations, plants, storage locations, purchasing documents, release strategies, invoice tolerances, and movement types.
• Experience in media or entertainment
• Ability to investigate and learn unfamiliar systems quickly.
• Experience applying automation, analytics, or AI capabilities to improve finance, procurement, supply chain, or business workflows.

jobs.title: Strategic Partnerships & Business Development Lead
jobs.description:
SoulCycle is looking for a commercially-driven leader to own partnerships as a revenue line for the business. The role oversees all strategic partnership and business development efforts, with a clear first priority for sponsorship dollars, monetization, and customer acquisition. The second priority is on brand heat and awareness as outcomes that great strategic partnerships can produce along the way.

The right candidate knows how to tell the Soul story and package it for a partner. The job includes significant storytelling, but the primary focus is on building and running a programmatic sales and business development portfolio (with pipeline, conversion, and renewals managed like a sales book rather than a series of one-offdeals). The Director, Strategic Partnerships will source, negotiate, and close new partnerships, and will own the commercial management of our existing partner relationships, including accountability for performance, growth, and renewal economics.

The Director, Strategic Partnerships will manage and develop talent on the team, will collaborate closely with other department leaders at SoulCycle, including Marketing, Finance, Operations, and Legal.

The right candidate will:

1. Build a programmatic partnerships portfolio to achieve revenue targets, and will manage the pipeline in a way that supports the vision for B2B growth at SoulCycle.

2. Own the commercial relationship with our most significant existing partners: performance against contract, growth opportunities, and renewal negotiations.

3. Be an internal champion for Partnerships, forging strong working relationships with internal stakeholders across all departments.

4. Serve as the face of SoulCycle in the market, from exploratory conversations through contracting and onboarding, bringing an established network that is additive to our existing partner base.

5. Manage, coach, and develop a direct report, helping elevate the standard of the team.

This role demands a results-oriented, low-ego, hard working leader who can execute and who has a proven track record of delivering revenue.

RESPONSIBILITIES

● Own the Partnerships revenue annual target. Build, manage, and report on a pipeline of active deals with clear targets for sponsorship dollars, monetization, and customer acquisition.

● Own strategy, relationship management & development, and negotiation of all partnerships, bringing in cross-functional SoulCycle partners and/or executives as needed to support discussions.

● Manage the commercial side of existing partnerships, including performance against contract terms, growth opportunities, and renewal.

● Identify and source new partnerships to create revenue streams for the company, including sponsorships and alternative monetization approaches.

● Build a partner network across key wellness, retail, and other lifestyle categories, striking opportunities that meet our target consumer where they are and punctuate our brand positioning to fuel awareness and acquisition.

● Manage deal negotiations end to end, partnering with Legal, Finance, Marketing and other internal teams to establish term sheets and deal parameters.

● Lead the execution of deals post-close, holding each deal to its KPIs and building strong cross-functional internal alignment and excitement around every opportunity.

● Manage and develop a direct report; set the operating rhythm and standards for the partnerships function.

● Set, measure, and exceed goals, plans, and KPIs for the partnership program at Soul.

• 6 to 10 years building and running sales, business development, or partnerships portfolios with direct revenue accountability and a record of hitting the number.
• Experience structuring, negotiating, and renewing large, multi-year commercial contracts; comfortable owning the economics as well as the marketing and relationship management elements.
• People management experience, including experience hiring, coaching, and developing direct reports to take on additional swaths of ownership.
• Executive maturity: can run a negotiation, a partner business review, or a leadership update without a script, and holds their own with senior counterparts.
• A strong storyteller who can package the SoulCycle brand for partners, grounded in a commercial case.
• Analytically minded, with an ability to set KPIs, track performance against them, and report ROI.
• Self motivated, a self starter who can run independently and adapt in a fast-paced, evolving business.
• Familiarity and comfort with navigating fitness/wellness, music, entertainment, lifestyle, tech, and fashion/retail industries.

Pay Transparency: $145k - $160k

JOINING THE SOULCYCLE FAMILY

As a member of the SoulCycle family, you will enjoy:

• Competitive salary, benefits, and perks/discounts at SoulCycle
• Unlimited complimentary rides at all SoulCycle locations
• Growth, leadership, and professional development opportunities

The responsibilities and duties of this position described here are representative of those an employee must perform. This is not a comprehensive list and other duties may be assigned.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Must have a legal right to work in the United States.

jobs.title: Cultivation Associate - Weekend
jobs.description:
At Curaleaf, we’re redefining the cannabis industry with a strong commitment to quality, expertise, and innovation. As a leading global cannabis provider, our brands—including Curaleaf, Select, and Grassroots—offer premium products and services in both medical and adult-use markets.

Join us at Curaleaf to be part of a high-growth, purpose-driven company that champions corporate social responsibility through our Rooted in Good initiative, supporting community outreach and positive change. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, drive innovation, and help shape the future of cannabis.

Title: Cultivation Associate
Pay Rate: $18.50
Location: Ravena, NY
Job Type: Full Time | Non-Exempt
Shift: Sunday - Thursday | 7am-3:30pm

Who You Are:
You’re excited to build a well-rounded skill set in cannabis cultivation and eager to learn every aspect of the garden. With training and guidance, you’ll gain hands-on experience across the entire production cycle, including plant care, environmental monitoring, harvesting, and more. You bring curiosity, reliability, and a team-focused mindset, making you a key part of a cultivation operation that thrives on shared knowledge and cross-training.

What You’ll Do:

As a Cultivation Associate at Curaleaf, you’ll be cross-trained to support the full plant life cycle, from clone to harvest, helping to grow premium cannabis while maintaining top-quality standards. Your day-to-day will include:

• Performing daily plant care such as cutting, rooting, transplanting, watering, feeding, trimming, staking, and pruning to keep plants healthy

• Tracking humidity, moisture, and temperature to maintain ideal growing conditions and meet quality goals

• Inspecting plants for leaf health, bloom size, pests, or disease and removing any that don’t meet standards

• Assisting with harvest by cutting plants, trimming, removing flowering tops, weighing products, and recording inventory in the electronic tracking system

• Supporting the curing process by hanging and dry-racking flowers, monitoring climate conditions, labeling and weighing products, and entering inventory data

• Operating and maintaining lighting, irrigation, and climate-control systems while stocking supplies and keeping all cultivation areas and tools clean and sanitized

• Pitching in during high-demand periods to help prepare and package products, including premium extraction items

• Following state regulations and security procedures by accurately labeling plants and entering inventory information

What You’ll Bring:

• You have a natural green thumb and a genuine passion for working with plants, with experience harvesting in a professional or home setting (gardening counts!)

• You thrive in a fast-paced, team environment, collaborating with others while fostering a positive and professional atmosphere

• You bring sharp attention to detail, ensuring quality and consistency in every task

• You are reliable and detail-oriented, with strong documentation, inventory, and organizational skills that help you stay on top of a tight schedule

• You have solid math and measurement skills and the ability to operate a scale with confidence

• You have a high school diploma, GED, or equivalent

Even Better If:

• You bring knowledge of growing technologies such as lighting, irrigation, soil, and nutrients, along with hands-on experience in landscaping, horticulture, or agriculture

• You understand different cannabis strains and their unique growing needs

Physical Requirements

• Ability to stand, sit, and walk for extended periods of time (8-10 hours per shift)

• Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds regularly and occasional lifting of heavier items with assistance

• Frequent and repetitive use of hands and wrists for extended periods of time

• Repetitive bending, squatting, and reaching

• Ability to climb ladders or step stools to access plants or equipment

• Ability to use required PPE when required, such as masks, hair nets, beard covers, respirators, boot covers, scrubs, non-slip shoes, and Tyvek suits as necessary

Environmental Conditions

• Exposure to environments with high humidity, varying temperatures, and strong odors (such as cannabis)

• Exposure to soil, water, fertilizer, dust, pollen and plant pathogens

• Exposure to cleaning solvents, such as high volumes of isopropyl alcohol

• Exposure to loud noises, including but not limited to air compressors, packaging equipment, and alarms

• Exposure to CO2 manufacturing procedures at OSHA approved CO2 levels

jobs.title: Production Assembly Technician
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Assembly Technician to join our Production Team. • 5+ years of hands-on experience in precision electro-mechanical, aerospace, or manufacturing environment .

• Demonstrated expertise in mechanical assembly, torque application, and wire routing/soldering.

• Proven ability to read and interpret complex engineering drawings, blueprints, schematics, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

• Ability to life and carry 50 pounds for short periods of time unassisted.

• Experience working in an AS9100 / ISO 9001 certified quality management environment.

Beam’s suite of gene editing technologies is anchored by base editing, a proprietary technology that is designed to enable precise, predictable and efficient single base changes, at targeted genomic sequences, without making double-stranded breaks in the DNA. This has the potential to enable a wide range of therapeutic editing strategies that Beam is using to advance a diversified portfolio of base editing programs. Beam is a values-driven organization committed to its people, cutting-edge science, and a vision of providing life-long cures to patients suffering from serious diseases.

Winrock International is a nonprofit organization that works with people in the United States and around the world to empower the disadvantaged, increase economic opportunity, and sustain natural resources. Winrock matches innovative approaches in agriculture, natural resources management, clean energy, and leadership development with the unique needs of its partners. By linking local individuals and communities with new ideas and technology, Winrock is increasing long-term productivity, equity, and responsible resource management to benefit the poor and disadvantaged of the world. The Wallace Center is a unit of Winrock International working to advance a more regenerative, equitable and resilient U.S. food system.

BACKGROUND:

The Wallace Center at Winrock International works to bring together diverse people and ideas to co-create solutions that build healthy farms, equitable economies, and resilient food systems. We envision a future where all communities have the power to nourish themselves and regenerate ecosystems through just food and agricultural systems.

DESCRIPTION:

The Wallace Center is recruiting a full-time Program Manager for its U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) Advancing Markets for Producers project. The project supports the production and marketing of conservation-grown rice, primarily in Arkansas and Missouri, through providing voluntary incentives to U.S. growers to implement improved practices. Riceland Foods is a key partner.

Essential responsibilities will include:

Program Management

• Working in close cooperation with the Project Lead and other staff and Winrock support units (Awards Management, Procurement, Human Resources, Information and Communications Technology, and Finance) to provide management, administrative oversight, and leadership to achieve outcomes of the project.

• Highly organized, detail-oriented, responsive, self-directed and able to connect individual projects and decisions to broader programmatic vision and ultimate impacts.

• Tracking project activities and progress against targets and goals. Ensures accuracy, quality, and timeliness of mandatory deliverables and collaborates in production and approval of final deliverables. ·

• Demonstrating creativity, initiative and resourcefulness in problem solving and idea generation.

• Significantly contributing to project management across the program, including updating, analyzing, and enhancing project management tools. ·

• Supporting the preparation of work plans, reports, working budgets, budget forecasts, implementing project planning and analyzing project successes to build on lessons learned.

Administration and Implementation

• Complying with organizational processes and policies to ensure compliance and alignment.

• Ensuring Winrock and USDA specific policies and practices are followed and provide guidance on relevant rules and regulations.

• Contributing to other team efforts as needed.

• Completing other duties as assigned by supervisor.

Content and Metrics

• Ensuring the project achieves its stated project outputs and outcomes, and the supporting data is accurately reflected in the USDA Detailed Project Reporting (DPR) spreadsheet and other reporting mechanisms.

• Contributing to monitoring and evaluation by reviewing and approving assigned producer and partner information and documentation. ·

• Contributing to outreach, by writing content, giving presentations, or participating in other aways to highlight activities, important relationships, and impacts of the project.

Leadership and Representation ·

• Traveling to field sites to assist team members and partners with technical and operational management and implementation.

• Contributing substantially to Winrock’s reporting to USDA.

• Managing partner relationships, including sub-awardees, to ensure they are positive and productive and compliant with USDA rules and regulations and reporting requirements.

• Contributing to new business development efforts

• Potential supervision of staff

The Program Manager is a motivated candidate who is talented at multitasking in a fast-paced nonprofit environment. This individual should have the focus to handle many complex, evolving responsibilities with a high degree of autonomy, accountability, and attention to detail. This includes engaging in relationships with a range of stakeholders and partners in the domestic agriculture sector. Experience with large U.S. agriculture and supply chain projects is preferred.

EXPERIENCE/EDUCATION

• Demonstrated Work Experience o Must have a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience.

• Demonstrates technical knowledge of relevant thematic topics and thought leadership in a relevant subject area (e.g conservation agriculture, rice value chain, agriculture premiums or incentives).

• Experience with federal government awards - ideally experience with USDA projects focused on U.S. agriculture systems

• Experience working with U.S. farmer groups

• A demonstrated knowledge of NRCS practices

· Education

• A minimum of a bachelor’s degree is required or combination of relevant experience and education.

· Technical/Computer Skills

• Effective use of Microsoft Office and other technologies essential to doing business.

• Demonstrated skills in project management to achieve targets within scope, budget, and on time.

• Excellent written and oral communication skills for project management, donor and partner relations, and new business development.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, AI Product Manager, Finance
jobs.description:
AbbVie is seeking a strategic and execution-oriented Senior Manager, AI Product Management, Finance to own the strategy, performance, governance, and value realization of a major portfolio of AI-enabled products for Finance.

This leader will serve as the accountable product and strategy bridge between business sponsors, AI engineering teams, data platforms, architecture, governance, risk, compliance, and change management functions. The role establishes portfolio direction, translates business needs into executable product strategies and roadmaps, and ensures AI products deliver measurable outcomes across large programs, multiple stakeholder groups, and enterprise priorities.

The ideal candidate combines advanced product management expertise with practical understanding of artificial intelligence, analytics, digital transformation, financial value creation, governance, organizational change, and talent development. Success requires leading through influence, resolving ambiguous enterprise-level problems, balancing innovation with compliance, and building scalable operating mechanisms that advance AbbVie’s long-term business strategy.

Responsibilities:

AI Product Strategy & Vision

• Set the product vision, strategy, standards, and multi-year roadmap for AI-enabled products and capabilities across the Finance Team
• Partner with Finance and BTS leaders to identify high-impact AI opportunities that improve performance, decision quality, risk reduction, and business outcomes.
• Establish portfolio objectives, success metrics, adoption targets, value realization measures, and executive-level performance reporting.
• Develop and govern business cases, investment priorities, funding tradeoffs, and resource allocation recommendations based on strategic alignment, financial impact, risk reduction, compliance, and operational benefit.

Product Ownership & Delivery

• Oversee the full product lifecycle across major programs and products, from opportunity framing through deployment, scaling, sustainment, and benefit realization.
• Translate business challenges into prioritized product backlogs and clear user requirements.
• Guide Product Owners, Product Managers, Agile delivery teams, and cross-functional partners to ensure roadmaps, backlogs, releases, and adoption plans remain aligned with enterprise priorities.
• Drive roadmap execution across AI Engineering, Data Engineering, Architecture, UX, and business teams.
• Manage portfolio scope, priorities, dependencies, risks, budget implications, and tradeoffs across multiple teams and business areas.

Business Partnership & Stakeholder Management

• Build trusted relationships with leaders and key stakeholders across AbbVie.
• Facilitate alignment on priorities, outcomes, funding, and adoption strategies.
• Communicate product vision, roadmap progress, value realization, tradeoffs, risks, and decision needs clearly and persuasively to senior and executive leadership.
• Lead prioritization forums, governance bodies, steering discussions, and cross-functional decision forums that align stakeholders around high-visibility AI investments.

AI Adoption & Value Realization

• Measure product success through adoption, engagement, business outcomes, productivity gains, and financial impact.
• Partner with change management and training teams to accelerate adoption.
• Ensure products solve real user problems and drive sustainable behavior change.
• Track KPIs and continuously refine products using user insights and operational metrics.

Responsible AI & Governance

• Own AI product governance expectations for the portfolio, ensuring alignment with AbbVie policies, compliance requirements, privacy standards, quality expectations, data security, risk controls, and Responsible AI principles.
• Partner with Legal, Compliance, Security, Quality, Privacy, Architecture, and Risk teams to establish controls, mitigate risks, support audit readiness, and respond to issues throughout the product lifecycle.
• Sponsor transparency, explainability, human oversight, model risk mitigation, documentation rigor, and scalable governance practices for AI-enabled solutions.

Product Management Excellence

• Establish and scale AI product management with best practices, frameworks, and tooling.
• Develop Product Managers, Product Analysts, business product owners, and emerging leaders through coaching, mentoring, capability building, and clear product management standards.
• Contribute to the development of a product-centric operating model for Data & AI
• Promote experimentation, customer-centricity, and evidence-based decision making.

Required:

• Bachelor's Degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or related fields plus 8 years’ experience; OR Master’s Degree plus 7 years’ experience; OR PhD plus 3 years’ experience
• Respective years of experience in product management, technology strategy, digital transformation, analytics, program leadership, or related disciplines, with demonstrated ownership of large programs, portfolios, or critical business capabilities.
• 3+ years leading AI, machine learning, analytics, automation, or digital products
• Enterprise AI product strategy: Ability to define a compelling product vision, multi-year roadmap, portfolio standards, investment priorities, and measurable outcomes aligned with business strategy.
• End-to-end product and portfolio leadership: Proven ability to lead complex AI products from opportunity framing through delivery, scaling, sustainment, adoption, and benefit realization across multiple teams and dependencies.
• Business and executive partnership: Strong business acumen and influence skills to align senior leaders on priorities, funding, tradeoffs, risks, decisions, and adoption without relying on direct authority.
• AI, data, and delivery fluency: Practical understanding of AI, machine learning, analytics, data platforms, architecture, user experience, and Agile delivery sufficient to translate business needs into executable product strategies, roadmaps, and backlogs.
• Value realization and adoption: Ability to build business cases, establish KPIs, quantify financial and operational impact, use customer insights, and drive sustained adoption and behavior change.
• Responsible AI and governance: Demonstrated capability to embed privacy, security, quality, compliance, model risk, human oversight, documentation, and audit-readiness throughout the AI product lifecycle.
• Operating model and talent development: Experience establishing scalable product management practices and coaching Product Managers, Product Owners, analysts, and cross-functional teams to improve product discipline and delivery performance.
• Experience setting strategy, managing portfolio-level priorities, influencing cross-functional leaders, and communicating recommendations, risks, and tradeoffs to senior leadership.
• Demonstrated experience managing product roadmaps and Agile delivery teams.
• Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills
• Proven ability to influence across organizational boundaries without direct authority.
• Demonstrated ability to manage compliance, risk, governance, audit-readiness, and documentation expectations for technology-enabled products or programs.
• Experience building business cases and measuring value realization.

Preferred:

• Experience in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, life sciences, manufacturing, or supply chain environments with a focus on Finance
• Familiarity with Generative AI, machine learning, data platforms, LLMs, AI governance, and MLOps concepts
• Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, Productboard, or similar product management tools
• MBA or advanced technical degree

jobs.title: Vacation Rental Advisor (Inside Sales)
jobs.description:
At Evolve, we’re on a mission to make vacation rental easy for everyone. Our high-performing, customer-obsessed team runs on curiosity, communication, and accountability—working together to create exceptional experiences for our owners and guests. Whether solving big challenges, delivering outstanding results, or celebrating wins, we approach every day with purpose and passion. If you’re ready to join a mission-driven company where every teammate has the opportunity to thrive, Evolve might just be the place for you.

Why this role

We are looking for a sales professional with a proven track record of high achievement in a quota-driven, consultative sales environment. The goal of this role is to sell prospective owners on becoming an Evolve Partner by listing their property through our network. All of our leads come to us; no more prospecting leads! As a Vacation Rental Advisor (Inside Sales Rep), you play a key role in accelerating our rapidly growing business by helping homeowners evaluate our services and commit to a fruitful partnership, managing their properties.

Our Vacation Rental Advisors act like consultants, providing detailed insight into the market, the industry, and our services while paying close attention to the homeowner’s needs. If we identify a great fit, you’ll lead the owner through the sign-up process and prepare them for their Evolve partnership. You’re the right candidate if you’re eager to jump into an energetic sales environment, want to learn all about the vacation rental business, and want to help build the most trusted hospitality brand in vacation rentals.

What you’ll do

• Qualify a pipeline of highly qualified marketing-generated leads

• Provide a consultative, end-to-end selling experience for homeowners from warm, inbound inquiries

• Hit or exceed daily/weekly/monthly productivity expectations (average of 30-50 contacts per day)

• Guide homeowners towards choosing Evolve and manage an active sales pipeline

• Handle objections and help homeowners have a clear understanding of our value, services, and policies

• Manage sales activities within our CRM platform (Salesforce) and Sales Engagement Tool (Salesloft)

• Participate in regular training and skill sessions

• Collaborate closely with other peers to optimize sales strategies and elevate performance

What makes you a great fit

• 3+ years of inside sales experience required

• Proven phone-based selling success is a plus

• Able to effectively manage a sales pipeline and drive lead conversion

• Adaptable and flexible in a rapidly changing environment

• Professional verbal and written communication skills

• Organized and detail-oriented

• Able to effectively manage time and determine priorities

• A goal-oriented, competitive mentality

• Strong work ethic

• Must be available to work Monday-Friday with flexibility to work Mountain Standard Time Zone

Compensation

For this role, compensation is based on a base pay plus commission model. Our base pay is $55,000 annually, based on a 40-hour work week ($26.44/hr). This role is eligible to earn an uncapped monthly commission with total on-target earnings of $118,000 annually based on individual performance.

Location

jobs.title: Clean Transportation Intern - Remote, US
jobs.description:
Interested in joining a growing company where you will work with talented colleagues, enhance a supportive and energetic culture, and be part of the climate solution? At Energy Solutions, we focus on the big impacts. And we believe that market-based programs can be a powerful force to deliver large-scale energy, carbon, and water-use savings. Since 1995, we’ve harnessed that power to offer proven, performance-based solutions for our utility, government, and institutional customers.

Does data and eco-friendly transportation drive you... sometimes literally? Are you excited about the economic and mathematic side of real-world incentive programs? The Clean Transportation Intern will have great opportunities for a numbers-oriented student looking to gain practical program insights and experience.

In this full-time (~40 hours/week) role, you will create a GIS—that's Geographic Information Systems—map which illustrates the combined impacts of our clean transportation incentive programs. The goal is to map our existing dealership relationships in proximity to customers, display the GHG emissions reductions for transitioning to zero carbon transportation modes, and develop a white paper comparing program trends to state and local policy goals.

To complement this project, you will deep-dive peer-reviewed studies to build an analysis on the impacts of incentives on vehicle purchases. You’ll gain a deep understanding of complex programs by speaking with program managers and using program data to test theories, forecast economic behavior, measure economic relationships, and model the impact of our incentives against a base case.

This experience will grant you:

• Hands-on practice using data modeling and visualization tools

• Knowledge of the CA transportation electrification landscape

• Daily collaboration with team members to support and understand program design decisions

Your work will result in:

• Measurable data on program impacts that can be shared with clients and support business development activities

• Informative project deliverables that may help shape program design decisions

To enable you for success, we are seeking candidates with these qualifications:

• Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills

• Skill in Python and/or R

• Currently enrolled or previously completed coursework in an economics or mathematics program

• Strong research, writing, and analytical skills

While not required, we love to see candidates with:

• An interest in renewable energy, clean transportation, and/or incentive program design

• Experience with ArcGIS or a similar tool

Compensation:

• Undergraduate student: $21/hr

• Graduate student: $24/hr

In order to be eligible for this position, you must be:

• Currently enrolled full- or part-time in an undergraduate program as a second to fourth-year student or enrolled in a graduate program Please note we are unable to accept applications from first-year undergraduate students or recent graduates who are not enrolled in a program

• A US Citizen or permanent resident Please note we are unable to host international students

• Available to meet your weekly hours requirement between May and August for Summer and between September and November for Fall

• Motivated by the Energy Solutions’ mission to reduce carbon emissions with an equity lens

You may apply to up to 2 positions per cycle.

To apply, please submit:

• 2 short essays that meets the criteria below.

• A work sample that meets the criteria below.

Your short essays must:

• Be original documents written by you. We will not accept work written by or with the assistance of ChatGPT or other AI/chatbot programs.

• Be 500 words or less each.

• Answer the following prompts: Describe how you have overcome adversity and applied the lessons learned to your academic, professional, or personal life. Describe how the internship you apply for will enhance or help launch your career in an energy related industry.

Your work sample must:

• Be an original document written by you. We will not accept work written by or with the assistance of ChatGPT or other AI/chatbot programs. You are permitted to submit a section of a larger document, including a document you wrote in collaboration with others, so long as the section you submit is entirely your own work.
