• Demonstrate your ability to communicate your thinking about an idea. This is vague by design; anything that you wrote—whether for a class, a job, or for personal reasons—and are proud of will probably suffice.

About Tenex.AI http://Tenex.AI

Regional Sales Director

Company Overview

TENEX is an AI-native, automation-first, built-for-scale Managed Detection and Response (MDR) provider. We are a force multiplier for defenders, helping organizations enhance their cybersecurity posture through advanced threat detection, rapid response, and continuous protection. Our team is composed of industry experts with deep experience in cybersecurity, automation and AI-driven solutions. Backed by leading investors, we are rapidly growing and seeking top talent to join our mission of revolutionizing the AI-Native MDR landscape.

We're a fast growing startup backed by industry experts and top tier investors led by Crosspoint Capital Partners and also backed by Shield Capital, DTCP (formerly Deutsche Telekom Capital Partners), Deepwork Capital, and the Florida Opportunity Fund. Seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). As an early employee, you'll play a meaningful role in defining and building our culture. Get in on the ground floor. The Profile of a Regional Sales Director

As a Regional Sales Director at Tenex, you will be responsible for driving revenue growth by identifying, engaging, and closing new business opportunities. You will play a crucial role in expanding our customer base and helping organizations strengthen their cybersecurity defenses with Tenex’s cutting-edge MDR solutions. As a player-coach, you will also lead a pod of Enterprise Sales Directors, coaching them, owning their forecast, and making deal decisions so the team moves faster while you carry your own quota.

 - A professional who wants to gain valuable experience in a startup environment, working alongside a team of deeply passionate security professionals with a desire to make a real impact in the industry.

 - A professional who is genuinely committed to improving the information security posture of companies through delivery of cutting edge AI MDR solutions.

 - A professional that will possess the aptitude to communicate effectively with both business and technical stakeholders regarding the specifics of the TENEX offerings is essential. While an engineering background is not a prerequisite, a comprehensive understanding of the solutions is necessary.

 - A professional that leads with humility but carries a set of professional values and gravitas that challenges the status quo of client environments.

 - A professional that conveys empathy and has a desire to give good the advantage.

What You Will Do

 - Sell. Carry a quota and keep your own pipeline creation at or above 90% of baseline.

 - Lead the pod. Act as manager of record for your ESDs: approve, escalate, and decide on deals so they no longer wait on the CRO.

 - Coach. Run a weekly 1:1 with every ESD and deliver at least 90% of scheduled coaching sessions.

 - Forecast. Own the pod pipeline review and the roll-up forecast. Report personal and pod pipeline separately.

 - Support deals, not take them. Join reps' opportunities as the secondary. The rep stays the owner.

 - Co-sell with partners. Work with the Cloud Security Specialist, Google Cloud Security, and Wiz field teams to build pod pipeline.

 - Keep ownership clean. Resolve account-ownership disputes with RevOps inside five days.

 - Build the team. Onboard new ESDs and help hire open pod seats, including the future BDR.

What You Bring

 - 8+ years of enterprise B2B sales, with a consistent record of attaining a $1M+ ARR quota.

 - Experience selling security: MDR, SOC, SIEM, or cloud security (CNAPP).

 - Frontline leadership or player-coach experience: coaching, forecasting, and deal inspection for a small team.

 - Co-selling with hyperscalers and partners, ideally Google Cloud Security and Wiz.

 - Comfort running a full personal cycle while managing a team's pipeline in the same week.

 - Clear written forecasting and a habit of making decisions instead of escalating them.

Education & Certifications

 - Bachelor’s degree in Business, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

 - Sales certifications such as MEDDIC, Challenger Sales, or Sandler Training are a plus.

Why Join Us?

 - Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI-driven cybersecurity technologies and Google SecOps solutions.

 - Collaborate with a talented and innovative team focused on continuously improving security operations.

 - Competitive salary and benefits package.

 - A culture of growth and development, with opportunities to expand your knowledge in AI, cybersecurity, and emerging technologies.

If you're passionate about combining cybersecurity expertise with artificial intelligence and have experience with Google SecOps and Chronicle, we encourage you to apply!

Position Summary

This role centers on generating new business opportunities with dealerships in the Powersports industry. You will be responsible for identifying, pursuing, and securing new business with dealers. A significant portion of your time will be dedicated to prospecting in the United States sales territory.

This position requires a strategic focus on building relationships, engaging with dealers, and closing sales.

Territory Planning & Business Development

Cross-Functional Collaboration, Market Intelligence & Reporting

• Maintain and report sales metrics to leadership, ensuring that data within our Sales Automation and Customer Relationship Management tool, Salesforce, is current and accurate.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Engagement Operations
jobs.description:
About Chamber

Cardiovascular disease remains America’s leading cause of death. Chamber is rebuilding cardiology around outcomes, not volume, partnering with independent cardiologists to lead population health through technology, data, and operational tools that turn complex insights into better patient care.

Our model combines clinical expertise, thoughtful design, and a modern operating platform for physicians, patients, and payers. By pairing cutting-edge AI with a relentless focus on human care, we aim to transform heart health at scale.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a Sr. Manager, Engagement Operations to build Chamber’s member journey systems from the ground up. Reporting to the Director of Member Engagement, you’ll design and launch the CRM, lifecycle infrastructure, campaign flows, and automations, partnering with Data to ensure everything is measured.

In this zero-to-one builder role, you’ll work cross-functionally to turn member journey strategy into scalable flows and automations.

This role is central to Chamber’s long-term success: building workflows, automations, and campaigns that optimize the funnel and Outreach team productivity as we scale.

Key Responsibilities

Member Journey & Lifecycle Strategy

 - Map and refine the end-to-end member journey — activation, engagement, and retention — ensuring every touchpoint is timely, relevant, and on-brand.

 - Build and maintain multi-channel lifecycle campaigns across email, SMS, phone and print that drive activation, retention, and longitudinal care.

 - Partner with the Director of Member Engagement to translate journey strategy into segmented, triggered, and always-on campaigns.

 - Optimize campaigns through ongoing gap analysis of messaging, timing, and channel mix.

 - Identify lead journey gaps and drop-offs, then deploy targeted interventions to close them.

 - Execute A/B tests and drive continuous experimentation across campaigns and channels.

 - Support copy, design, and QA for member-facing materials to ensure accuracy, brand consistency, and polish before each send.

CRM & Marketing Operations

 - Own and architect HubSpot from the ground up, including workflows, automations, segmentation, data hygiene, and permissions.

 - Build Chamber’s first scalable campaign build and QA processes to ensure every send is accurate, deliverable, and error-free at scale.

 - Partner with the Associate Director, Data Analyst on engagement reporting so campaigns reflect real operations and can be tracked accurately across channels.

 - Own SMS send operations — carrier registration (10DLC/toll-free verification), opt-in/opt-out compliance, and message throughput and deliverability.

 - Secure and manage toll-free (800#) numbers for member-facing SMS and voice, including provisioning, verification, and carrier registration.

 - Manage engagement operations across email, SMS, Agentic AI, print, and other vendors.

Vendor & Partner Management

 - Own third-party engagement partnerships — including freelance design artists, agency work, and print vendors — managing scope, timelines, and deliverable quality.

 - Serve as the internal contact for vendor performance, troubleshooting, invoicing, and issue of escalation.

 - Support the evaluation and eventual centralization of vendor relationships as Chamber’s engagement operations scale.

What You’ll Achieve in Your First 90 Days

 - Become fluent in Chamber’s HubSpot instance, active journeys, and vendor relationships, documenting what exists and what does not.

 - Establish Chamber’s first operating standards for campaign QA, data hygiene, and vendor management as the baseline for scale.

 - Architect and launch at least one full lifecycle journey end-to-end, from CRM workflow to measurable, trackable output.

 - Present an update to leadership on early engagement metrics, journey performance, and a roadmap for scaling automation and vendor relationships.

Requirements

 - 10+ years in lifecycle marketing, CRM/marketing operations, or member/customer engagement, ideally building programs from scratch at an early-stage company.

 - Experience in Healthcare or value-based care environments is strongly preferred.

 - Strong hands-on expertise in architecting workflows, campaigns, integrations, and data governance from scratch.

 - Experience with marketing automation platforms such as HubSpot, Braze, Iterable, or Customer.io http://Customer.io a plus.

 - Experience managing external vendors or agencies, ideally including print or direct mail production.

 - Proven experience executing automated, multi-channel campaigns and workflows across SMS, email, direct mail, and related channels.

 - Working knowledge of email deliverability fundamentals — authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), list hygiene, and spam complaint management.

 - Familiarity with SMS compliance and deliverability requirements (10DLC/toll-free registration, TCPA, opt-in/opt-out management).

 - Analytical thinkers who use data to decide, troubleshoot, and measure campaign impact.

 - Strong communicator and collaborator who aligns Care Teams, Product, Network Operations, and external partners around shared goals.

 - Comfortable navigating ambiguity, solving problems in real time, and wearing multiple hats in a fast-moving environment.

jobs.title: Cultivation Associate - Harvest
jobs.description:
At Curaleaf, we’re redefining the cannabis industry with a strong commitment to quality, expertise, and innovation. As a leading global cannabis provider, our brands—including Curaleaf, Select, and Grassroots—offer premium products and services in both medical and adult-use markets.

Join us at Curaleaf to be part of a high-growth, purpose-driven company that champions corporate social responsibility through our Rooted in Good initiative, supporting community outreach and positive change. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, drive innovation, and help shape the future of cannabis.

Title: Cultivation Associate
Pay Rate: $18.50/hr
Location: Ravena, NY
Job Type: Full Time | Non-Exempt
Shift: Monday - Friday | 7am - 3:30pm

Who You Are:
You’re excited to build a well-rounded skill set in cannabis cultivation and eager to learn every aspect of the garden. With training and guidance, you’ll gain hands-on experience across the entire production cycle, including plant care, environmental monitoring, harvesting, and more. You bring curiosity, reliability, and a team-focused mindset, making you a key part of a cultivation operation that thrives on shared knowledge and cross-training.

What You’ll Do:

As a Cultivation Associate at Curaleaf, you’ll be cross-trained to support the full plant life cycle, from clone to harvest, helping to grow premium cannabis while maintaining top-quality standards. Your day-to-day will include:

• Performing daily plant care such as cutting, rooting, transplanting, watering, feeding, trimming, staking, and pruning to keep plants healthy

• Tracking humidity, moisture, and temperature to maintain ideal growing conditions and meet quality goals

• Inspecting plants for leaf health, bloom size, pests, or disease and removing any that don’t meet standards

• Assisting with harvest by cutting plants, trimming, removing flowering tops, weighing products, and recording inventory in the electronic tracking system

• Supporting the curing process by hanging and dry-racking flowers, monitoring climate conditions, labeling and weighing products, and entering inventory data

• Operating and maintaining lighting, irrigation, and climate-control systems while stocking supplies and keeping all cultivation areas and tools clean and sanitized

• Pitching in during high-demand periods to help prepare and package products, including premium extraction items

• Following state regulations and security procedures by accurately labeling plants and entering inventory information

What You’ll Bring:

• You have a natural green thumb and a genuine passion for working with plants, with experience harvesting in a professional or home setting (gardening counts!)

• You thrive in a fast-paced, team environment, collaborating with others while fostering a positive and professional atmosphere

• You bring sharp attention to detail, ensuring quality and consistency in every task

• You are reliable and detail-oriented, with strong documentation, inventory, and organizational skills that help you stay on top of a tight schedule

• You have solid math and measurement skills and the ability to operate a scale with confidence

• You have a high school diploma, GED, or equivalent

Even Better If:

• You bring knowledge of growing technologies such as lighting, irrigation, soil, and nutrients, along with hands-on experience in landscaping, horticulture, or agriculture

• You understand different cannabis strains and their unique growing needs

Physical Requirements

• Ability to stand, sit, and walk for extended periods of time (8-10 hours per shift)

• Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds regularly and occasional lifting of heavier items with assistance

• Frequent and repetitive use of hands and wrists for extended periods of time

• Repetitive bending, squatting, and reaching

• Ability to climb ladders or step stools to access plants or equipment

• Ability to use required PPE when required, such as masks, hair nets, beard covers, respirators, boot covers, scrubs, non-slip shoes, and Tyvek suits as necessary

Environmental Conditions

• Exposure to environments with high humidity, varying temperatures, and strong odors (such as cannabis)

• Exposure to soil, water, fertilizer, dust, pollen and plant pathogens

• Exposure to cleaning solvents, such as high volumes of isopropyl alcohol

• Exposure to loud noises, including but not limited to air compressors, packaging equipment, and alarms

• Exposure to CO2 manufacturing procedures at OSHA approved CO2 levels

$18.50—$18.50 USD

• Career Growth Opportunities

• Competitive Pay and Benefits

• Generous PTO and Parental Leave

• 401(K) Retirement Plan

• Life/ Disability Insurance

• Community Involvement

• Referral Bonuses and Product Discounts

Benefits vary by state, role type, and eligibility.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager II, SMB -Account Strategy
jobs.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

A day in the life

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) II, SMB – Account Strategy role sits at the heart of  Toast's customer retention strategy. This team engages directly with customers in real-time to understand their needs, demonstrate the value of the Toast platform, and ensure every customer has the opportunity to thrive with Toast.

In this highly visible role, you will lead consultative retention conversations, navigate contract and pricing discussions, and leverage Toast's product suite to help restaurants find every reason to continue growing with Toast. This is a high-volume, inbound and outbound engagement position that requires strict adherence to service levels, a strong phone presence, and the ability to handle complex conversations with confidence and empathy.

Account Strategy CSMs partner closely with cross-functional teams and senior leadership, operating in a focused, data-driven motion with clear success metrics tied to retention, customer outcomes, and long-term growth on Toast.

What you'll do (Responsibilities)

• Staff a dedicated high-volume Account Strategy phone and chat line with adherence to service levels and schedule, engaging customers in real-time to understand their needs and ensure they are set up for long-term success on Toast

• Lead consultative, value-based retention conversations tailored to each customer's unique business and tech stack, helping them realize the full potential of the Toast platform

• Navigate complex customer conversations with professionalism, empathy, and confidence — including objection handling, competitive discussions, and contract and pricing negotiations

• Diagnose customer needs quickly and identify the best path forward to help each customer continue to grow and succeed with Toast

• Accurately document interactions, outcomes, and customer feedback with strong attention to data hygiene, case management, and reporting

• Leverage data, account insights, and internal tools to inform retention strategies and real-time decision-making

• Act as the voice of the customer, surfacing insights and competitive trends to internal partners and leadership to continuously improve the customer experience

• Operate in a focused, repeatable motion designed to work at scale while delivering exceptional, personalized customer experiences

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Product, and Finance to drive customer outcomes and support escalation paths

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

• 2+ years of Account Management, Customer Success, or retention-focused experience with a track record of driving positive customer outcomes

• Experience working in high-volume, queue- or case-based environments with adherence to service levels and strong prioritization in real time

• Comfort navigating high-stakes, complex customer conversations with confidence and professionalism

• Strong objection handling, negotiation, and influencing skills, especially in live customer conversations

• Proven ability to operate independently while handling competing priorities in a fast-paced, changing environment

• Data-driven mindset with the ability to interpret account insights and apply them in real-time decision-making

• Strong phone presence with excellent communication, presentation, and written skills

• Self-starter with the ability to quickly assess complex scenarios and drive toward resolution

What will help you stand out (Non-essential Skills/Nice to Haves)

• Experience in account management, customer care, or churn prevention roles

• Payments or credit card processing knowledge

• Experience working in SaaS or tech environments

• Familiarity with Salesforce, Five9, Hex, ChiliPiper, G-Suite, and Slack

• Hospitality experience

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

#LI-DNP

The base salary range for this role is listed below. The starting salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, our total rewards components include cash compensation (overtime, bonus/commissions if eligible), equity, and benefits. You can learn more about how we align pay with local labor markets in our Geographic Pay Zone Philosophy.

Zone A

$80,000—$90,000 USD

Zone B

$75,000—$85,000 USD

Zone C

$70,000—$80,000 USD

How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

jobs.title: Laboratory Automation & Robotics Engineer - Pharmaceuticals
jobs.description:
Position Summary:

The Automation Engineer will lead the implementation, validation, integration, and ongoing optimization of laboratory automation solutions supporting regulated research and development environments. This role is responsible for designing and deploying robotic workflows, liquid handling systems, laboratory instrumentation integrations, and data management solutions that enable scalable, efficient, and compliant laboratory operations.

Working closely with scientists, laboratory operations teams, IT partners, and automation stakeholders, the Automation Engineer will drive automation initiatives from discovery and system assessment through deployment, validation, performance optimization, and long-term lifecycle support. The role will play a key part in advancing laboratory digitalization, increasing throughput, improving data integrity, and enhancing operational reliability.

Key Responsibilities:

Laboratory Automation & Robotics

• Assess existing automation environments, including robotics platforms, liquid handling systems, and laboratory workflows.
• Design, develop, configure, and deploy automated laboratory workflows.
• Program and optimize robotic and liquid handling systems to meet scientific and operational requirements.
• Implement automation strategies that improve process efficiency, reproducibility, and scalability.
• Develop and execute automation roadmaps aligned with business priorities.

System Integration

• Integrate robotic platforms with laboratory instruments, software applications, scheduling systems, and LIMS environments.
• Design and implement data flow architectures that support seamless interoperability across laboratory systems.
• Ensure automation outputs are appropriately integrated with downstream analytics and reporting platforms.
• Partner with IT and laboratory stakeholders to enable secure, reliable system connectivity.

Validation & Compliance

• Execute validation and qualification activities, including IQ/OQ/PQ protocols and documentation.
• Develop and maintain validation lifecycle documentation.
• Support regulatory compliance requirements and audit readiness initiatives.
• Ensure automated systems meet quality, validation, and data integrity standards.
• Participate in inspection readiness and compliance reviews.

Performance Optimization & Reliability Engineering

• Perform system troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and performance tuning.
• Monitor automation performance and establish KPIs to ensure sustained operational excellence.
• Identify workflow bottlenecks and implement solutions that improve throughput and reduce downtime.
• Develop preventative maintenance strategies and reliability programs.
• Lead continuous improvement initiatives utilizing Lean, RCA, and CAPA methodologies.

Documentation & Knowledge Management

• Author SOPs, technical specifications, validation documentation, and engineering records.
• Develop training materials and support knowledge transfer activities.
• Maintain comprehensive automation system documentation throughout the lifecycle of deployed solutions.
• Provide technical mentorship and training to laboratory and operational staff.

Basic Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Automation, Robotics, Computer Science, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or related technical discipline.
• Demonstrated experience supporting laboratory automation, robotics, or automated instrumentation platforms.
• Experience supporting pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, or regulated laboratory environments.
• Experience programming, configuring, and troubleshooting robotic and liquid handling systems.
• Knowledge of laboratory systems integration and data management workflows.
• Experience executing validation activities in regulated environments, including IQ/OQ/PQ.
• Strong technical problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
• Ability to work effectively across scientific, engineering, quality, and IT organizations.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Familiarity with LIMS, laboratory scheduling systems, data capture platforms, and analytics tools.
• Knowledge of data integrity, laboratory compliance, and quality system requirements.
• Experience implementing continuous improvement, Lean Six Sigma, RCA, or CAPA methodologies.
• Experience with cross-platform laboratory automation integration.
• Exposure to audit readiness and regulatory inspection support activities.

This role is a full-time, permanent position Monday-Friday 1st Shift. Candidates currently located within commutable distance to West Point, PA are encouraged to apply.

Excellent full-time benefits include:

• Comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options
• Life and disability insurance
• 401(k) with company match
• Paid vacation and holidays
• Eligibility for yearly goal-based bonus & merit-based increases

jobs.title: Supervisor on Duty
jobs.location: War Memorial/Baptist Health IcePlex, Fort Lauderdale, FL
jobs.description:
Organization Overview:

The Florida Panthers are in their 33rd season in 2026-27 as one of the National Hockey League's premier franchises. As back-to-back Stanley Cup Champions in 2024 and 2025, the Panthers have won 11 of their past 12 postseason series and captured four Eastern Conference Championships. The organization is led by President of Hockey Operations & General Manager Bill Zito, entering his seventh season, and President of Business Operations Michael White, beginning his first full season.

Anchored by a championship culture on the ice, the Panthers are equally committed to building a world-class sports and entertainment platform off of it. The organization focuses on delivering an elite guest experience across all venues, deepening the connection between the team and the South Florida community and continuing to grow the sport for the next generation. The Panthers operate four facilities in Broward County: Amerant Bank Arena in Sunrise which is home of Panthers home games, concerts and events, Panthers IceDen in Coral Springs, the state-of-the-art Baptist Health IcePlex in Fort Lauderdale and renovated War Memorial Auditorium which hosts concerts and events year-round.

The Panthers are owned by Vincent J. Viola, a graduate of the United States Military Academy at West Point and a veteran of the U.S. Army. That foundation of selfless service shapes the organization's identity at every level. The Panthers' pillar program, "Heroes Among Us," honors a U.S. military veteran at every home game, and the Florida Panthers Foundation directs its efforts across four core pillars: veterans' affairs, children's health and education, raising awareness for the endangered Florida Panther and growing youth hockey throughout the region. The organization remains deeply committed to empowering and strengthening the diverse communities of South Florida and the tri-county area.

Job Title: Supervisor on Duty
Department: Baptist Health Iceplex - Guest Services
Reports To: Front Desk Manager
FLSA: Non-Exempt
Employment Type: Part-Time
Location: Baptist Health Iceplex

Organization Overview

The Florida Panthers are a community focused organization led by an authentic management team that served our country and now serves the South Florida community. Led by General Manager Bill Zito, the Panthers are coming off their best season in franchise history, culminating in a Stanley Cup Championship. Off the ice, the business is experiencing growth across all key metrics and our revenue is at an all-time high. The organization has grown its footprint via the renovation and expansion of the FTL War Memorial complex in downtown Fort Lauderdale. This state-of-the-art facility features two regulation-size rinks, including a new team practice rink with stadium seating, and a 3400-capacity music theatre for live entertainment. The future is bright, and we are very proud of what we are building in South Florida.

Job Summary

The Supervisor on Duty provides front line supervision of the guest experience journey throughout the building during each scheduled shift, including employee oversight and customer interface. The Supervisor on Duty maintains a strong service orientation in dealing with customers to provide accurate information and receive timely feedback. This position is available to staff members to attend to immediate issues as they arise and communicates as appropriate with Baptist Health IcePlex management team members.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Oversees the general operation of the Baptist Health IcePlex during each shift, by regularly walking the building, observing conditions, communicating with customers and employees, and ensuring operations are maintained at a consistently high level of customer service and impressions.

• Oversees and supports all front desk operations, including supervision and direction of front desk attendants, interacting with customers, facilitating registrations, and answering and routing incoming phone calls.

• Oversees all public sessions, including supervision and direction of the skate guard staff and equipment, and ensuring a safe and fun experience for all guests.

• In the absence of a staff member from the presenting department, supervises drop-in activities such as freestyles, stick and puck sessions and pick up hockey games to ensure all participants are registered and paid, and all general rink rules are followed.

• Completes incident reports, engaging Security and informing Baptist Health IcePlex management team members as appropriate.

• Handles customer complaints, including appropriate routing and follow up to ensure the complaint has been adequately addressed. Utilizes Task Manager in point-of-sale communications where applicable.

• Assists in providing locker rooms (keys for keys) and making sure each locker room is clean and orderly before returning exchanging keys back.

• Knows how to turn on/off music over the ice surfaces and throughout arena.

• Debriefs with all staff on duty at the beginning of each shift and as each staff member comes on duty.

• Assists in observing any programming, operations, or security needs or concerns, and engages the appropriate department when necessary.

• Maintains a clean and organized front office. Restocks program flyers or business cards as needed and informs Front Desk Manager when any new orders are needed.

• Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Qualified candidates will have:

• Excellent customer service, communication and problem-solving skills.

• Strong detail orientation.

• Solid math and cash handling skills.

• Working knowledge of computers and software applications like the Microsoft suite. Experience with DaySmart or other ice arena specific software is a plus.

• Ability to handle a fast-paced environment with multiple demands at any given time.

• Ability to meet the physical demands of the job, including regular movement about the building, answering phones, creating reports, and other duties as described above.

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work

This is a part-time position. Must be able to work a flexible, irregular schedule as required, including early mornings, nights, weekends, and holidays to ensure proper oversight of events and activities scheduled in arena.

Work Environment

This position works in a professional ice hockey practice facility, where the noise level is generally high, crowd traffic is heavy, and temperatures are often cold; lights are bright or dark with occasional exposure to flashing lights.

At the Florida Panthers Hockey Club, Arena Operating Company, Panthers IceDen, Sanza Food Service, War Memorial Benefit Corporation, and FLA Team Shop, we strive to make every employee feel valued and respected for who they are and the unique contributions they make. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Amperesand is reinventing how the world powers its most critical systems.

We are facing a once-in-a-generation opportunity for infrastructure disruption. Electricity demand is skyrocketing, driven by AI factories, electric vehicles, and modern industrial growth. Energy supply is shifting to incorporate a more diverse mix of resources – including solar, gas, and batteries – at a massive scale.

And yet the power infrastructure behind our latest mega-projects hasn’t meaningfully changed in nearly 100 years. Supply chains for today’s infrastructure equipment can’t match the pace and sophistication of critical energy projects. Amperesand is building hardware and software that rewrites this broken power infrastructure playbook to support a new era of energy abundance.

We’ve built a new class of intelligent, software-defined power infrastructure products leveraging a decade of advanced medium voltage Solid State Transformer research that’s now ready for commercial deployment.

Our products and solutions go far beyond the capabilities of traditional electrical equipment. We make power systems that are faster to deploy, dramatically smaller and more efficient, and capable of supporting modern, dynamic energy needs for tomorrow’s most demanding energy consumers.

Scalable in-house advanced manufacturing capability is our foundation for meeting timeline and quality expectation to serve infrastructure customers around the world.

Amperesand is led by breakthrough energy hardware development veterans and funded by top tier investors who share our vision of building a category-defining energy technology company.

With hubs in San Francisco, Reno, and Singapore, our global team is laser focused on building foundational technology to solve the most pressing problems in power infrastructure at scale.

Join us in building the power foundation of the future!

About Amperesand

Amperesand is building next-generation power infrastructure systems for Data Centers, EV charging platforms, and future energy applications. Our systems combine advanced power electronics, embedded controls, and scalable energy architectures to rethink how power is converted, controlled, and deployed.

About the Role

At Amperesand, you will lead the design and development of a scalable, robust distributed test framework in Golang that automates test systems across our labs and manufacturing lines, accelerating prototype validation and ramping high-volume production. You'll own the technical direction of our test software, set engineering standards, and mentor the team. Your hardware background lets you design efficient, accurate test systems for our Solid State Transformer and integrate them with manufacturing systems.

What You'll Do

• Architect a highly scalable, modular test framework in Golang to test high-voltage power electronics, thermal systems, and more, spanning lab validation, regression testing, and production.

• Drive end-to-end test software development from design through deployment and post-deployment improvements, building in ease of validation and maintenance.

• Integrate test systems with MES and other databases to enable traceability and closed-loop feedback between test results and production.

• Innovate test system design by collaborating with electrical, mechanical, firmware, and manufacturing teams, and provide feedback to improve product quality.

• Lead and mentor the software team: establish development standards, foster a strong code review culture, and drive adoption across the team.

• Participate hands-on in test hardware bring-up, system debugging, and optimization to meet accuracy, cycle time, and throughput targets.

• Travel to facilities worldwide to collaborate with teams and deploy our solutions.

What You'll Bring

• BS or MS in Computer or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.

• 6+ years designing and building scalable software for distributed systems, with demonstrated technical leadership on complex projects.

• Deep expertise in system-level languages (Golang, Rust, C, C++, etc.) with excellent software fundamentals: architectural design, algorithms, data structures, modularity, and maintainability.

• Strong command of concurrency, asynchronous programming, and distributed systems to meet strict cycle-time requirements and maximize throughput.

• Experience ingesting high-volume data for real-time decision-making, and with both relational and non-relational databases.

• Strong hardware background: experience with electrical hardware, microcontrollers, and communication protocols (CAN, SPI, I2C, etc.), sufficient to design efficient, accurate test systems.

• Experience working with Linux.

• Proven ability to mentor engineers, build team depth, and drive adoption of engineering standards.

• Engaged, proactive, and positive in owning challenging work and taking accountability for team success.

Working Model

Employment Type:
• Full-time

Location:
San Francisco/Sunnyvale / Reno

Work Model:
• Onsite

Onsite Collaboration Rationale:
Given the highly collaborative and cross-functional nature of hardware, embedded systems, and product development, in-person partnership across engineering and product teams is critical to enabling rapid execution, technical alignment, and successful development outcomes.

Why Join Amperesand

• Work on next-generation power infrastructure systems • High ownership and visibility • Cross-functional collaboration • Opportunity to shape future products and infrastructure • Fast-moving startup environment

Candidate Confidentiality & Information Protection

As part of our commitment to protecting confidential and proprietary information, candidates should not disclose or provide Amperesand with any confidential, proprietary, or trade secret information belonging to a current or former employer or any other third party during the application or interview process.

Please do not submit or present employer-owned source code, schematics, designs, technical documentation, internal presentations, customer information, prototypes, or other confidential materials. Candidates should discuss their experience and accomplishments at an appropriate level and use only information and materials they are authorized to share.

Pay Disclosure & Benefits

Compensation will be determined based on experience, location, and other factors permitted by law.

The benefits outlined below apply exclusively to employees located in the United States.

• Competitive Salary + Incentive Stock Options

• Medical, vision, and dental benefits for employees and their dependents, effective from the start of hire

• Company paid Basic Life, AD&D, short-term and long-term disability insurance

• 401k retirement savings plan through Empower

• Employees receive paid time off (PTO), paid sick days, and paid company holidays

• Commuter Benefits

• 100% paid maternal leave (12 weeks) and paternal leave (6 weeks)

Singapore-based employees receive benefits in accordance with local government provisions.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Amperesand is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Amperesand is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

jobs.title: VP of Product
jobs.description:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 


WHAT WE DO 

Our core services—Maps, Search, and Navigation—serve as the foundational location infrastructure for the next generation of software, powering real-time spatial intelligence for millions of developers and leading AI platforms worldwide. We are revolutionizing how users interact with the physical world by equipping large language models, conversational agents, and consumer apps with advanced geographical reasoning. Today, our developer ecosystem builds everything from AI-powered location experiences and top-ranking mobile apps to advanced autonomous driving platforms across transportation, retail, and logistics.

While we continue to empower developers to build highly customized location awareness into their applications, Mapbox is continuously pioneering Location AI. We have launched innovations like MapGPT, our Location AI platform, and native Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations that bring context-aware spatial discovery and routing directly to AI agents. From partnering with AI leaders like OpenAI and Perplexity, to working with global automotive giants—including BMW, Toyota, and GM—Mapbox is embedding beautiful 3D maps, intuitive natural language search, and optimal navigation into the fabric of the AI era.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

As the VP of Product reporting directly to the CEO, you will oversee product teams across all Mapbox services to drive our strategic direction, product-market fit, and commercial adoption. This role entails both managing a complex, scaled product portfolio, and simultaneously driving zero-to-one initiatives to build and launch new lines of business. Operating in a rapidly evolving environment, you will partner closely with product managers, engineers, designers, and data scientists to deliver a best-in-class developer experience, pioneer AI-powered location features, and build robust merchant and business ecosystems.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Shape the Vision: Develop and communicate a clear product vision for our external-facing services in alignment with overall company goals. You will operate in "founder mode" by thinking highly entrepreneurially not just to ship features, but to actively build and scale the business.

 - Build for the Customer: Engage directly and effectively with customers, external industry leaders, developers, and key partners to understand their needs, gather feedback, and evangelize the product.

 - Grow the Merchant Ecosystem: Drive product strategies specifically designed for B2B2C environments, focusing on how we successfully onboard merchants, businesses, and rich external data sets onto our platform.

 - Collaborate: Partner with engineering leads to balance feature development with operational excellence and platform scalability. Work closely with marketing, sales, and customer success teams to optimize go-to-market strategies, product messaging, and client support.

 - Demonstrate Organizational Leadership: You understand the 10X difference between good and great product organizations. As our customer needs, technologies, and product strategy evolve, you will evolve our product organization with it while maintaining rigorous product management fundamentals. 




WHAT WE BELIEVE ARE IMPORTANT TRAITS FOR THIS ROLE

 - Product Leadership: 10+ years of leadership experience. Deep, proven background in building, scaling, and driving strategic initiatives in diverse organizational settings.

 - AI Transformation: Strong technical foundation in artificial intelligence, including experience developing, integrating, or scaling AI-powered features, and models such as MCP, agents, and toolkits.

 - B2B2C & Consumer Ecosystem Expertise: Strong preference for leaders who have built for large consumer or B2B2C ecosystems with a track record of successfully onboarding merchants and businesses onto platforms.

 - Zero-to-One Track Record: You operate with extreme agency as a business builder; a proven founder, a new service owner, or have bootstrapped a business from scratch.

 - Go-To-Market (GTM) Execution: Proven track record of developing and driving comprehensive GTM strategies. You know how to successfully align product, marketing, and sales teams to launch new capabilities, drive rapid adoption, and scale revenue across both developer platforms and consumer ecosystems.

 - Technical Expertise: Our teams and customers are technical and value technical depth and critical thinking. Prior experience in developer focused products, delivering APIs, SDKs, AI integrations, and/or iOS/Android Apps is critical.

 - Ownership & Execution: Own the technical product vision, lead the strategy, and work alongside engineering counterparts to guide the team in executing the plan. You treat failures as critical learning opportunities, actively seeking feedback and continuously adapting product strategy to evolving customer needs and market realities.

 - Customer Focus: You care deeply about your customers and their problems, and you work tirelessly to innovate on their behalf.

 - Data-driven Decisions: You believe in the value of data-informed decision-making and strive to measure things that are not straightforward but essential. You also have the right instincts to make speedy decisions in the absence of perfect & comprehensive data.

 - Strong written and vocal communication skills: You can talk and write about complex ideas concisely to a wide audience.

 - Operational Excellence: You drive a culture of quality and continuous improvement in your organization.

 - Hire & Elevate: Great leaders understand the importance of hiring the best talent and creating a culture where team members can learn & grow with the organization. You demonstrate investment in coaching and stretching peers across all levels




VALUABLE BUT NOT REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

 - Prior experience in Search, Maps, or Navigation.  While domain expertise is extremely valuable in this role and with our customers, at our core, we are individuals who are technical, customer-focused, genuinely curious, adaptive, and eager to transform customer experiences from what they are today.




WHAT WE VALUE

In addition to our core values https://www.mapbox.com/about/values/, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

 - We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

 - We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

 - We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

 - We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.




HOW WE SUPPORT YOU

 - Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable.

 - Comprehensive Healthcare: Private medical coverage for you and your dependents.

 - Family-First Support: Generous maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family.

 - Fertility & Family Building: Inclusive fertility support. Grow your family on your terms.

 - Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth.

 - Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents.

 - Rest & Recharge: Flexible paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies.

 - Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO.

 - Invest & Grow: Retirement plans with competitive matching.

Our annual base compensation for this role ranges from $X - $Y for most US locations and 5% to 10% higher for US locations with a higher cost of labor. Job level and actual compensation will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role), market demands, and specific work location. Please discuss your specific work location with your recruiter for more information.

jobs.title: Lead Business Technology Engineer
jobs.description:
Here at Appian, our values of Intensity and Excellence define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you’ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together.

Lead Business Technology Engineer

Location: McLean, VA | Work Model: On-site

Are you a technical leader ready to architect, optimize, and scale the mission-critical platforms powering a global pioneer in enterprise transformation? Move beyond daily maintenance to bridge strategic engineering gaps, guide cross-functional teams, and future-proof the complex software layers that enable our global workforce.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Appian Business Technology team is the strategic engine driving our internal corporate infrastructure forward. We design, optimize, and scale the enterprise systems that empower Appian employees globally, ensuring our internal operations mirror the high-performance capabilities of our market-leading technology and enable our corporate growth in the automation market.

THE OPPORTUNITY

This lead role is designed for an elite systems expert who thrives at the intersection of enterprise architecture, AI innovation, and stringent security compliance. At Appian, you will have the autonomy to direct the design and management of multiple complex Google Workspace (GWS) tenants. Including environments built to strict CMMC and FedRAMP requirements. You will pioneer the rollout of cutting-edge GWS AI tools and engineer seamless integrations across our tech stack, all while working face-to-face in a culture that champions collaboration and rapid technical innovation at our corporate headquarters.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Multi-Tenant Architecture: Design, configure, and manage multiple complex Google Workspace tenants, ensuring continuous alignment with FedRAMP and CMMC compliance standards.

• AI Integration & Management: Serve as the subject matter expert for GWS AI tools. Manage, support, and optimize our heavy leverage of embedded AI features (e.g., Gemini for Workspace) to drive workforce productivity and secure data handling.

• Innovation & Feature Rollouts: Stay on the cutting edge of Google Workspace capabilities. Architect the testing, piloting, and organization-wide deployment strategies for the newest features and platform updates before they hit production.

• Security Partnership: Work closely with Information Security and Network teams to implement robust zero-trust controls, data loss prevention (DLP) policies, and access management to mitigate risks across all GWS environments.

• Seamless Integrations: Architect and maintain advanced integrations between GWS and other core enterprise platforms, ensuring a frictionless, high-performance experience for end-users.

• Support & Management Plans: Develop and execute comprehensive platform management plans and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Serve as the Tier-3 escalation point for the most complex technical issues involving routing, policy conflicts, and advanced troubleshooting.

• Scripting & Automation: Utilize GAM (Google Account Manager), Google Apps Script, and Python to automate routine administration, reporting, and complex workflow optimization

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Degree: Minimum of a Bachelor of Science or Bachelor of Arts in Computer Science, Management Information Systems (MIS), Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.

• 7+ years of experience in desktop engineering or similar IT-related roles.

• Demonstrated experience managing multiple, highly complex GWS tenants, specifically dealing with environments subject to strict regulatory frameworks (e.g., CMMC, FedRAMP).

• Hands-on expertise configuring GWS security center, complex mail routing, Google Vault, and enterprise identity integrations (e.g., SAML, SSO via Okta or Microsoft Entra ID).

• Proven capability in managing, testing, and supporting enterprise AI tools within a modern productivity suite.

• Working knowledge of scripting and API automation for GWS (e.g., GAM/GAMADV, Google Apps Script, Python).

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across teams.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Certifications: Google Cloud Professional Workspace Administrator.

• Deep technical understanding of zero-trust security models and government compliance auditing processes.

• Experience building sophisticated, automated user lifecycle workflows spanning across multiple SaaS applications.

The base salary range represents a good faith and reasonable estimate of the range at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be dependent on a number of factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s relevant work experience, qualifications, internal peer equity, and market and business conditions that exist when extending an offer. A discretionary bonus may be awarded in recognition of individual and company performance.

In addition, Appian provides generous benefits offerings that include a 401(k) plan with company match, flexible time off, paid parental leave, medical, dental, and vision plans, life insurance, disability insurance, wellness programs, flexible spending accounts, health savings account contributions, an employee referral bonus program, and learning and development resources. Certain positions may be eligible for equity awards.

Pay and benefits are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation, commission, bonus, or benefit plans.

Base Salary Range

$100,000—$200,000 USD

Tools and Resources

• Training and Development: During onboarding, we focus on equipping new hires with the skills and knowledge for success through department-specific training. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires.

• Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.

• Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee-led affinity groups. These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company.

Benefits

Appian offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and financial future. Benefits may include health coverage, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental health support, life and disability insurance, an Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), a retirement/pension plan, wellness dollars, tuition reimbursement, family-forming benefits and more. Benefits vary by country—please ask your Talent Acquisition contact for details specific to the location you are applying to.

About Appian

Appian provides AI automation for the most important business processes at the world’s largest organizations. Our platform is known for its unique power, reliability, and scale. We’ve been automating processes for more than 25 years and have proven expertise in enterprise operations. For more information, visit appian.com.

Follow Appian: LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, and X.

Appian provides reasonable accommodations to applicants in accordance with all applicable laws. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please contact us by email at ReasonableAccommodations@appian.com. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Talent Management & Organization Effectiveness
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.

Financial technology is a high-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.

Position Summary

Arcesium seeks a Manager / Senior Manager, Organization and Talent Development to join our global Human Capital team in New York.

You will partner with senior business and Human Capital leaders to help shape how the organization is structured, how talent is evaluated and developed, and how employees grow as the business evolves. You will work across a broad range of strategic people questions, from organization design and spans and layers to performance management, career architecture, promotion processes, and capability development.

This is a highly consultative role. You will be expected to understand complex business problems, bring structure to ambiguity, use data and organizational insights to develop recommendations, and translate those recommendations into practical people processes and solutions.

Responsibilities

• Partner with senior leaders on organizational and talent-related questions, bringing an enterprise perspective to how teams, roles, talent, and capabilities should evolve.

• Lead and support organization design and effectiveness work, including organizational structures, spans and layers, role clarity, decision rights, accountabilities, and operating models.

• Design, evolve and execute performance management and talent processes, including performance frameworks, promotion process, goal-setting, talent assessments, calibration, and related people processes.

• Develop and evolve career architecture and job/role frameworks, helping create greater clarity around roles, levels, career paths, and expectations.

• Identify critical capabilities required by the business and translate them into capability-building and upskilling strategies.

• Use organizational, workforce, talent, and performance data to identify patterns, risks, and opportunities and translate them into actionable recommendations.

• Develop practical frameworks, tools, and processes that can scale across geographies while allowing for appropriate local differences.

• Lead and contribute to global Human Capital initiatives that strengthen organizational effectiveness and talent outcomes.

• Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and influence decisions without formal authority.

Qualifications

• 7+ years of experience in Talent Management, Organization Development, Organization Effectiveness, Organization Design, HR Strategy & Consulting, or a related field.

• Experience working with senior business leaders on complex organization, talent, or workforce questions.

• Strong understanding of organization design and effectiveness, including structures, spans and layers, operating models, roles and responsibilities, decision rights, and organizational capabilities.

• Experience designing or evolving performance management, talent assessment, promotion, career, or capability-building processes.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn ambiguous business questions into structured analysis and practical recommendations.

• Ability to connect business strategy with organization structure, talent, performance, careers, and capabilities rather than treating these as separate disciplines.

• Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills, particularly with senior leaders and leadership teams.

• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment where the problem is not always clearly defined.

• Ability to move between strategic thinking and hands-on execution, from developing a framework to making sure it works in practice.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to simplify complex ideas and communicate clearly with different audiences.

• Experience in technology, financial services, consulting, SaaS, or other complex, high-growth environments is preferred.

• Experience working across geographies and cultures is a plus.

• Graduate degree in business, HR, organizational psychology, or a related discipline is preferred.

The expected annual base salary for this position is $140,000 - $200,000. Our compensation package includes variable compensation in the form of a year-end bonus, guaranteed in the first year of hire, benefits including medical and prescription drug coverage, and 401k contribution matching.

The applicable annual base salary paid to a successful applicant will be determined based on multiple factors including without limitation the nature and extent of prior experience and educational background.

The Nursing Services Manager is responsible for the Wellness Coordination program as well as supervising and managing nursing operations in a select area.  This position develops and monitors the oversight of medical policies and procedures used within Dungarvin and ensures they meet all licensing requirements. The Nursing Services Manager will assure that each individual receives quality, individualized health care management resulting in optimal health.

• Clinical Oversight: Monitor healthcare needs, clinical services, and care delivery for individuals supported across assigned programs.
• Clinical Consultation: Partner with Area Directors, Program Directors, nurses, and other team members on medical concerns, healthcare practices, and regulatory requirements.
• Program Growth: Help develop healthcare systems and nursing supports for new individuals and new programs.
• Compliance & Quality: Ensure nursing services and documentation meet licensing requirements, organizational standards, and person-centered care expectations.

MUST HAVES:

• Active Indiana RN License: Current, unrestricted license to practice as a Registered Nurse in Indiana.
• Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of experience leading, supervising, coaching, or developing nursing or healthcare staff.
• Communication & Documentation: Strong ability to communicate clinical information clearly and maintain accurate healthcare documentation.
• Valid Driver’s License: Must be able to travel between programs as needed.
• Successful Background Clearance: Must successfully complete required background and compliance checks.

NICE TO HAVE:

• Residential Services Experience: Experience in ICF/IID, Medicaid waiver, group home, supported living, or community-based settings.

• Staff Training: Experience educating clinical and non-clinical staff on health-related needs, medication administration, and care procedures.
• Healthcare Planning: Knowledge of assessments, care plans, medication management, MARs, and physician orders.
• Clinical Documentation: Experience with electronic health records, audits, regulatory documentation, and quality improvement.
• Interdisciplinary Collaboration: Experience partnering with physicians, guardians, pharmacies, case managers, and program leadership.
• On-Call Leadership: Experience providing clinical guidance during evenings, weekends, or urgent situations.

SKILLS CRITICAL FOR SUCCESS:

• Clinical Judgment: Assess health concerns, recognize changes in condition, and determine appropriate next steps.
• Leadership & Communication: Coach staff and clearly explain medical information to both clinical and non-clinical teams.

• Collaboration: Build strong relationships with individuals served, families, nurses, DSPs, providers, guardians, and program leaders.
• Adaptability & Initiative: Stay calm under pressure, adjust to changing needs, and proactively improve healthcare systems and services.
• Person-Centered Care: Balance health and safety needs with individual rights, preferences, and independence.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE THIS ROLE:

You’ll love this role if you’re passionate about using your nursing leadership to make a meaningful difference in the lives of individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities and their families. You’ll help ensure people who have traditionally been underserved have access to high-quality, individualized healthcare and the support they need to thrive in their communities. As a Nursing Services Manager, you’ll have the opportunity to develop and support a talented nursing team while collaborating with a larger group of professionals who genuinely support one another. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist - Growth
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
jobs.description:
In the 1840s, Charles Babbage and Ada Lovelace worked on an early version of the computer known as the “Analytics Engine”. In the words of computing historian Doron Swade, “What Lovelace saw...was that numbers could represent entities other than quantity” and together they laid the foundation for general-purpose computing.

While much has changed since then, the importance of numbers in building great technology remains. We’re looking for Data Scientists who can help us build our analytics engine by making meaning from data and identifying opportunities for improvement.

As a Growth Data Scientist at Mercury, you will partner with Growth product, design, engineering and marketing leaders to shape how Mercury acquires, activates and retains customers across business and personal banking*. This is a strategic, product-facing role: you’ll frame the “why” behind what we build, size opportunities, and turn the growth funnel into clear, prioritized recommendations. You will work as a full-stack Data Scientist on projects end to end and build deep domain expertise at the intersection of Data Science, Product and Growth. You will help set the direction for how Growth measures success and decides where to invest, in line with Mercury’s broader product and company goals.

Here are some things you’ll do on the job:

• Partner with Growth product, design, engineering and marketing leaders to identify the highest-impact business questions, and influence what gets built and why.

• Own the growth funnel end to end, from first visit through signup, approval, activation and retention, building the metrics, driver trees and narratives that show where we’re winning and where we’re not.

• Size opportunities and help prioritize the Growth roadmap and annual planning, making clear recommendations even when data is incomplete.

• Design, analyze and communicate experiments (A/B tests and quasi-experimental methods) that tell teams whether a change worked and what to do next.

• Right-size your work to the decision: fast and directional when that’s what’s needed, rigorous when the stakes call for it.

• Collaborate with other Data Scientists, Data Engineers and Analytics Engineers to build trusted, self-serve growth metrics.

• Communicate findings and recommendations to audiences at all levels, including executives, with a clear point of view that improves entrepreneurs’ lives and generates revenue for Mercury.

You should:

• Have 6+ years of experience in data science, product analytics or growth analytics, including 3+ years partnering closely with product growth teams.

• Have strong product sense and a track record of shaping product direction, not just measuring it, including times your work changed what a team built.

• Have deep experience with experiment design and analysis, as well as funnel, cohort and retention analysis.

• Have fluency in SQL and a statistical programming language (e.g. Python, R).

• Have experience with product analytics and BI tools such as Amplitude, Hex, Omni or similar; familiarity with Snowflake and dbt is a plus.

• Be comfortable with ambiguity and with respectfully disagreeing with senior stakeholders, backed by evidence.

• Be a clear, concise communicator who leads with the point and tailors the message to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Nice to have: experience in consumer or SMB fintech, or with mobile product analytics.

* Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

jobs.title: Senior Business Technology Engineer
jobs.description:
Here at Appian, our values of Intensity and Excellence define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. Senior Business Technology Engineer

Location: McLean, VA | Work Model: On-site

Are you a technical leader ready to architect, optimize, and scale the mission-critical platforms powering a global pioneer in enterprise transformation? Move beyond daily maintenance to bridge strategic engineering gaps, guide cross-functional teams, and future-proof the complex software layers that enable our global workforce.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Appian Business Technology team is the strategic engine driving our internal corporate infrastructure forward. We design, optimize, and scale the enterprise systems that empower Appian employees globally, ensuring our internal operations mirror the high-performance capabilities of our market-leading technology and enable our corporate growth in the automation market.

THE OPPORTUNITY

This lead role is designed for an elite systems expert who thrives at the intersection of enterprise architecture and technical execution. At Appian, you will have the autonomy to direct end-to-end system assessments, implement robust configuration and coding solutions, and pioneer methodologies to simulate user interactions before updates reach production—all while working face-to-face in a culture that champions collaboration and rapid technical innovation at our corporate headquarters.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Secure Environment & CMMC Management: Manage, govern, and maintain established secure IT enclaves compliant with Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) and NIST 800-171 frameworks. Ensure ongoing compliance of endpoints, infrastructure, and access controls against stringent federal and DoD standards.

• Strict Patch Management Execution: Enforce and support rigorous patch management SLAs for OS and third-party applications across all environments. Continually test, deploy, and verify updates to maintain CMMC compliance, mitigate zero-day vulnerabilities, and ensure uninterrupted system functionality.

• Monitor and address security vulnerabilities, partnering with security teams to mitigate risks.

• Zero-Touch Provisioning: Maintain and improve automated onboarding/offboarding workflows using Windows Autopilot and Apple Business Manager / Automated Device Enrollment.

• Scripting & Tooling: Write and maintain operational scripts (PowerShell, Bash, Python) to automate software distribution, settings configuration, and routine IT tasks.

• Workflow Optimization: Identify manual IT support processes and build automated workflows to streamline operations and improve end-user resolution times

• Tier-2 / Tier-3 Escalations: Serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues involving endpoint OS performance, policy conflicts, and software deployment failures.

• Documentation & Standards: Maintain clear technical documentation, system configurations, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for the IT team.

• Cross-Team Execution: Partner with Information Security and Network teams to implement security controls and ensure endpoint compatibility with company systems.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Degree: Minimum of a Bachelor of Science or Bachelor of Arts in Computer Science, Management Information Systems (MIS), Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.

• 4+ years of experience in desktop engineering or similar IT-related roles.

• Demonstrated experience configuring, managing, and troubleshooting both Windows 10/11 and macOS operating systems in an enterprise setting.

• Experience administering enterprise device management systems (e.g., Microsoft Intune for Windows; Jamf Pro, Addigy,NinjaOne, or Intune for macOS).

• Working knowledge of PowerShell (Windows) and Bash / zsh (macOS) for administrative automation.

• Practical experience with endpoint encryption, antivirus software deployment, and identity management basics (e.g., Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD, Okta).

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across teams.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience with zero-trust security models and endpoint protection tools.

• Knowledge of cloud-based IT solutions (e.g., Azure AD, Google Workspace, AWS WorkSpaces).

• Certifications: Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator
