jobs.title: GNC Engineer I
jobs.description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

GNC ENGINEER I - MISSION FORMULATION

Based out of Rocket Lab’s global headquarters in Long Beach, CA, the GNC Engineer I-Mission Formulation is responsible for Guidance Navigation and Control (GNC) design, modeling, analyses, and testing for Rocket Lab launches and missions. You'll play an integral part of Rocket Lab’s Global Launch Services (GLS) Mission Formulation Team, which works closely with other Engineering teams and Production to bring new launch and mission concepts to life.

As part of the Mission Formulation team, you'll be responsible for conducting trades studies, preliminary and final mission analyses, and definition and implementation of detailed designs for Rocket Lab’s launch programs. This team is also primarily responsible for the formulation and implementation of launches and missions for classified missions on HASTE and Electron launch vehicles.

Success in this position will be measured by the value of the knowledge and experience in launch vehicle design and mission experience that you bring into this role, your ability to contribute to projects without supervision, successful collaboration with other teams across Rocket Lab, and the skillful prioritization of competing engineering projects across the group.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

• GNC contact to Business Development for proposals and mission definition

• Launch and mission operational concept development

• Orbital and suborbital trajectory design and analysis

• Work with external stakeholders and customers for mission-specific requirements engineering

• Document proposed GNC solutions and participate in design reviews with customers

• Support hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) testing to verify trajectories, GNC, and flight code performance

• Conduct Monte Carlo simulation analyses to define and verify launch and mission operations

• Develop and support release of flight code for pre-launch ground testing, launch, and mission operations

• Develop tools and processes for automating common GNC modelling and analysis tasks

YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS GNC ENGINEER I:

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering

• Understanding of orbital mechanics and/ or closed-loop control systems, preferably launch vehicles

• Experience with trajectory optimization

• Proven experience developing real-time control and/or estimation algorithms in autonomous vehicles, preferably launch vehicles

• Active Secret security clearance OR Ability to obtain and maintain one

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

• Active TS/SCI clearance

• Experience with requirements assessments and interface control document generation

• Experience with git version control.

• 1+ years’ experience in modelling, simulation and/or control of dynamics systems, particularly rigid bodies

• 1+ years’ experience with Python development

• 1+ years’ experience with data analysis using MATLAB and/or SciPy

• Experience developing in C/C++

• Experience with POST, ASTOS, TAOS or similar mission analysis, trajectory optimization, vehicle design and simulation tools

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to build strong working relationships

• Creative, analytical, and good at problem solving

• Ability to work on own initiative and to plan daily workflow to meet higher level tasks

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

The expected salary range for the position is displayed in accordance with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act. Final agreed upon compensation is based upon individual qualifications and experience.

Base salary is only one part of Rocket Lab’s compensation package for this role. You may be eligible for company stock, or cash incentives, and can purchase discounted stock through Rocket Lab’s Employee Stock Purchase Program. Employee benefits also include medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage; 401(k) retirement plan options; paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave; paid parental leave; and other discounts and perks.

Base Pay Range (CO Only)

$81,000—$102,000 USD

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Important information:

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR here.

Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at g.biow@rocketlabusa.com.This dedicated resource is intended solely to assist job seekers with disabilities whose disability prevents them from being able to apply/interview. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.

jobs.title: Senior Robotics Engineer, AV Performance Diagnosis & Evaluation
jobs.location: Boston, Massachusetts, United States; Las Vegas, Nevada, United States
jobs.description:
Mission Summary:

The Systems Readiness and Performance team is the crucial bridge between software development and real-world deployment. We are responsible for driving system design, for verifying and validating the autonomy stack, and for defining, measuring, and validating system performance targets. We work closely with stakeholders in autonomy, infrastructure, and operations to build the definitive safety case for the commercial launch of our fully driverless IONIQ 5 robotaxis in Las Vegas later this year.

We are seeking a highly skilled and autonomous Senior Robotics Engineer to play a critical role in investigating and diagnosing complex autonomous vehicle (AV) behaviors across on-road, resimulation, and synthetic simulation environments. This engineer will be responsible for taking end-to-end ownership of ambiguous problem spaces, utilizing Python, custom Spaceship tooling, and data visualization platforms to effectively perform root-cause analysis on emergent behaviors across our autonomy stack. Their work will directly contribute to accelerating the development of safe and reliable autonomous technologies by transforming deep technical debugging into clear summaries that support unified release narratives and executive insights.

What You'll Be Doing:

• System Diagnosis & Root Cause Analysis: Perform deep technical investigations of undesirable AV behaviors across simulation, HIL, and on-road operations. Take end-to-end ownership of complex investigations, driving solutions autonomously from initial triage to final resolution with little to no oversight.

• Cross-Subsystem Debugging: Debug behaviors across perception, prediction, localization, planning, controls, and vehicle systems. Reason across subsystem boundaries to diagnose emergent behaviors resulting from component interactions.

• Data Analysis & Tooling: Analyze large datasets from system logs, telemetry, and software outputs using Python. Develop automated diagnostic workflows and custom internal tooling using Python and Spaceship to increase the speed and scale of investigations.

• Performance Visualization: Design and build interactive dashboards using Python frameworks and Business Intelligence tools (e.g., Looker) to effectively measure, analyze, and report on the performance of our AV systems.

• Hypothesis Generation: Develop technical hypotheses from incomplete or ambiguous evidence, distinguish behavioral symptoms from underlying root causes, and design analyses to systematically test potential causes.

• Problem Space Identification: Autonomously identify recurring undesirable behaviors, regressions, and emerging system-level performance issues, categorizing them into meaningful failure modes.

• Technical Storytelling & Synthesis: "Dive deep" into technical complexities to uncover root causes, then step back to synthesize findings. Translate raw performance metrics into clear summaries that support executive-level reporting, unified release narratives, and cross-functional communication.

What We're Looking For:

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Computer Science, Electrical, Systems, Robotics) or equivalent work experience, with a Master's degree considered a strong plus.

• Robotics Experience: 5+ years of professional software or systems engineering experience working on safety-critical, complex systems such as Autonomous Vehicles, Robotics, Medical Devices, or Aerospace. Thorough understanding of robotics systems including sensors, actuators, and software autonomy stacks.

• Data & Analytics Expertise: Strong proficiency in Python for data analysis and scripting, backed by a strong understanding of modern software development principles. Experience building data visualizations using Python frameworks, with a willingness to learn Business Intelligence tools (e.g., Looker).

• Systems Thinking & Quality: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for complex system performance evaluation. Ability to think logically, remove bias, perform root cause analysis using system logs, and maintain a strict commitment to data quality and rigorous testing.

• Engineering Workflows: Proficient with Git and standard version control workflows, and entirely comfortable working in a fast-paced, agile, continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) environment.

• Autonomy & Communication: Proven ability to work both independently and effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team. Excellent communication skills with the ability to synthesize complex technical findings into clear summaries that support cross-functional teams and executive leadership.

Bonus Points (not required):

• Experience using AV-specific software diagnostic and visualization tools (e.g., Planner Analyzer) to troubleshoot complex autonomy behaviors.

• Knowledge of statistical analysis and machine learning techniques relevant to performance evaluation.

Success Metrics:

• Core Diagnosis & RCA: Effective execution of deep technical investigations that accurately isolate the underlying root causes of complex, cross-subsystem AV behaviors and translate them into actionable engineering resolutions.

• Diagnostic Automation: Successful implementation of robust, automated diagnostic workflows that significantly reduce the time required to triage and resolve anomalous AV behaviors.

• Technical Synthesis & Insights: Consistent delivery of accurate, high-impact data visualizations and clear summaries that directly accelerate AV development and system maturity.

Physical Demands:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit, talk, or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand and at times for long periods; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and move up to 50 pounds.

Travel Requirements (greater than 20%):

Expected to travel for 1-2 weeks each quarter visiting all of our testing sites - mostly to LV, but also domestically as needed for the business.

Working Environment:

The work environment characteristics described here represent those a team member encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The team member is regularly exposed to mechanical and computer parts. The team member is occasionally exposed to fumes and/or airborne particlesThe noise level in the environment is low to moderate.

This role is hybrid from our Boston or Las Vegas office. It requires in-office days each week.

jobs.title: Government Contracts Administrator
jobs.description:
ABOUT NOOKS

Nooks is pioneering Classified-Infrastructure-as-a-Service (CIaaS) — designing, building, and operating Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities (SCIFs) and other secured, classified environments for the defense and national security community. We work with the agencies, contractors, and mission-driven organizations that keep the nation safe, delivering the physical infrastructure that makes classified work possible. We’re growing fast, operating across multiple markets, and building a company that takes both the mission and the business seriously.

About the Role

You will support the Government Delivery team by administering assigned government contracts, analyzing contract documents, negotiating routine agreements, and supporting proposal preparation. Reporting to the Senior Director of Government Delivery and working day to day with program managers and the Program Director, you exercise independent judgment on contract administration matters while acting at the direction of Government Delivery leadership. You identify contractual issues early, recommend resolutions, and guide teammates on contract administration principles and regulations. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports.

At Nooks, we move fast. While you'll have clear ownership over your core responsibilities, startup life means priorities can shift. We're looking for a proactive problem-solver who is comfortable with ambiguity and ready to lean in wherever the team needs them most to drive us forward.

Key Responsibilities

Contract Administration

• Administer assigned contracts from award setup and kickoff briefings through modifications and closeout, keeping files complete and audit-ready.

• Serve as a point of contact for Contracting Officers and Contract Specialists on administrative matters for assigned contracts.

• Coordinate between program teams and Finance on invoicing so billing matches contract terms, funding, and delivered work.

Performance and Compliance Monitoring

• Monitor contract performance against delivery schedules, pricing, and terms, and identify when modifications, amendments, or extensions are needed.

• Determine when customer-directed changes fall outside contract scope and raise them with Government Delivery leadership before work proceeds.

• Track deliverables, reports, and Contract Data Requirements List (CDRL) items for assigned contracts, alerting owners and escalating risk to the Program Director.

Agreements and Subcontracts

• Negotiate and maintain nondisclosure agreements (NDAs), teaming agreements, and subcontracts within policy and the approved fallback playbook, routing final versions for signature.

• Flow down required Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) and Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) clauses, keeping subcontract provisions clear and compliant.

• Monitor subcontractor performance with program managers, and investigate and recommend resolutions to claims, disputes, and complaints.

Pre-Award Support

• Support solicitation reviews, compliance assessments, and teaming coordination in partnership with Growth.

• Help prepare proposal contract documentation, including representations, certifications, and required forms, for leadership review and submission.

• Draft solicitation questions and responses to customer data calls for leadership review.

The Skillset

• Four or more years of government contracts administration experience.

• Strong working knowledge of the FAR and DFARS.

• Experience supporting Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) and General Services Administration (GSA) Schedule contracts.

• Experience drafting and negotiating NDAs, teaming agreements, and subcontracts.

• Ability to identify contract risk and develop solutions to moderate and complex contractual issues.

• Ability to work independently while taking direction from program and department leadership.

• Strong written and verbal communication, with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

• Certified Federal Contracts Manager (CFCM), Certified Professional Contracts Manager (CPCM), or Federal Acquisition Certification in Contracting (FAC-C), preferred.

• Prior experience as a federal 1102 Contract Specialist, a plus.

• Familiarity with the Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) and Contractor Performance Assessment Reporting System (CPARS), a plus.

• Experience with Other Transaction (OT) agreements or Intelligence Community customers, a plus.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Commercial Operations
jobs.description:
MISSION

Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we’re looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Associate Director Commercial Operations will support commercial decision-making and execution through robust forecasting, commercial insights, market research, competitive intelligence, and effective sales operations.

Key areas of responsibility include commercial forecasting, Sales Incentive Plan management, Veeva CRM administration and field-force support, territory design, segmentation and targeting, Sales Force Effectiveness, as well as the coordination of market research and competitive intelligence activities.

The successful candidate will be a hands-on Commercial Operations professional with strong analytical capabilities, sound commercial judgment, and excellent business partnering skills. As a collaborative team player, this person will work closely with Brand Leads, Country General Managers, Commercial and Sales Leadership, Finance, Market Access, Medical, and external partners in a dynamic, entrepreneurial biotech environment.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who combines strategic thinking with operational excellence, enjoys building and improving processes in a fast-moving environment, and is willing to go the extra mile to help the business succeed.

This position requires an onsite presence in Zug, offering the opportunity to be deeply integrated into Mirum’s company culture. Remote working is permitted in accordance with Mirum policy and as agreed with the reporting manager.

JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES

Forecasting & Business Planning

• Lead the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of commercial forecasting models across brands and countries.

• Partner with Country General Managers, Brand Leads, Finance, and Commercial Leadership and facilitate the creation & update of country level mid & long-range forecasts

• Ensure forecasts are transparent, assumption-driven, well documented, and aligned with Finance and Commercial Leadership.

• Identify key forecast risks and opportunities and provide clear recommendations to support business decisions.

Market Research & Competitive Intelligence

• Partner with Brand Leads and Commercial Leadership to define research and competitive intelligence priorities aligned to key business questions.

• Develop research briefs, select methodologies, manage RFPs, evaluate vendor proposals, and oversee projects from briefing to final delivery.

• Support qualitative and quantitative research including market assessments, customer insights, patient journeys, ATUs.

• Monitor competitive landscape across public sources (competitor activity, clinical trials, regulatory updates, congresses, investor materials, market access developments, and commercial signals).

• Translate findings and competitive developments into actionable commercial implications for brand strategy, forecasting, launch planning, and decision-making.

• Ensure compliance with internal legal, procurement, compliance, and pharmacovigilance requirements.

Sales Operations

• Manage Sales Incentive Plans for country sales teams, including plan design, target setting, performance tracking, calculation, reconciliation, communication, exception management and coordination of payouts in partnership with key stakeholders.

• Own the commercial administration of Veeva CRM for Mirum International, including users, territories, targeting lists and relevant field configurations; provide first-level support and coordinate testing and roll-out of system enhancements with US counterparts.

• Support territory design, field-force deployment and roster management, ensuring alignment with market potential, patient populations, referral pathways and commercial priorities.

• Support & facilitate segmentation and targeting process, translating strategic customer priorities into actionable target lists, call plans and CRM execution.

• Develop Sales Force Effectiveness KPIs and provide insights on territory performance, customer coverage, reach/frequency, CRM adoption and field execution.

• Support field-force onboarding, CRM training, launch readiness and continuous improvement of Sales Operations processes and governance.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education /Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree required, Master a plus, preferably in Business, Finance, Economics, Data Sciences or a related field.

• >5 years of experience in pharmaceutical, biotech or life sciences Commercial Operations, Sales Operations, Commercial Excellence or a related function.

• Demonstrated hands-on experience in commercial forecasting and working with senior commercial stakeholders, experience with Veeva CRM administration, Sales Incentive Plans, territory alignment, segmentation and targeting, and field-performance reporting, Experience in managing market research projects and generating competitive insights.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

• Advanced Excel and forecasting model development skills.

• Hands-on experience administering Veeva CRM/Salesforce.

• Strong analytical capabilities and experience developing commercial dashboards and visualizations, preferably using Power BI.

• Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud-based data platforms is a plus.

• Ability to work with commercial datasets including sales, account, CRM, market access, market research and performance data.

• SQL knowledge and familiarity with VBA, Python and effective use of AI-enabled tools are desirable.

• Familiarity with pharmaceutical secondary data, claims, prescription, CRM and/or patient-level data is beneficial.

• Collaborative, hands-on team player with strong business partnering skills; comfortable operating in ambiguity, challenging assumptions and thinking creatively.

jobs.title: Staff+ Fullstack Software Engineer, Safeguards Engineering
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Note: this job post is for Fullstack Software Engineers only. If you are a Backend Engineer, please see our Backend Software Engineer post here.

About the role

We are looking for fullstack software engineers to help build safety and oversight mechanisms for our AI systems. As a software engineer on the Safeguards team, you will work to monitor models, prevent misuse, and ensure user well-being. This role will focus on building systems to detect unwanted model behaviors and prevent disallowed use of models. You will apply your technical skills to uphold our principles of safety, transparency, and oversight while enforcing our terms of service and acceptable use policies.

We have multiple teams that are currently hiring within Safeguards. Team placement occurs after the interview process, taking into account your interests and experience alongside organizational needs. This flexible approach allows us to match talented engineers where they'll have the greatest impact and growth potential.

Responsibilities:

• Design and build the internal review tools analysts use to investigate abuse — dashboards, case queues, and evidence viewers that make high-volume, high-stakes decisions fast and accurate.

• Build the interfaces where humans supervise agents: streaming output, interruption and approval flows, and clear provenance for every action an agent takes.

• Surface abuse patterns to our research teams through the visualizations and exploration tools that make emerging patterns legible.

• Own the frontend architecture for tools handling sensitive data at scale — performance under large datasets, correctness under real-time updates, and access controls enforced end to end.

You may be a good fit if you have:

• A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or comparable experience

• Proficiency in TypeScript and modern React; comfortable in Python for backend work

• The ability to work across the stack

• Strong communication skills and ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

Strong candidates may also:

• 8+ years of experience in a software engineering position, not including internships or co-ops

• Have experience building data-dense internal tools or operator interfaces, not just marketing or consumer surfaces

• Have experience with integrity, spam, fraud, or abuse detection and mitigation

• Have experience building trust and safety detection mechanisms and intervention for AI/ML systems

• Have experience with prompt engineering, jailbreak attacks, and other adversarial inputs

• Have worked closely with operational teams to build custom internal tooling

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$405,000—$485,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

In this role, you’ll own the strategy, planning, execution, and measurement of programs designed to build relationships, strengthen our presence in the market, and generate meaningful pipeline. • Strong project management skills with experience managing multiple programs, stakeholders, vendors, and deadlines.

• Commercial mindset with an understanding of how marketing programs support pipeline, sales cycles, and account engagement.

• Strong communication and relationship-building skills with confidence representing a company externally.

• Comfort working with senior leaders and managing high-visibility programs.

• Strong attention to detail paired with the ability to think strategically about priorities and investment.

• Willingness to travel for events, conferences, customer programs, and other field initiatives as needed.

Benefits and Perks

• Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision. Multiple plan options, including a plan option for 100% employer-paid premium for individual coverage for full-time employees.

• Free access to Health Advocate

• Hybrid & Remote opportunities - we have an Amazing new office in Midtown Atlanta

• You will be part of a small, professional fast-moving team with minimal supervision

• Annual team gatherings

Top Three Reasons to Join

#1: It’s the Right Time – We’ve already facilitated more than $500 billion of complex projects across the United States

#2. Northspyre has the right product – Our technology empowers modern real estate teams to build leveraging data, automation and artificial intelligence to get to faster, more predictable outcomes on complex projects.

#3. Northspyre celebrates a culture of creativity – We strive to have a sense of community within Northspyre that encourages diverse viewpoints, openness, and fostering an environment in which employees feel comfortable bringing their whole authentic selves to work.

We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
(SENIOR) FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER

Bring the Spherecast Platform, our real-time operating system for global consumer goods supply chains, into customers’ daily operations. Agnes, our AI Supply Chain Manager, runs on this foundation to evaluate production, purchasing, and inventory decisions and execute approved actions in their ERP.

As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll own getting Spherecast live and delivering value for the brands you work with. You’ll work directly with supply chain operators and customer IT teams, understand how their business runs, connect their data, configure their workflows, and ship the code needed to make the implementation successful.

Each brand you own will know you as its primary technical partner. You’ll drive the work from discovery through go-live and ongoing adoption, with the engineering judgment to solve problems yourself and bring in the right specialist when needed.

In a typical week, you might move a customer from file uploads to Snowflake, investigate why inventory numbers don’t reconcile, map how goods move between manufacturers and warehouses, or build a supplier performance dashboard.

In this role, you will:

 - Own implementations end to end. Lead technical discovery, define milestones and acceptance criteria, run customer working sessions, and drive deployments through validation, go-live, and stabilization.

 - Make customer data reliable. Set up and operate integrations using our existing connectors and infrastructure. Build customer-specific mappings and transformations, configure file and warehouse connections, and resolve data quality and synchronization issues.

 - Translate supply chains into software. Work with operators to map suppliers, manufacturers, warehouses, and sales channels. Configure planning parameters such as lead times, safety stock, minimum order quantities, and replenishment rules.

 - Ship product improvements. Turn customer needs into concrete requirements and build scoped features, dashboards, workflow improvements, and fixes across the backend and frontend. Align feature scope and design with our product lead before building.

 - Drive customer progress. Keep milestones, blockers, dependencies, and next steps clear. Follow up with customer stakeholders, coordinate internal work, and communicate progress and risks every week.

 - Own activation and ongoing technical success. Validate outputs with customers, help teams adopt their workflows, and stay accountable for resolving issues after launch.

 - Make each implementation easier than the last. Turn repeated work into reusable tooling, configuration, documentation, and automation that helps the team support more brands.

You’ll work closely with product and engineering. Our integrations engineer owns shared connectors and the infrastructure for supporting new ERPs. You’ll use that foundation to own each customer’s data setup and implementation. Product engineers own core capabilities and help resolve deeper product issues; you remain the customer’s technical owner throughout.








WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Have shipped and operated production software, with strong Python and SQL skills and the ability to work across APIs, data pipelines, and frontend interfaces.

 - Can take an ambiguous customer problem from discovery to a working solution, including scoping, implementation, testing, and rollout.

 - Are comfortable leading customer calls, asking precise questions, explaining technical tradeoffs, and setting clear expectations.

 - Debug systematically across source systems, data transformations, application logic, and the user interface.

 - Can manage several customer implementations at different stages while keeping commitments and priorities clear.

 - Use AI coding tools effectively and take responsibility for the quality and reliability of what you ship.

 - Want to work on-site with an ambitious team in New York City, move quickly, work hard, and take substantial ownership.
   
   


ABOUT SPHERECAST

Spherecast is building the operating system for AI-native Consumer Goods Supply Chains.

The Spherecast Platform brings demand, inventory, materials, capacity, costs, and business rules into one real-time operating context. It gives teams a single place to plan, evaluate tradeoffs, and execute the decisions that move physical goods.

Agnes, our AI Supply Chain Manager, runs on top of this foundation. It evaluates thousands of feasible options in seconds to decide what to produce, where to make it, and how to move it through factories, warehouses, and channels. Teams set the objectives and guardrails; Agnes turns them into approved actions in the ERP.

Our ambition is to make the physical flow of goods as programmable as code. When we succeed, every consumer product you touch will run on the Spherecast stack: planned in Spherecast OS, executed through Spherecast Rails, and optimized by the shared Spherecast Network.

Oracle made business data programmable. Spherecast makes the physical economy programmable.

Join us in the trenches in New York City to build the operating system for AI-native Consumer Goods Supply Chains.

Be part of building the next trillion-dollar company.

jobs.title: Principal Program Manager
jobs.description:
About the Team:

STR’s Analytics & C2 (AC2) Division develops novel technologies to solve challenging national security problems through advanced analytics. Our team consists of passionate and motivated individuals with degrees in engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics, and data science. We use our expertise and creativity to develop and mature innovative ideas from conception to improve mission success of our customers.

The Collaborative Autonomy and Control (CAC) Group in the AC2 Division works to build software systems that solve critical problems in the areas of uncrewed system autonomy, multi-agent collaboration, resource management, and control. By leveraging expertise in machine learning, algorithms, model-predictive control, and software development we build tools that support tactical mission planning and execution, autonomous reasoning, and more.

The Role:

The CAC group is seeking a Program Manager with a highly operational centric space systems background and extensive knowledge of and prior experience working with Department of War organizations in this area.  In this role you will manage multi-disciplinary teams of researchers, scientists, and engineers spread across multiple STR campuses to meet cost, schedule, and performance objectives on innovative, complex, and challenging national security programs. Your areas of specific focus will include building and executing programmatic baselines, including personnel, deliverables, and subcontractor / contract manufacturer management plans while anticipating risks, resolving resource, security, and contracting challenges, and meeting or managing customer, sponsor, and leadership expectations.

A successful candidate will have recent and significant program manager experience in several of the following areas: space systems, collection orchestration, satellite constellation management, modeling and simulation, test & evaluation, software architecture, resource management, acoustic data analysis, signal processing, and/or communications. This position requires competency in leading and managing multi-disciplinary teams, briefing senior leadership, cultivating positive, collaborative, and productive work environments, and a strong proficiency in all aspects of program management. Strong interpersonal, communication, mentorship, and peer-leadership skills are also required.

What you will do:

• Be the primary programmatic representative of STR to Government customers, other stakeholders, sub-contractors, and partner organizations.

• Effectively execute multiple programs ensuring cost, schedule and technical program metrics are being tracked and within plan.

• Lead proposals by providing expertise in proposal development while ensuring adherence to a gated capture process.

• Negotiate subcontractor statements of work and manage/track Subcontractors to ensure proper execution.

• Lead multi-functional teams.

• Provide regular program briefs to Group and Division Leadership.

• Create and maintain an environment that fosters collaboration by giving clear direction and constructive feedback to the team.

• Monitor progress against goals: anticipate risks, resolve issues, and initiate corrective actions as appropriate.

Who you are:

• Active TS clearance with SCI and ability to gain and SAP accreditations, for which U.S citizenship is needed by the U.S government.

• Technical Degree and 8+ years of prior relevant experience. In lieu of degree, extensive experience with government contracting, research and development (R&D), scientific & technical intelligence (S&TI), or advanced technology production will be considered.

• Program Manager or Control Account Manager experience in design and development and/or build contract including Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) definition, schedule generation, financial analysis/reporting, and resource management.

• Demonstrated expertise in Proposal Management including planning and cost estimation.

• Demonstrated expertise in managing projects larger than $10M for the Department of War or IC.

• Excellent interpersonal and communications skills.

• Successful experience in leading and managing multi-discipline teams.

• Strong presentation and organizational skills.

Even Better:

• Experience with:

• Earned Value Management System (EVMS)

• Risk and Opportunity Management

• Developing integrated Master Schedules

• Proficiency in all Microsoft Office applications including but not limited to MS Project, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $200,000 - $250,000

The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

STR is a growing technology company with locations near Boston, MA, Arlington, VA, near Dayton, OH, Melbourne, FL, Carlsbad, CA, Atlanta, GA, and Denver, CO. We specialize in advanced research and development for defense, intelligence, and national security in: cyber; next generation sensors, radar, sonar, communications, and electronic warfare; and artificial intelligence algorithms and analytics to make sense of the complexity that is exploding around us.

STR is committed to creating a collaborative learning environment that supports deep technical understanding and recognizes the contributions and achievements of all team members. Our work is challenging, and we go home at night knowing that we pushed the envelope of technology and made the world safer.

STR is not just any company. Our people, culture, and attitude along with their unique set of skills, experiences, and perspectives put us on a trajectory to change the world. We can't do it alone, though - we need fellow trailblazers. If you are one, join our team and help to keep our society safe! Visit us at www.str.us for more info.

STR is an equal opportunity employer. We are fully dedicated to hiring the most qualified candidate regardless of race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation and pregnancy), marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

If you need a reasonable accommodation for any portion of the employment process, email us at appassist@str.us and provide your contact info.

Pursuant to applicable federal law and regulations, positions at STR require employees to obtain national security clearances and satisfy the requirements for compliance with export control and other applicable laws.

jobs.title: Online Data Analyst Kosovo
jobs.description:
TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands.

Millions of people rely on digital maps every day to navigate, to discover, to find their way. But maps are only as accurate as the data behind them, and data is only as trustworthy as the people who verify it. Your knowledge of Kosovo's geography, local landmarks, and how people actually navigate your region is something no algorithm can fully replicate. That local intelligence is what makes maps genuinely useful.

A Day in the Life of an Online Data Analyst

In this role, you will conduct structured quality audits on spatial and mapping datasets. Your role is to verify, evaluate, and validate complex geographic and business information using advanced mapping tools and detailed reference materials.

• Conduct structured quality audits on spatial datasets using mapping platforms, search directories, and GIS-standard evaluation tools
• Evaluate and cross-reference complex business, geographic, and cultural data entries against multiple authoritative sources
• Perform root-cause analysis when spatial data points conflict across sources, documenting the discrepancy with precise reasoning
• Apply detailed evaluation frameworks with consistency and rigor across dozens of geographic, business, and cultural data variations
• Be open to work across a diverse set of Task Types (e.g. Maps, News, Audio tasks, Relevance)
• Provide structured feedback that helps refine mapping algorithms and improve geographic intelligence

Why this matters: Accurately verified mapping data prevents real-world navigation errors. Your verification work ensures people can reliably find critical services, reach trusted businesses, and navigate with confidence. At scale, this is infrastructure work that is foundational to how billions of people interact with geographic information.

Why join the project:

• Fully remote flexibility: Complete work from anywhere with stable internet, structuring your schedule around academic research, consulting, or other professional commitments
• Structured onboarding: Access comprehensive evaluation guidelines, detailed reference materials, and practical examples before your first live assessment
• Direct feedback and growth: Receive performance assessments tied to quality metrics so you can refine your evaluation precision
• Intellectually rigorous work: Each evaluation requires methodical reasoning, framework interpretation, and structured discrepancy analysis.
• Responsive support team: Contact dedicated contributor operations staff for clarification on guidelines, technical issues, or administrative questions

Qualification path

Requirements:

• Professional fluency in English and Albanian (native or near-native proficiency required)
• Residency in Kosvo country for the last 5 consecutive years
• Being open to work across a diverse set of Task Types (e.g. Maps, News, Audio tasks, Relevance)
• Advanced analytical thinking and methodical problem-solving ability
• Deep regional, cultural, and geographic knowledge of Kosovo
• Comfort with rigorous guideline interpretation and consistent framework application
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in analytical, technical, or research disciplines (strongly preferred)
• Stable internet connection and access to a personal computer

Qualification path

• Complete your contributor profile and submit a brief background overview
• Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process
• Review the open-book study guide and evaluation framework (provided in your welcome materials)

Please be aware that you may be required to rate tasks that relate to data from other countries or territories where the same language is spoken.

Service Rates

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

Compensation (optional)

Year of Birth

Country Origin

jobs.description:
ABOUT F. SCHUMACHER & Co.

F. Schumacher & Co., also known as FSCO, is the parent company of many brands within our portfolio. Our family‐owned company is synonymous with style, taste and innovation. Our collections are comprehensive, with an extraordinary range united by respect for classicism, an eye for the cutting edge, and an unparalleled level of quality. Schumacher designs and produces some of the most beautiful fabrics, wall coverings, trims, furniture, and accessories in the world. Our portfolio of products is broad, but they are united by a passion for design, a thirst for what’s next, an appreciation for what’s come before, and a drive to make things with enormous care and attention to detail. Schumacher has a myriad of showrooms in the United States and internationally, as well as a best-in-class website. But don’t be fooled! While we celebrate our storied heritage, we operate like a 134-year‐old startup. Our talented team is innovative and dynamic, and our culture is progressive and fun. In order continue our success; we are always looking for talented people that fit.

F. Schumacher & Co.is America’s leading name for designing and distributing fabric, wall covering, floor covering, and furnishings. We are as equally passionate about being a style leader as we are about being on the forefront of technology, constantly pushing boundaries and striving for excellence. We are driven by a shared belief that design has the ability to transform our lives: It can challenge convention, bring a unique point of view into the world, and it leaves a lasting mark.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Rocky Mountain Account Executive serves as a brand ambassador for the FSCO portfolio across Idaho, Wyoming, Montana, Aspen, and Vail, cultivating lasting relationships with leading interior designers, architects, and developers while driving growth across fabric, wallcovering, rugs, and trim. This is a highly field-focused, relationship-driven role requiring approximately 50% travel to meet with clients in person, understand their needs, present thoughtfully curated product solutions, and identify opportunities across Schumacher, Patterson Flynn, Tillett Textiles, and Backdrop.

Working collaboratively with our inside sales team to own and grow a shared portfolio of accounts, the Account Executive acts as a trusted advisor to the design community—bringing strong sales instincts, an appreciation for great design, and the ability to translate relationships into meaningful business growth.

Account Executive Responsibilities

Territory Ownership

• Develop and grow sales across Schumacher, Patterson Flynn, Tillett Textiles, and Backdrop, spanning fabric, wallcovering, trim, and rugs within your geographic territory.

• Cultivate a strategic view of your territory, including leading firms, rising design studios, dormant accounts ready for reactivation, new business opportunities, and the trade events that shape the market.

• Know your client. Develop a strong understanding of each firm’s aesthetic, project mix, and business needs, and use that knowledge to thoughtfully curate each meeting—knowing which brands, categories, and products to lead with to make every client interaction relevant and impactful.

• Consistently meet monthly, quarterly, and annual sales plans across all brands and categories, taking shared ownership with your sales partners for the strategy and execution required to achieve them.

• Main areas of travel (with additional cities possible as territory grows):

• Colorado: Aspen, Vail

• Idaho: Boise, Sun Valley

• Montana: Bozeman, Big Sky, Missoula, Whitefish

• Wyoming: Jackson

Relationship Building

• Be present in the field, including designer offices, project sites, industry events, designer dinners, and other relevant events and gatherings.

• Develop trusted advisor relationships with principal designers, junior staff, purchasing teams, and other key contacts across your accounts.

• Become an extension of your clients’ firms—a trusted resource they regularly turn to for project needs, product expertise, and new opportunities to support and grow their business.

• Serve as a brand ambassador within the local design community, representing FSCO and its portfolio with professionalism, warmth, strong product knowledge, and a genuine passion for design.

Lead Generation & Cross-Sell

• Generate qualified opportunities across every brand and category, partnering with your inside colleagues to bring each opportunity through to close.

• Provide clear briefs, relevant designer and project context, and timely follow-through so the inside team can execute effectively.

• Identify natural cross-sell opportunities across the portfolio. Every Schumacher account is a potential Patterson Flynn rug opportunity, every Tillett project may present a custom rug specification, and every wallcovering installation may create a trim opportunity. Bring the full portfolio into client conversations thoughtfully and strategically.

Curation & Product Storytelling

• Curate the sample story for each account with thoughtful consideration of the firm’s aesthetic, current projects, and clients.

• Lead project shops, line shows, and in-person presentations with clarity, taste, and confidence.

• Act as a knowledgeable brand ambassador, staying deeply current on product launches, collaborations, brand stories, and trends across the portfolio.

Pipeline & Partnership

• Use FSCO’s CRM, sample tools, and reporting platforms with discipline, maintaining clean, accurate, and current account records.

• Partner closely with your inside team as equal collaborators, recognizing the distinct expertise each person brings to the account. Clear communication, mutual respect, and shared ownership are essential to the work.

• Communicate progress, blockers, opportunities, and pipeline status to your Managing Director and inside partners on a regular cadence.

REQUIREMENTS

Experience & Skills

• 3–5+ years of outside sales experience, ideally within luxury, interior design, home furnishings, or the trade.

• Proven ability to build and grow a territory through relationship development, strategic prospecting, and consistent follow-through.

• Demonstrated success setting and achieving sales goals, influencing purchasing decisions, and identifying opportunities to grow business within existing and prospective accounts.

• Multi-line or multi-category sales experience, or a clear track record of quickly mastering complex product assortments.

• Strong territory and time-management skills, with the ability to strategically plan client visits, travel, prospecting, and follow-up across a large geographic region.

• Ability to work independently in the field while collaborating closely with inside sales partners to deliver an exceptional client experience.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with a polished, professional, and warm presence across all levels of a client organization.

• Comfort using digital tools to manage relationships and drive business, including CRM systems (Odoo or comparable), Microsoft Office, Instagram, and email marketing platforms.

• Willingness and ability to travel approximately 50% of the time, including regular overnight travel throughout the territory.

• Dependable transportation, a clean driving record, and a willingness to travel throughout your territory, including comfort driving in winter weather conditions.

• Bachelor’s degree preferred; relevant experience and a strong track record of success may be considered in place of formal credentials.

Who You Are

• A salesperson with great taste. You have a genuine eye for design and an appreciation for color, scale, texture, and materials.

• A natural connector. You are energized by being in the field, meeting people, cultivating new relationships, and deepening existing ones.

• Polished, warm, and professional. You can confidently engage with principal designers and firm leadership while remaining approachable and collaborative with junior designers, purchasing teams, and support staff.

• A proactive business developer. You are always looking for the next opportunity—whether that means opening a new account, expanding an existing relationship, or introducing a client to a category they have yet to explore.

• Collaborative and team-oriented. You thrive as an equal partner within a shared account team, working closely with your SSR and Account Manager toward common goals. You value the expertise and contributions of your teammates, communicate openly, and understand that each person plays a distinct and equally important role in growing the business and delivering an exceptional client experience.

• Driven and positive. You bring energy, curiosity, resilience, and grace to every interaction.

• Self-directed, organized, and dependable. You take ownership of your calendar, territory, pipeline, and follow-through without needing constant direction.

• Adaptable and comfortable with change. You can manage competing priorities, pivot quickly, and thrive in an environment where no two days look exactly the same.

• Genuinely passionate about design. You light up when you walk into a beautifully designed room and enjoy helping designers discover products that make their work even better.

• Invested in long-term growth. You want to build relationships, develop a market, and grow a territory—not simply hit a quota.

Benefits Package

Your well-being is our top priority. Our benefits and total compensation are designed for the whole person, caring for both you and your family.

jobs.title: Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Pantera Capital is the first institutional investment firm focused exclusively on bitcoin, other digital currencies, and companies in the blockchain tech ecosystem. Pantera launched the first cryptocurrency fund in the United States in 2013. The firm subsequently launched the first exclusively-blockchain venture fund. In 2017, Pantera was the first firm to offer an early-stage token fund. Pantera manages $3.5bn across three strategies – passive, hedge, and venture – exclusively focused on bitcoin, other digital currencies, and companies in the blockchain tech ecosystem.

Pantera is hiring an Operations Analyst to assist with fund operations & automation. This role requires presence at least 3 days a week in our San Juan office.

Responsibilities:

Daily Books

• Run the morning position reconciliation: pull the breaks, sort each into timing, known standing item, or needs a look, and write up the ones that need a decision.

• Draft trade bookings for review: exchange and OTC fills, staking income, vesting unlocks and fees. Venture deals, token conversions and write-offs come later, once the routine bookings are second nature.

Cash and Wires

• Tag and reconcile bank activity with Finance (about 1,000 rows a month).

• Match deal wires to their approvals, flag any wire that has not been booked, and draft wire approval requests for sign-off.

Month-End and Audit

• Support the close: maintain the pricing checklist, chase and document mark sources, and prepare the tie-out to the fund administrator for review.

• Prepare and track annual audit confirmations with the auditors and counterparties.

Automation and AI

• Use our AI coding agents every day. Review what they propose, and flag anything that looks wrong before it reaches the books.

• Write and maintain runbooks so every task can be repeated without help. With guidance, turn repeat steps into small Python and SQL scripts.

Counterparties and Inbox

• Handle routine requests with custodians, prime brokers, trading venues and staking providers (statements, balance confirmations, address whitelisting), and escalate anything non-routine.

• Triage the shared operations inbox: route what needs action and file the rest.

Qualifications:

• 0–2 years in fund operations, fund administration, audit, trading operations or a similar analyst role. Strong new graduates are welcome.

• Comfortable in Excel and able to write basic SQL queries. Some Python, or clear evidence that you pick up tools quickly.

• Careful with numbers. You check your own work before you hand it in.

• Clear, precise writing. You can explain a break in three sentences.

• A controls mindset. You ask before guessing, and you would rather flag something than "just book it to clear the rec."

• Interest in crypto: you have used a wallet, read a block explorer, or followed a token launch.

• Exposure to pandas, Jupyter or Git.

• Coursework or an internship in accounting, fund administration or audit.

Compensation:
$50,000 - $65,000 USD*

*Compensation range is provided as an estimate and will be determined based on the candidate's experience and qualifications.

jobs.title: Vertical Sales Strategy and Operations
jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re looking for someone to join our Sales Strategy & Operations team and own how ElevenLabs goes to market by vertical. As we shift from a horizontal motion to a vertical-led one, you will go deep on each of our top verticals — the buyer, the use cases, the competitive landscape, and what it takes to win — and turn that into a repeatable playbook for launching and scaling each one.

As part of the Revenue Operations team, you'll sit at the center of the vertical GTM motion, working with Product Marketing, Forward Deployed Engineering, Product, and Sales leadership to define each vertical's strategy, surface product gaps, and drive cross-functional alignment until every vertical is launched and performing. This is a role for someone who wants to shape a new market from the ground up, not maintain an existing one.

In this role, you will be responsible for:

 - Vertical Deep Dives - Own the research and strategy for each top vertical: market sizing, ICP and persona definition, buying process, priority use cases, competitive positioning, and where ElevenLabs wins.

 - Vertical Launches - Run the end-to-end launch of each vertical, from strategy and segmentation through enablement, pipeline targets, and post-launch performance reviews.

 - Cross-Functional Alignment - Drive alignment across PMM, FDE, Product, Sales, and Marketing on vertical priorities, owners, and timelines. Be the single thread that keeps every function moving in the same direction.

 - Product Needs - Dig deep into what each vertical requires from the product — integrations, compliance, features, workflows, and translate field signal into prioritized, evidence-backed requirements for Product.

 - Data-Driven Strategy - Define the metrics that matter for each vertical (pipeline, win rate, ACV, sales cycle, product adoption), build the dashboards, and use the insights to decide where to double down or pull back.

 - Leadership Partnership - Serve as a trusted advisor to Sales and GTM leadership on where to invest by vertical, with clear recommendations and regular performance reporting.
   
   

Who you are

We're looking for exceptional individuals who combine technical excellence with ethical awareness, who are excited by hard problems and motivated by human impact. You’ll strive with us if you:

 - Are passionate about audio AI driven by a desire to make content universally accessible and breaking the frontiers of new tech.

 - Are a highly motivated and driven individual with a strong work ethic. Our team is aware of this critical moment of audio AI evolution and is committed to going the extra mile to lead.

 - Are analytical, efficient, and strive on solving complex challenges with a first principles mindset.

 - Consistently strive for excellence, delivering high-quality work quickly and exceeding expectations.

 - Take initiative and work autonomously from day one, prioritizing learning and contribution while leaving ego aside.
   
   

What you bring

 - 4+ years in Sales Strategy & Operations or GTM strategy, ideally with experience building or launching a vertical GTM motion

 - Proven track record of taking an ambiguous strategic question to a structured answer, then driving execution across teams.

 - Deep curiosity about industries — you enjoy learning how a healthcare, financial services, or retail buyer actually operates and what they need

 - Strong analytical skills, with proven expertise in SQL and data visualization using BI tools (e.g. Sigma)

 - Excellent communication and influence skills, with the ability to align Product, Marketing, and Sales leaders without direct authority.

 - Highly adaptable, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and comfort operating in a fast-moving, undefined space.

 - Strong coachability and willingness to learn and adapt to new challenges.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Partnerships Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for someone to join our Revenue Strategy & Operations team to play a key role in building the operational backbone behind our partner ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of technical problem-solving and operational excellence. You'll own the systems, automations, data, and dashboards that help our Partnerships team source, co-sell, and scale revenue through resellers, referral partners, technology partners, and strategic alliances.

Each Revenue Strategy & Operations team member is a dedicated partner to a specific go-to-market function. In this role, you'll be the strategic and operational counterpart to Partnerships leadership. You'll also work closely with Sales, Account Management, Finance, Data, and Product to make partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue visible, measurable, and repeatable.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Partner Lifecycle & Process Management: Design, build, and maintain end-to-end processes for the partner journey, including onboarding, deal registration, lead and referral routing, co-sell workflows, and payout or commission handling. Make these processes consistent, automated, and easy to adopt.

 - Strategic Partnership to Leadership: Act as a trusted advisor to Partnerships leadership, providing performance reporting, capacity and territory planning input, partner segmentation, and recommendations on program structure and incentives.

 - Partner Attribution & Pipeline Visibility: Define and maintain how we track partner-sourced, partner-influenced, and co-sell pipeline and revenue across Salesforce and our data stack. Make sure partner contribution is accurately attributed and trusted by Sales, Finance, and leadership.

 - Reporting & Analytics: Own dashboards, reports, and KPIs for partner performance, such as pipeline generation, win rates, sales cycle, partner ROI, and tier or segment health. Turn the data into insights that guide where we invest.

 - Partner Program & Incentive Operations: Support the design, modeling, and rollout of partner programs, including tiering, rebates, referral fees, and MDF. Work with Finance and Legal to ensure accuracy and compliance.

 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Align Sales, Account Management, Marketing, Finance, and Product on how partner deals are handled, from account mapping and conflict resolution to handoffs and renewals.

 - Experimentation: Test new partner motions, lead sources, routing logic, and program levers. Measure what works and scale it.




WHO YOU ARE

We're looking for exceptional individuals who combine technical excellence with ethical awareness, who are excited by hard problems and motivated by human impact. You'll thrive with us if you:

 - Are passionate about audio AI, driven by a desire to make content universally accessible and to push the frontiers of new technology.

 - Are highly motivated, with a strong work ethic. We're at a critical moment in audio AI's evolution and committed to going the extra mile to lead.

 - Are analytical and efficient, and approach complex challenges with a first-principles mindset.

 - Consistently strive for excellence, delivering high-quality work quickly and exceeding expectations.

 - Take initiative and work autonomously from day one, prioritizing learning and contribution while leaving ego aside.

 - Are energized by working with external partners and by the ambiguity of building a program that's still scaling.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - 4+ years in Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, or Partner/Channel Operations at a high-growth technology company

 - Hands-on experience supporting partner, channel, alliance, or co-sell motions (e.g., deal registration, partner attribution, referral or reseller programs)

 - A proven track record of building end-to-end solutions, from data collection and analysis through execution

 - Strong Salesforce experience, including objects, reporting, and process design for partner-related workflows

 - Strong analytical skills, with proven expertise in SQL and data visualization using BI tools (e.g., Sigma)

 - The ability to break complex problems into smaller, actionable steps

 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across internal teams and external partners

 - A highly adaptable, proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement

 - Coachability and a willingness to learn and adapt to new challenges

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.
