jobs.title: Senior Service Delivery Manager, IT
jobs.description:
Founded in 1999, Audax Group is a leading alternative investment manager with offices in Boston, New York, San Francisco, London and Hong Kong. With approximately $42 billion of assets under management and more than 475 employees, Audax is a leading capital partner for middle market companies, operating through three business lines: Audax Private Equity, Audax Private Debt, and Audax Strategic Capital.

For more information, visit www.audaxgroup.com or follow Audax Group on LinkedIn.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Sr. Manager, Service Delivery is responsible for leading and continuously improving the firm's IT service delivery and end-user support function.  This process-driven, customer-focused leader will oversee day-to-day support operations, establish consistent service-management practices, manage service levels and performance, and foster accountability and continuous improvement.

The role serves as the operational owner of Freshservice and uses service data, automation, knowledge, self-service, and AI-enabled capabilities to improve operational performance and the employee experience.  The Sr. Manager, Service Delivery will partner closely with Cloud & Endpoint, Security Operations, and Asset & Vendor Management on complex escalations and shared processes while remaining primarily focused on service leadership, process discipline, and service transformation.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Service Delivery

• Lead end-user support operations across Audax offices, providing a consistent, high-quality service experience for executives, investment professionals, and firmwide staff.

• Oversee ticket queues, workloads, escalations, staffing, schedules, coverage, and service risks to ensure work is appropriately prioritized and completed.

• Identify capacity, coverage, or service-delivery gaps and implement or recommend corrective action.

IT Service Management / Freshservice

• Own Freshservice as the firm's service-management platform and system of record, including platform adoption, data quality, reporting, workflows, and automation. Govern platform configuration and administration, directing a designated administrator within the IT Operations team for hands-on changes.

• Establish and continuously improve standards for ticket lifecycle management, incidents, requests, problems, approvals, escalations, and service levels.

• Govern the service catalog, self-service experience, knowledge management, and repeatable workflows such as onboarding, offboarding, access, hardware, and software requests.

• Ensure Freshservice change, access, onboarding, and offboarding records are complete and audit-ready in partnership with Information Security Risk (SOC 1 IT controls).

Reporting, SLAs and Service Quality

• Establish and manage SLAs, OLAs, KPIs, experience measures, and service-performance standards aligned with business expectations.

• Develop dashboards and analyze service data to identify trends, recurring issues, resource constraints, employee friction, and opportunities for improvement.

• Lead recurring service reviews that translate operational data into corrective actions and measurable improvement initiatives.

Process Improvement, Automation and AI

• Standardize and continuously improve IT Operations processes, workflows, documentation, self-service, and knowledge practices.

• Maintain a prioritized service-improvement and automation roadmap based on service volume, employee experience, cycle time, operational risk, and business value.

• Evaluate, pilot, and operate practical uses of automation and AI that improve service quality, employee experience, technician productivity, and operational efficiency.

Incident and Problem Management

• Lead operational coordination of major incidents and significant service disruptions, engaging the appropriate technical teams while maintaining ownership of service restoration and stakeholder coordination. Security incidents are led by Security Operations, with Service Delivery coordinating restoration and communications.

• Develop timely firmwide service communications and concise status updates for IT leadership and business stakeholders.

• Lead post-incident reviews and problem-management activities to identify root causes, recurring issues, and corrective actions.

Team Leadership and Development

• Lead and manage IT Operations staff, including engineers and co-ops, setting clear performance expectations, and coach and develop them through regular feedback, performance management, training, mentoring, and professional development.

• Strengthen team capabilities through cross-training, knowledge sharing, skills development, and succession planning.

COMPETENCIES:

• IT Service Management and enterprise ITSM platforms, preferably Freshservice.

• People leadership, coaching, and performance management.

• Service analytics, SLAs, KPIs, XLAs, reporting, and continuous improvement.

• Process improvement, workflow automation, self-service, knowledge management, and AI-enabled service capabilities.

• Executive-level communication and customer service in a high-expectation environment.

• Technical fluency sufficient to manage enterprise support operations and coordinate complex technical escalations.

REQUIREMENTS/QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

• 7+ years of progressive experience in IT service delivery, IT Operations, IT Service Management, end-user support, or a related discipline, preferably within a high-touch professional services environment.

• Demonstrated experience managing an IT support or service-delivery team across multiple locations.

• Experience owning or administering an enterprise ITSM platform such as Freshservice, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or similar.

• Experience developing service levels, operational reporting, process improvements, workflow automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Strong leadership, analytical, organizational, communication, change-management, and customer-service skills.

• Availability outside normal business hours for significant incidents or escalations may be required.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• ITIL 4 certification or equivalent service management credential.

• Hands-on Freshservice administration experience.

• Experience in financial services, private equity, or another regulated, high-touch professional services environment.

LOCATION: Boston, MA – Hybrid 4 days in-office. These in-office requirements may be adjusted based on the needs of the business.

TRAVEL: Some domestic travel to the New York and San Francisco offices is required.

For Massachusetts: The base salary range for this position is $140,000 - $160,000. The base salary range represents the estimated low and high end for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation may vary and will be determined based on but not limited to, the skills, qualifications, and experience of the applicant along with the requirements of the position, and Audax reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. An employee may also be eligible for annual discretionary incentive compensation based on performance.

Audax offers a wide range of employee benefits, including health insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, paid time off (including sick leave, parental leave, volunteer leave, and vacation), charitable donation match, family support services (including Bright Horizons and Benefit Advocate Center), and a 401(k) in addition to other benefits.

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

Audax Management Co. is an equal opportunity employer.

Please note that Audax Group and its affiliated entities do not accept unsolicited resumes from a third-party recruiting agency not currently under a signed agreement. Any unsolicited resume that is sent to directly to Audax Group or one of its affiliated entities, or its employees, including those submitted to hiring managers by a third-party recruiting agency not currently under a signed agreement, will be considered property of Audax Group. If a third-party recruiting agency submits a resume without an agreement, Audax Group or its affiliated entities explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the third-party recruiting agency. Any third-party recruiting agency should contact either a member of the Talent Acquisition or Human Resource team at Audax Group, in conjunction with a valid, fully executed contract for service based upon a specific job opening.

jobs.title: Revenue Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
ABOUT SAVVY WEALTH:

Wealth management is a $545 billion industry that still runs on manual work. 75% of advisors offer no digital communication beyond email, and most still build financial plans by hand in Excel. Savvy is reinventing what it looks like to be a financial advisor. Founder Ritik Malhotra saw the fragmentation firsthand after seeking out his own advisor, and started Savvy to give independent advisors a modern, AI-native home.



Savvy is a registered investment advisor (RIA), and we partner with experienced financial advisors who want to grow without running the back office themselves. Advisors bring their book and join Savvy, running under their own brand (or ours), and Savvy earns a percentage of the assets they manage. In return, they get a true business-in-a-box: a proprietary tech platform and client portal, an in-house marketing team that helps them grow, a world-class investment management team, and a dedicated client services team that runs day-to-day operations and support. Advisors at Savvy service up to 50% more households and save 19 hours a week.



AI runs through everything we do. On the product side, Savvy Intelligence (released April 2026) is the only AI built for wealth managers that can see a client's complete financial picture. Internally, everyone at Savvy uses Claude and is encouraged to experiment with it, backed by a dedicated AI enablement team and a RevOps org building agents in-house.



The trajectory is steep and it's still early. We're a Series C company with 170+ people, $200M raised, and $100M ARR in sight this year. Inc. ranked us the No. 1 fastest-growing financial services company in America in 2026. Come build the next stage with us!



Recognition:

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for our culture and our growth:

 - Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2026)

 - Fortune Best Workplaces in New York™ (2026)

 - Great Place to Work Certified™ 
   
   

The Role:

Revenue Operations at Savvy is entering a new era. We've built the foundation: the CRM infrastructure, pipeline tooling, and an early AI-native analytics layer. Now we need a sharp, technical operator to take ownership of that foundation and scale it.

As Senior Revenue Operations Manager, you'll be the primary operational partner to our sales team. You'll sit closest to our AEs, SDRs, and sales leadership of anyone on the RevOps team, translating what the business needs into the systems, data, and processes that make the sales motion work. This means owning the operational layer end-to-end: territory design, pipeline governance, data hygiene, analytics, and the Salesforce infrastructure that holds it all together. You'll be expected to move fast, earn trust with the sales org, and build things that last.

Responsibilities:

 - Own pipeline stage governance and CRM data hygiene end-to-end: define stage definitions and entry/exit criteria, build enforcement mechanisms in Salesforce, and drive toward 95% hygiene adherence. Define and maintain rules of engagement for lead ownership, nurture policies, and routing logic in partnership with sales leadership

 - Lead new tool assessments with a focus on AI-native GTM solutions: evaluate the landscape, build and test AI-native workflows and agents, make structured recommendations, and implement what gets approved

 - Own the GTM analytics layer for the sales motion: build and maintain pipeline and win rate analysis (SQO-to-close conversion by AE, segment, and period), real-time revenue dashboards with ARR and deal metrics, and ad hoc analyses for sales leadership and RevOps. Contribute to WBR and QBR data preparation

Develop brand communication and design concepts that meet the business objectives of the organization and that advance our brand and proposition strategy.

Shape, articulate and execute on billups brand vision to drive and elevate design initiatives. Co-shape the big business ideas to be developed and ensure the design framework and vision is understood by all interested parties.

 

Core Role Duties:

 - Create content & brand design. Produce clear, on-brand materials across formats — presentations, marketing content, event materials, and print. Build and maintain branded templates that keep quality consistent and production efficient.

 - Manage multiple projects at once and guide creative teams. Often under compressed timelines, work to produce multiple high-quality deliverables within scope and inspire, lead and instruct team members. A successful candidate will be able to lead as a thought partner to project owners, and work under tight deadlines while maintaining a high standard of excellence.

ABOUT SAVVY WEALTH:

Wealth management is a $545 billion industry that still runs on manual work. 75% of advisors offer no digital communication beyond email, and most still build financial plans by hand in Excel. Savvy is reinventing what it looks like to be a financial advisor. Founder Ritik Malhotra saw the fragmentation firsthand after seeking out his own advisor, and started Savvy to give independent advisors a modern, AI-native home.



Savvy is a registered investment advisor (RIA), and we partner with experienced financial advisors who want to grow without running the back office themselves. Advisors bring their book and join Savvy, running under their own brand (or ours), and Savvy earns a percentage of the assets they manage. In return, they get a true business-in-a-box: a proprietary tech platform and client portal, an in-house marketing team that helps them grow, a world-class investment management team, and a dedicated client services team that runs day-to-day operations and support. Advisors at Savvy service up to 50% more households and save 19 hours a week.



AI runs through everything we do. On the product side, Savvy Intelligence (released April 2026) is the only AI built for wealth managers that can see a client's complete financial picture. Internally, everyone at Savvy uses Claude and is encouraged to experiment with it, backed by a dedicated AI enablement team and a RevOps org building agents in-house.



The trajectory is steep and it's still early. We're a Series C company with 170+ people, $200M raised, and $100M ARR in sight this year. Inc. ranked us the No. 1 fastest-growing financial services company in America in 2026. Come build the next stage with us!



Recognition:

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for our culture and our growth:

 - Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2026)

 - Fortune Best Workplaces in New York™ (2026)

 - Great Place to Work Certified™ 
   
   

The Role:

The Product Manager role is a high-impact role. You will operate in a very dynamic environment where you’ll get to proactively identify market opportunities across the business and lead the product direction & strategy to tackle them.

You will play a critical role in identifying market opportunities to expand value to existing customers and build new product lines. ABOUT JUNIPER SQUARE

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. ABOUT SAVVY WEALTH:

Wealth management is a $545 billion industry that still runs on manual work. 75% of advisors offer no digital communication beyond email, and most still build financial plans by hand in Excel. Savvy is reinventing what it looks like to be a financial advisor. Founder Ritik Malhotra saw the fragmentation firsthand after seeking out his own advisor, and started Savvy to give independent advisors a modern, AI-native home.



Savvy is a registered investment advisor (RIA), and we partner with experienced financial advisors who want to grow without running the back office themselves. Advisors bring their book and join Savvy, running under their own brand (or ours), and Savvy earns a percentage of the assets they manage. In return, they get a true business-in-a-box: a proprietary tech platform and client portal, an in-house marketing team that helps them grow, a world-class investment management team, and a dedicated client services team that runs day-to-day operations and support. Advisors at Savvy service up to 50% more households and save 19 hours a week.



AI runs through everything we do. On the product side, Savvy Intelligence (released April 2026) is the only AI built for wealth managers that can see a client's complete financial picture. jobs.title: Pretrial Associate - Brooklyn
jobs.description:
PRETRIAL ASSOCIATE (Brooklyn)

New York City Criminal Justice Agency (CJA)

Posted: 10/9/2026

Do you have a passion and desire to help New York City reduce jail overcrowding and unnecessary detention?

Can you make a commitment to helping justice-involved people through the complex court system?

Join our team of professionals seeking to improve the experience of justice involved individuals in the NYC Courts!

ABOUT CJA

The New York City Criminal Justice Agency (CJA) is a not-for-profit service and research organization that operates in partnership with the New York City Mayor’s Office of Criminal Justice.  CJA is the City’s main pretrial services agency, combining operations, pilot projects, and research under one roof.  CJA utilizes procedural justice practices to provide pretrial services to over 100,000 arrested annually in New York City. Information collected about these arrestees and subsequent case processing is maintained in the agency’s internal and externally shared database systems, which are used to conduct descriptive and evaluation research on arrestee characteristics, case processing and court outcomes, and on issues and potential reforms to criminal justice policy in New York City. CJA’s programs operate in the criminal courts and detention facilities 24 hours a day seven days a week within the 5 boroughs of NYC, employing over 300 employees, citywide.

About the Position

Pretrial Associates (PTAs) are integral to the work we do in the courts and Central Booking. With staff working 24/7 in each of the city's centralized courthouses, CJA interviews nearly all individuals held in custody before they see a judge and makes a release recommendation to the court.  We assist people who have been arrested, as well as their families, in navigating the bail payment process to facilitate their release from court before admission to DOC facilities.

Primary Responsibilities

Client/Customer Service & Communications:

• Thoroughly and compassionately interviews recently arrested individuals in Central Booking locations in all boroughs to determine community ties. The information gathered plays a major role in the CJA’s recommendation to release them without bail.

• Conducts telephone verifications of the information the individuals provide, such as address, employment, possible sureties, and other factors which play an important role in the individual's opportunity to receive a recommendation for Release on Recognizance (ROR).

• Explain bail payment procedures and assist sureties with the bail payment process.

Attention to Detail & Organization:

• Accurately record the interview responses into the Agency’s computerized database.

• Determine release recommendation for individuals using CJA’s standardized release assessment, which combines criminal history factors and community ties information.

• Observe and monitor arraignment outcomes and assist individuals who have bail imposed.

• Participate in various interdepartmental programs, such as Bail Expediting Program, which involves identifying eligible cases and making follow up phone calls to their sureties to expedite bail payment at the courts, rather than at DOC facilities.

Teamwork & Relationship Building

• Interact respectfully with other agencies and court players, such as NYPD, DOC, NYS Court Officers, Supervised Release programs, Court Clerks, and Legal Aid to effectively facilitate court procedures and represent CJA in a professional manner.

• Contribute to and work on various innovative pilot programs implemented in the boroughs and suggest potential improvements.

Qualifications

• A high school diploma or GED and at least one year of relevant work experience are required. Candidates from all educational backgrounds and college majors are welcome to apply, with a preference for those with a background in criminal justice or a related social science field. An associate degree or higher is a plus but not required. Candidates with two or more years of comparable work experience are also encouraged to apply.

Required Skills

• Strong verbal and written communication skills

• Computer literacy, to include Microsoft applications and ability to quickly adapt to changing technology

Preferred Skills: Multilingual candidates are highly encouraged to apply (please list any fluent languages in your application)

This opportunity is ideal for an individual who has recently graduated from college or has commensurate experience.

Location: Brooklyn, NY

SALARY:  $54,114.06 + Night Shift Differential $4,329.12

The available shifts are as follows:

Evening Shift: 3PM-11PM

**Please note this role may require weekend shifts.

Note: This role is 100% in person

*Internal applicants must be 1 year in their current roles and in good standing (no disciplinary action within the last 90 days) to apply.

CJA VALUES

Each employee at CJA is guided by these values in our work:

• Commitment: We are committed to being active partners in criminal justice reform through initiatives and creative problem-solving that evaluates different methods and strategies for alternatives to detention.

• Fairness: We are guided by fairness and the presumption of innocence for those who are detained and work with integrity and without bias to protect the privacy and interest of court-involved people and their families.

• Innovation: We value curiosity as a driving force to lead the way in pretrial services. We use innovative techniques in research, pilot programs, and engaging justice-involved communities to execute our mission of reducing unnecessary pretrial detention.

BENEFITS: CJA offers a very generous benefit plan including health, dental and vision insurance, a comprehensive mental health, and wellness, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) plan, four weeks’ vacation, paid holidays, and a retirement plan with employer matching contributions.  CJA is also strongly committed to professional learning and development for its staff members and offers staff varied opportunities for learning and development through partnerships and vendor services for web based, in-person professional development training, as well as in-house job training and development.

Note: Only those candidates being considered will be contacted.

CJA is seeking applicants who pursue professional development pathways by participating in educational opportunities, reading professional publications, maintaining professional networks, and engaging with professional associations

The New York City Criminal Justice Agency is an Equal Opportunity Employer

CJA is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, sex, gender identity, religion, sexual orientation, age, disability, parental status, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. We encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply.

THE ROLE:

Savvy's introducing broker-dealer is live, but the trading desk operation underneath it is still a work in progress. Trade supervision, best execution review, and principal-level sign-off have been handled ad hoc, split across a few people without a dedicated senior owner. As Sr. Brokerage Operations Manager, you'll be the licensed principal of record for trading activity and the primary operations counterpart to our General Counsel/CCO. This is a senior, high-visibility role: you'll operate as a peer to Legal/Compliance and Business Operations.




RESPONSIBILITIES:




TRADING DESK LEADERSHIP

 - Build and own Savvy's trading desk operation end-to-end — trade lifecycle, execution quality, and best execution review — as the function's senior owner

 - Serve as the licensed principal (Series 7/24) of record for trading activity, holding personal sign-off authority on trades, account actions, and exceptions requiring principal review

 - Design and run Savvy's best execution program, holding Fidelity (and future execution venues) accountable to execution quality standards

 - Own CAT/CAIS and Rule 605/606 regulatory trade reporting

 - Drive AI/automation opportunities across the trading desk and back office — reducing manual reconciliation, exception detection, and compliance documentation — with a bias toward building rather than scaling headcount


REGULATORY & PRINCIPAL OVERSIGHT

 - Serve as CCO's primary operations counterpart on broker-dealer regulatory matters

 - Resolve open licensing and supervisory-control ambiguities (e.g., manual vs. API-based account entry, principal pre-approval parameters) into documented, auditable policy

 - Own FINRA examination readiness: supervisory review documentation, WSP maintenance, and audit-trail/document-versioning infrastructure

 - Personally own escalation and disclosure decisions on regulatory-adjacent issues — late reviews, trade breaks above threshold, unusual trading patterns

 - Experience building document versioning or audit-trail infrastructure


ACCOUNT, CASHIERING & COMPLIANCE OPERATIONS

 - Own the strategic design of account and cashiering operations — money movement approvals, wire approvals, AML alert escalation, account restriction management

 - Partner with Legal & Compliance on FINRA/audit requests, complaint reporting, and escheatment tracking

 - Own the Fidelity relationship and vendor management for broker-dealer operations, transitioning fully from Rohan over time




MUST HAVE:

 - 6-8+ years of broker-dealer operations experience, including having personally built a brokerage/trading operations function from scratch (e.g., at an RIA custodian, broker-dealer, or clearing firm)

 - Series 7, 63 and 24 licenses

 - Deep knowledge of the trade lifecycle, best execution, and regulatory trade reporting (CAT/CAIS, Rule 605/606)

 - Comfortable operating as a senior peer to Legal/Compliance and company leadership — presents and defends decisions directly, doesn't need managing

 - Experience preparing for or supporting a FINRA/SEC examination

 - High comfort with ambiguity — this function and its controls are being built from scratch

 - AI-first builder mindset with a track record of automating manual ops work rather than scaling through headcount

THE ROLE:

Savvy is hiring its first Legal Operations Associate to refine and mature its legal and compliance function. As a registered RIA and broker-dealer, we have a growing list of FINRA and SEC obligations. Savvy's rapid growth has driven a corresponding surge in compliance and contract volume, outpacing the administrative capacity available to manage it.

You'll take ad hoc, attorney-owned administrative work and turn it into clear, repeatable, AI-enabled processes. This will include overseeing the contract lifecycle, vendor due diligence, legal request intake, the ADV and compliance calendars, advisor compliance, and outside counsel spend. You'll work closely with the General Counsel and leadership and have real freedom to design your own systems and use AI tools from day one. Broker-dealer experience is a plus.


RESPONSIBILITIES:


CONTRACT & VENDOR MANAGEMENT

 - Own the full vendor lifecycle: due diligence, a negotiation playbook and template library to keep terms consistent across similar vendors, and a version-controlled contract repository

 - Run vendor due diligence, including a single source of truth vendor inventory, risk-tiering all vendors (prioritizing those handling PII), and managing annual security questionnaires

 - Own version control for all advisor- and client-facing agreements so all contracting is uniform and up to date

 - Review first-pass redlines and handle routine agreements (e.g., NDAs, standard vendor contracts) using the playbook, and escalate to counsel when required


LEGAL & COMPLIANCE INTAKE

 - Design and oversee the intake and escalation process for legal and compliance requests, consolidating disparate channels into a single, organized view so all requests are tracked through resolution

 - Triage and route all questions and requests to the appropriate owner, maintaining visibility into all open items

 - Keep a running log of recurring contract and compliance questions to cut down on repeat escalations to counsel


COMPLIANCE & REGULATORY

 - Develop and own the ADV update calendar and firm-wide compliance calendar across all of Savvy’s RIA and BD obligations

 - Run the quarterly and annual IAR attestation cycle and drive near-100% on-time completion of advisor oversight compliance requirements (trade oversight, OBAs, gifts and entertainment, attestations)

 - Support regulatory filings, exams, and inspections, and track regulatory changes that affect the business

 - Translate compliance requirements into plain-language reminders and checklists for advisors


OUTSIDE COUNSEL & BUDGET

 - Review outside counsel invoices against engagement terms and flag inconsistencies

 - Track outside counsel spend against budget and give Finance a clear quarterly view, flagging variances early


AI & AUTOMATION

 - Own and maintain our Claude-based internal legal tools (such as contract playbooks and regulatory change management skills), as well as helping design additional tools to improve efficiency

 - Use AI to triage intake, draft reminders and redlines, automate repetitive tracking, and review the output before trusting it


MUST HAVE:

 - 3-5+ years of experience in legal operations, compliance, or paralegal roles within the RIA space

 - Working knowledge of SEC RIA requirements, including Form ADV, IAR oversight, and third-party/vendor oversight expectations

 - Proven experience building and owning a tracking system or process end-to-end (trackers, calendars, logs, repositories)

 - Strong attention to detail under hard deadlines and good judgment about what you can handle yourself versus what needs counsel's sign-off

 - Clear written communication and the ability to build trust across Legal, Product, Operations, and Finance teams while handling confidential information with discretion

 - Comfortable using AI tools day to day, with a habit of checking AI output before relying on it

 - Strong proficiency in Google Workspace and modern compliance and CLM tools

 - Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2026)

 - Great Place to Work Certified™ 
   
   

The Role:

The Strategic Growth team is responsible for bringing top-producing financial advisors to Savvy and plays a critical role in the company’s continued growth.

In this role you will partner closely with our SDR team, who provide top-of-funnel support by identifying and engaging prospective advisors. From there, you will own the sales process --building relationships with advisors and helping them understand how Savvy’s technology, marketing, operational support, and culture can enable them to build a stronger, more scalable wealth management business.

This is a highly consultative sale centered on influencing successful advisors to make a meaningful career and business transition. You’ll work directly with the decision-makers themselves, allowing you to build genuine relationships, navigate complex considerations, and make a visible impact on Savvy’s growth.

Responsibilities:

 - Bring top producing financial advisors with an existing book of business to Savvy by effectively selling the Savvy value proposition.

 - Partner with the SDR team to engage prospective financial advisors, inbound and outbound, and qualify them to ensure they're a strong fit. Build relationships with prospects as a business partner and help them understand the different paths to achieving their business goals.

 - Identify the key pain points a prospective financial advisor has and tailor the sales process accordingly.

 - Prepare for and run the recruiting process to showcase Savvy's technology platform, sales and marketing capabilities, and operational support to prospective financial advisors.

 - Understand a prospective advisor's pricing and compensation expectations and book-of-business transferability, and use that information to customize pricing and compensation contracts that work for both the advisor and Savvy.

 - Leverage internal tools and keep them up to date based on your sales activity.

 - Prepare for and participate in regular business reviews with the Leadership Team, sharing pipeline data, learnings, and next steps, and providing forecasts across your current pipeline and projections for future quarters.

Nuances for this role:

 - This is a quota-carrying role. Deal size ranges from $200K to $1M+ ARR, with an average time to close currently under two months.

 - This is a more humanized sale than the average technology sales process, since you're dealing directly with decision-makers. Think of every financial advisor as the CEO of their own business, this requires a heightened degree of empathy to be successful, along with the ability to make quick decisions. 

 - Consider a top producing financial advisor who's been with a firm for 10+ years. Their personal and professional identity is often tied to that firm's brand. Successfully educating an advisor and facilitating a move from their prior firm takes outstanding patience, listening, agility, and focus to get the deal done.

 - The equally demanding need for high IQ and high EQ in this role has built an incredibly high-performing, driven team with diverse backgrounds.

Must have:

 - 5+ years of relevant sales experience in quota-carrying roles

 - Experience with deal sizes of $150K to $1M ARR

 - Experience working with deal cycles ranging from 1–12 months

 - Experience selling to senior executives and owners

 - Proficiency with revenue-related technology, such as AI (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) and sales and marketing tools (e.g., LInkedIn, Outreach, Gong, etc.)

Nice to have:

 - Experience recruiting individuals through a tech-enabled platform business, a staffing agency, or as a corporate recruiter

 - Experience selling in the financial advisory / wealth management space (RIA, broker-dealer, bank) 

 - 2+ years of experience at a high-growth tech startup

jobs.title: Seasonal Sales Associate- Carlsbad
jobs.description:
Tecovas is passionate about offering an incredible customer experience for first-time boot buyers and western enthusiasts alike! As a Tecovas Seasonal Sales Associate, you will support the store leadership team through the cultivation of a store environment catering to an unmatched customer experience. You will provide exceptional service in all aspects of the sales floor - greeting customers, selling, product knowledge, cash wrap, restocking, and overall shopkeeping. Seasonal Sales Associates are responsible for outstanding customer service and demonstrating superior knowledge to customers during periods of high volume.

In order to provide our customers with the best holiday shopping experience, you will be required to be flexible with scheduling and available to work during the following:

• Extended holiday hours that may include early morning shifts, weekends, and evenings.

• Key holiday events; including the week of Thanksgiving (including the Friday after Thanksgiving), the week of Christmas (including the day after Christmas), and the week between Christmas and New Years (including New Years Day).

This is a temporary role with an expected start date in late-September 2026 and can last through early-January 2027. Opportunities to become a permanent Sales Associate may become available after the season, pending individual performance and business needs.

Responsibilities will include:

• Supports a sales-driven environment of genuine customer experience and demonstrate extraordinary service standards

• Supports store team with receiving shipment and preparing product for floor placement

• Plans for, tracks and communicates all in transit shipment information to the leadership team

• Performs customizations for customers with hands-on training

• Maintains an efficient and well-organized stockroom ensuring accessibility to employees

• Assists in and/or leads the restock process to continually maintain store stock levels

• Demonstrates loss prevention awareness through assisting in cycle counts and transfers

• Participates in ongoing staff education and through the sharing of product knowledge

• Assists in the maintenance of the building facilities

Qualifications:

• Exceptional selling skills, customer service, and clientele

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

• Independent, proactive, results-driven work ethic

• Utmost character, honesty, and transparency

Requirements:

• High School Diploma

• Must be at least 18 years of age or older

• Continually able to stand/walk for extended periods of time, and be able to reach overhead, bend, squat, and kneel as you organize and stock inventory.

• Ability to deliver excellent customer service

• Able to lift up to 30lbs regularly

• Must have reliable transportation

• Must be available to work weekends (Friday, Saturday and Sunday), evenings and holidays as needed

Part-Time Benefits:

• Competitive hourly compensation

• Holiday bonus eligibility

• Free boots and generous employee discount!

The hourly rate for this position is $17.50. The actual compensation will be based on factors such as the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience.

About Us:

Based in Austin, TX, Tecovas brings the spirit of the West to the modern consumer. Handcrafting the best Western footwear, workwear, apparel, and accessories, Tecovas has grown rapidly since its founding as the first digitally native Western brand in 2015, serving customers through www.Tecovas.com, Tecovas Stores from coast to coast, and select wholesale partners. We’re certainly growing- and hiring passionate, humble, positive, and talented people determined to help us continue to grow!

Important note: We strive to hire values-aligned people because we believe it takes each and all of us to be successful, and lead with grit, speed and a clear vision of where we’re headed. In a remote setting, interviewing at Tecovas may include phone interviews, virtual “on-site” interviews, and on-the-job mock cases. We are committed to run a thorough process for candidates with whom we identify a potential match, and we will do our best to follow-up with each and every applicant! If you’re on the fence, just give it a try!

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply! Please note: Offers of employment may be conditional pending the completion of standard onboarding procedures.

jobs.title: Events & Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT OBVIO AI

Each year, more than 40,000 people in the U.S. leave home and never make it back due to traffic crashes. At Obvio, we believe these deaths are preventable. We deploy solar-powered, AI-assisted cameras to enforce traffic laws where pedestrians are most vulnerable, automating enforcement in ways that traditional systems cannot. Our approach has already led to a 50% reduction in reckless driving in early partner cities.


Founded by the team behind Motive's AI dashcam and backed by Bain Capital Ventures and Khosla Ventures, we are building the intelligence layer for safer streets globally.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a high-agency, hands-on Events & Field Marketing Manager to build and lead our field presence from the ground up. In this role, you will own how Obvio shows up in the physical world: from public safety trade shows and municipal conferences to intimate roundtables with local officials, police chiefs, city planners, and enterprise partners.

You will bridge offline experiences with sales pipeline, brand building, and community engagement. You will evaluate where Obvio invests, design high-impact activations that stand out, negotiate contracts, and oversee end-to-end technical and physical execution on-site.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead the strategy, planning, and execution of Obvio’s field marketing calendar, directly aligning event strategy with GTM revenue targets and geographical expansion goals.

 - Evaluate, prioritize, and secure Obvio’s presence at major government expos, public safety summits, traffic safety conferences, and industry trade shows.

 - Conceptualize and launch proprietary Obvio events, including executive dinners, regional roundtables, live hardware demos, and community launch activations.

 - Own end-to-end event production: site selection, booth design, vendor management, hardware demo setups, staffing, travel logistics, and budget allocation.

 - Partner with Sales and Government Relations on target account strategy, pre-event outreach, on-site meeting schedules, and post-event lead routing.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally to create event-specific toolkits, localized marketing collateral, and interactive hardware demonstrations.

 - Establish event KPIs, track lead attribution and deliver clear post-event performance reporting to GTM leadership.

 - Build repeatable, scalable field playbooks to support rapid company growth across new markets.

 - Identify and secure high-impact speaking opportunities, panels, and media engagements for company executives, building credibility and positioning the company as a recognized authority in the market.

jobs.title: Manager, Paid Social
jobs.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a Manager, Paid Social to join our growing team!

The Manager, Paid Social is responsible for social campaign paid planning, strategy, execution, implementation, and delivery to meet client objectives.

You’ll be the day-to-day partner to strategy & account teams and will leverage your knowledge of paid social media to support strategy development and delivery. You will activate omni-channel, digital first marketing and advertising campaigns for our clients, leveraging your capabilities in managing paid social media, dynamic ad creative, personalization, and integrated digital media programs.

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, Lambertville, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What you’ll do:

• Collaborate with internal team and client peers to support strategic solutions that respond to business and communications challenges with healthcare professionals, patients, and caregivers
• Act as day-to-day paid social media lead across several healthcare accounts, but part of an integrated team; responsible for the execution of social media campaign planning, setup, creation, QA, optimization, performance, and management
• Cultivate and maintain in-depth knowledge and understanding of social media platforms and trends to guide account teams and help Real Chemistry continue to be a leader in the space
• Create and help present thoughtful, clear, concise decks that translate business objectives and strategies into tangible media plans that achieve business goals
• Provide counsel and guidance internally and with client on guiding creative and placement optimizations as well as best practices for incorporating paid social into an overall social strategy
• Provide strong input on KPIs for program success and performance data, partnering with analytics teams on building measurement approaches that deliver on KPI’s and goals
• Support financial processes; monitor budgets in ad platforms, maintain flowcharts, review and approve campaigns in MediaOcean/Prisma
• Provide proactive recommendations on research findings, campaign results, industry trends and innovation, competitive pressures to keep clients informed and manage programs upon best practices of paid social media
• Ability to understand key metrics and utilize data and analytics to inform trading strategies and campaign management approach
• Build close partnerships with media partners and understand the ecosystem from demand, supply, verification, measurement etc.

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

• Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead.
• You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities.
• You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.
• You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.
• You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact.

What you should have:

• 1-3 years of experience managing paid social media and being a hands-on trader, managing a client’s performance marketing/advertising-driven activities across multiple social platforms
• Preference for experience in pharma/healthcare industry, but not required - must have strong knowledge of the platforms and data used to support and measure the overall performance of the campaign
• Proficiency with social media buying platforms: Meta Business Manager, LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, Reddit Ads, X Ads etc. - Meta Blueprint, X Ads Academy/Twitter Flight School and Google Certifications a plus
• Display an in-depth understanding of the functionality, strategies behind social media driven campaigns and best practices of all major social platforms
• Exceptional project management skills: demonstrated ability to work under pressure to meet deadlines, prioritize and manage detailed budgets
• Ability to work well under pressure and to build relationships with internal teams
• Work related diversity, equity and inclusion involvement a plus

Pay Range: $65,000-$80,000

jobs.title: Compensation Operations Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT SAVVY WEALTH:

Wealth management is a $545 billion industry that still runs on manual work. 75% of advisors offer no digital communication beyond email, and most still build financial plans by hand in Excel. Savvy is reinventing what it looks like to be a financial advisor. Founder Ritik Malhotra saw the fragmentation firsthand after seeking out his own advisor, and started Savvy to give independent advisors a modern, AI-native home.



Savvy is a registered investment advisor (RIA), and we partner with experienced financial advisors who want to grow without running the back office themselves. Advisors bring their book and join Savvy, running under their own brand (or ours), and Savvy earns a percentage of the assets they manage. In return, they get a true business-in-a-box: a proprietary tech platform and client portal, an in-house marketing team that helps them grow, a world-class investment management team, and a dedicated client services team that runs day-to-day operations and support. Advisors at Savvy service up to 50% more households and save 19 hours a week.



AI runs through everything we do. On the product side, Savvy Intelligence (released April 2026) is the only AI built for wealth managers that can see a client's complete financial picture. Internally, everyone at Savvy uses Claude and is encouraged to experiment with it, backed by a dedicated AI enablement team and a RevOps org building agents in-house.



The trajectory is steep and it's still early. We're a Series C company with 170+ people, $200M raised, and $100M ARR in sight this year. Inc. ranked us the No. 1 fastest-growing financial services company in America in 2026. Come build the next stage with us!



Recognition:

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for our culture and our growth:

 - Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2026)

 - Fortune Best Workplaces in New York™ (2026)

 - Great Place to Work Certified™ 
   
   


THE ROLE:

Savvy partners with independent financial advisors who move their practices onto our platform. A core part of that partnership is how we pay them. Every advisor has a negotiated economic arrangement with Savvy, and turning those arrangements into accurate, on-time monthly payments is its own operational discipline.



We are looking for a Compensation Operations Manager to own that discipline end to end. We pay over 100 advisors, and each payment is the output of a calculation that pulls from upstream sources across the company. The Head of Finance has owned this since the beginning; it now needs a dedicated owner and you will be the first person in this seat. You will inherit a working and roughly automated process, make it more accurate and more scalable.



This is an operator role. You will sit in Finance and report to our Head of Finance, but you will spend most of your week working with our advisory operations, trading, billing, and post-sales teams, and speaking directly with advisors. Success means advisors trust their payout statements, and every question about advisor pay has one clear owner.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Run the monthly advisor payout cycle
   
   - Own the monthly payout process end to end for individual advisors and for advisor teams, including edge cases where a team is paid as a single entity and cases where payments are coordinated across several individuals.
   
   - Build each payout from that advisor's contract terms from gross to net payout. Advisors can purchase additional services or products for fees that we net from payouts.
   
   - Reconcile every payout before funds move. Investigate discrepancies regardless of size, and stand behind the numbers you send.

 - Own the broader advisor money stack
   
   - Administer the advisor loan program, including balances, repayment schedules, and offsets against payouts.
   
   - Build and run the process for equity distributions to advisors under their agreements.
   
   - Manage corporate card budgets and expense oversight for advisors.
   
   - Triage payroll escalations from advisors and drive them to resolution with the right internal owners.
   
   - Own advisor platform-fee invoicing and collections.
   
   - Track incoming deposits from third-party insurance and annuity partners and map them to the advisors.

 - Build the function
   
   - Document every process you inherit or create, and turn one-off judgment calls into repeatable procedures.
   
   - Identify and close control gaps before they become advisor-facing errors.
   
   - Partner with Data and Engineering over time to move this work off spreadsheets and into systems.




MUST HAVE:

 - 5+ years in operations, payroll, commissions, revenue operations, or business operations, in a role where you personally owned a recurring monthly process with money at the end of it.

 - Advanced Microsoft Excel. This is a hard requirement. You will build and audit multi-input calculations and should be comfortable with lookups, nested logic, and pivot tables without working from a template.

 - Exceptional attention to detail and a low tolerance for unexplained variances, including small ones.

 - Comfort chasing information across an organization. Most of the context you need lives on other teams, and getting it is part of the job.

 - Strong written communication. You will explain compensation calculations to people whose income depends on them.

 - Working fluency with AI tools and the judgment to know where they help and where they do not. We expect this role to use AI heavily, but every dollar that leaves the company is a human decision.




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience in wealth management, financial services, or fintech, particularly with advisor, broker, or producer compensation.

 - Experience with commissions or incentive compensation where terms are negotiated individually rather than standardized.

 - Experience with Stripe, corporate card platforms, or payroll systems.

 - Experience as the first person in a role, building the process behind it rather than inheriting one.




ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

Savvy Wealth is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive work environment that values diversity and individual contributions.


BENEFITS:

 - Competitive salary and equity package

 - Unlimited PTO + paid company holidays

 - Access to holistic medical, dental, and vision plans

 - Company 401(k) (including Mega backdoor Roth options), Commuter, and HSA/FSA plans

 - NYC office in Union Square

 - Lunch and snacks provided in the office, & dinner if you stay late

 - Access to virtual mental health care (Spring Health) and health concierge (Rightway) to help you find the right care

 - Access to counseling for stress management, dependent care, nutrition, fitness, legal, and financial issues (Guardian WorkLifeMatters EAP)

jobs.title: Millwright - Mining
jobs.description:
Job Title: Millwright

Company: Loenbro, LLC
Business Unit/Department: Loenbro - Southwest
Location: Arizona
Reports To: Superintendent
Employment Type: Full Time
FLSA Classification: Non-Exempt

About Loenbro

Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries, and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach, and every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.

At Loenbro, we don't just offer jobs, we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose. Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps build and maintain the critical infrastructure that supports communities across the nation.

Position Overview: Loenbro Industrial Services Group is seeking to hire experienced Millwrights for our Arizona jobsites.

As a Millwright, you will install, assemble, dismantle, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair machinery to specifications. Millwrights use precision tools and processes to ensure that the machinery is installed and working correctly and ensuring compliance with all safety regulations and guidelines. We offer a competitive salary, a full range of benefits, a challenging work environment, and growth potential.

Job Duties:

• Work with industry-specific and complex precision machines, including but not limited to exhaust fans, generators, hydraulic systems, pumps, gears, bearings, compressors, etc.

• Plan, inspect, verify, and document the scope of work.

• Use precision leveling and alignment tools to measure angles, material thickness, and small distances with calipers, squares, micrometers, optical instruments, and other tools.

• Fit bearings, align gears and wheels, attach motors, and connect belts according to manufacturer’s blueprints and drawings.

• Dismantle machines using hammers, wrenches, crowbars, and other hand tools.

• Assemble and install equipment such as shafting, exhaust fan blades, and pump systems.

• Assemble machines and bolt, weld, rivet, and fasten machinery to foundations or other structures using hand tools and power tools.

• Operate engine lathes, grinders, and files.

• May construct foundations for machinery.

• Fabricate and install parts, equipment, and machinery by measuring, cutting, drilling, and/or welding.

• Unload, inspect, move, and set equipment into position using cranes, hoists, dollies, rollers, and trucks.

• Use rigging and hoisting devices such as chokers, chain falls, and come-alongs to move equipment/materials into place.

• Conduct preventative maintenance such as lubrication and fixing or repairing worn parts.

• Follow directions from the supervisor.

• Must be willing to perform other duties as assigned.

• Other duties as assigned.

• Able to recognize changing ground conditions.

• Adheres to all safety rules.

• Maintaining the work areas in a clean, safe, and orderly manner on a continuous basis

• Perform all other job duties as assigned.

Skill/Qualifications:

• Must have experience with industrial machinery installation, repair, and maintenance.

• Must know how to read blueprints, schematic drawings, and engineering specifications, and understand how to read and interpret technical manuals to determine work procedures.

• Must have experience using industrial hand tools and power tools.

• Must have all Journeyman Precision Millwright hand tools.

• Minimum 4-5 years of industrial construction/maintenance experience.

• Minimum of 3 years of Millwright experience.

• Must have reliable transportation.

Essential Requirements:

• Demonstrated industrial construction/maintenance history experience.

• Knowledge of hand tools, power tools, and layout tools such as lasers, ultrasonic measuring and alignment tools, plumb bobs, cutting torches, welding machines, hydraulic torch wrenches, hydraulic stud tensioners, soldering guns, and metalworking equipment, including lathes and grinding machines.

• Organization and time management.

• Good problem-solving abilities.

• Good aptitude and manual dexterity

• Knowledge of math concepts, geometry, and layout.

• Demonstrated ability to lead others and provide detailed instructions.

• Ability to work with others – team player.

• Ability to work independently – minimal supervision.

• Effective communication skills with co-workers and supervisors.

• Employees are required to adhere to large amounts of standing, walking, bending, squatting, and lifting.

• Employees may be required to lift, carry, and move up to 50 lbs.

• Will occasionally work at heights, climb ladders and stairways, and work off platforms.

• Must be capable of working outside in the elements, including, but not limited to heat, cold, rain, snow, and wind; and must be able to work for prolonged periods, up to 12 hours a day.

• Employees will be required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) i.e. hard hat, safety glasses/goggles, ear plugs/muffs, masks/respirators, safety vests, gloves, and steel-toe boots.

• Walking on uneven terrain, with an average of two miles per day.

• Exposure to noise above 85 decibels and intense odors

• If driving is required, a valid driver’s license and proof of insurability will be required. All drivers are subject to a DMV background records search.

This role requires compliance with all applicable safety regulations, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and Loenbro Environmental Health & Safety (EH&S) policies.

Benefits

Loenbro offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and rewards to those who join our team:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• 401(k) retirement plan with company match

• Paid time off (PTO)

• Life and disability insurance

• Professional development and training opportunities

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Benefits eligibility may vary based on employment classification and hours worked.

Our Core Values (LEAD)

At Loenbro, we are guided by our core values:

• Living with Integrity

• Exceeding Expectations

• Acting with Urgency

• Delivering Excellence

If you're ready to join a company committed to building exceptional projects, developing outstanding people, and delivering excellence every day, we want to hear from you.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Loenbro is an Equal Opportunity Employer

You will own how money moves between Savvy and the 100+ financial advisors on our platform, along with the models, systems, and decisions around it. THE ROLE

We are seeking a Senior Application Security Engineer to join Savvy Wealth at our NYC headquarters as our first dedicated security hire. This is a hands-on, in-the-weeds engineering role. You will execute the security strategy set by our Director of IT & Information Security and our CTO, with day-to-day work centered on identifying vulnerabilities, remediating them, and closing the longer-term gaps that make us exposed, both in our product and in the SaaS tools our teams use every day.

Savvy is an AI-forward company. Most of our engineering is AI-assisted, and we enable people across the business, including non-technical roles, to build with AI coding tools. That enablement is a core part of how we work, and we intend to keep it. Your job is to make it safe: setting security hygiene standards in our codebases, building guardrails around AI-assisted development, and partnering closely with our internal AI team so that speed and security move together. You will make the secure path the easy path.

This role is deliberately not a compliance or GRC position. There are no audits to run, no certifications to chase, and no questionnaires to fill out. This is purely technical security work: finding and eliminating the vectors that make us vulnerable.

 - Own vulnerability management end to end: identify, triage, prioritize by real-world risk, and drive remediation to closure across our product, codebases, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Cloudflare)

 - Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2026)

 - Fortune Best Workplaces in New York™ (2026)

 - Great Place to Work Certified™ 
   
   


THE ROLE

Savvy is hiring our first dedicated agentic harness engineer. Coding agents are already part of how our engineers work, but adoption has moved faster than our ability to make their output consistently good. Wrong code and weak architectural decisions still create review burden. We are hiring someone to treat that as an engineering problem, not solve it with a longer prompt.

You will own how developers across EPD interact with coding agents and with the systems around them. That includes the codebase itself, our internal skills and instructions, cloud coding workflows, agentic code review, CI, local development, testing, debugging, and delivery. You will have substantial autonomy to make cross-cutting decisions, change defaults, and set standards across the organization.

 

This is a hands-on platform engineering role. Most of your time will be spent building software and improving the environment in which developers and agents work. You will also talk directly with engineers, study where time and quality are being lost, test your ideas against real work, and help teams adopt better ways of operating. You will join our infrastructure and harness team and partner closely with infrastructure, security, data, and product engineers.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own developer and agent experience: Set the roadmap for how our engineers and coding agents navigate the codebase, use internal tools, run tests, review changes, and ship software.

 - Build the cloud coding experience: Build the developer-facing layer around our existing compute foundations, including task intake, environment setup, context, tools, permissions, observability, review, and delivery.

 - Improve agent output at the source: Change repository structure, interfaces, documentation, instructions, and feedback loops so agents produce correct code and sound architecture more consistently.

 - Engineer context deliberately: Design what agents receive up front, discover progressively, persist, compact, hand off, or discard. Choose models and reasoning effort based on evidence from the job, not habit.

 - Own our internal skills system: Raise the quality of our shared skills and instructions through clear contribution standards, evaluation, discoverability, progressive disclosure, maintenance, and pruning.

 - Fix everyday developer friction: Improve CI speed and reliability, local setup, testing, debugging, deploy workflows, and the other bottlenecks that cost engineers time.

 - Measure what works: Combine developer research and satisfaction data with DORA or SPACE measures and task-level agent evaluations. Inspect traces, establish baselines, and test whether changes improve correctness, reviewability, cost, latency, and human intervention.

 - Drive adoption: Work directly with engineers, teach effective practices, and turn successful experiments into defaults. When the root problem is the codebase or engineering process, make that case and help fix it.

 - Partner on safe autonomy: Work with our infrastructure and security engineers on sandboxing, credentials, approvals, auditability, and the controls needed to give cloud agents useful access without giving them unlimited access.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Exceptional with coding agents: You use Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar tools for substantial work and can show how you decompose tasks, manage context, choose models, inspect failures, and consistently produce maintainable software. Faster output alone is not the bar.

 - Internal tools with real users: You have built developer tooling or a platform that engineers beyond your immediate team relied on. You learned from their behavior and support burden, not only from what they said they wanted.

 - CI or large-codebase experience: You have made a meaningful improvement to CI, testing, repository workflows, or developer productivity in a substantial, long-lived codebase.

 - Product judgment for internal systems: You can interview developers, separate symptoms from root causes, turn evidence into a roadmap, and say no to attractive work that will not improve the system.

 - Strong software engineering: You have built and operated substantial production software. We are open on language and framework, but you must be able to move from diagnosis to a durable implementation yourself.

 - Evaluation over intuition: You know that agent behavior is nondeterministic and changing quickly. You compare prompts, context, tools, models, and workflows against representative tasks rather than declaring success from a demo.

 - Cross-team influence: You can set standards and change defaults across teams without becoming a gatekeeper. You explain the evidence, earn trust, and remain accountable for the experience you create.

 - Pragmatic range: You are comfortable moving between platform code, repository conventions, evaluation data, developer interviews, documentation, and hands-on enablement. This is not a prompt-writing, DevRel, or framework-only role.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience building cloud or remote development environments, coding-agent control planes, or secure execution sandboxes.

 - Experience building or operating an agentic code review system.

 - Experience designing agent tools, skills, context systems, memory, orchestration, or model-routing infrastructure.

 - Experience using DORA, SPACE, or similar frameworks without reducing developer productivity to a single metric.

 - Experience in financial services or another security- and compliance-sensitive environment.


BENEFITS:

 - Competitive salary and equity package

 - Unlimited PTO + paid company holidays

 - Access to holistic medical, dental, and vision plans

 - Company 401(k) (including Mega backdoor Roth options), Commuter, and HSA/FSA plans

 - NYC office in Union Square

 - Lunch and snacks provided in the office, & dinner if you stay late

 - Access to virtual mental health care (Spring Health) and health concierge (Rightway) to help you find the right care

 - Access to counseling for stress management, dependent care, nutrition, fitness, legal, and financial issues (Guardian WorkLifeMatters EAP)

jobs.description:
Lead with your clinical skill and your heart

At the Suites of Someren Glen, we believe our community thrives when our care partners are happy and empowered to give their best. If you have experience in long-term care or memory care and a real passion for working with older adults, we’d love to meet you.

As a Registered Nurse, you’ll be a leader on our Nursing Team. You’ll guide resident care from planning through evaluation, so each resident gets care that fits their individual needs and supports their whole well-being. You’ll work closely with physicians, pharmacists, families, and fellow care partners, and you’ll mentor the team members you work alongside. We support our nurses’ professional growth and value their clinical judgment and leadership.

We’re looking for strong team players who will go the extra mile for each other and, above all, for the residents who call our community home.

What you’ll do

You’ll plan, organize, direct, carry out, and evaluate all aspects of resident care. You’ll meet each resident’s total needs while following state and federal regulations and community policies. Day to day, you will:

• Keep nursing staff, physicians, pharmacists, and families informed about each resident’s status
• Listen to concerns from residents, families, and physicians, then take corrective action or escalate as needed
• Take part in Resident Care conferences and keep Resident Care Plans accurate and up to date
• Prepare, administer, and document medications according to physician orders, and manage medication ordering, including replacing expired medications
• Document resident care issues and report them to the appropriate personnel
• Recognize signs and symptoms, and use sound clinical judgment to choose the right treatments and procedures
• Supervise and direct CNAs and other support staff, and take corrective action when needed
• Support the team with other duties as needed

Basic Qualifications & Experience

• Colorado Registered Nursing License, in good standing.
• Advanced training in geriatrics preferred.
• 1-year experience in a long-term care facility preferred.
• 1-year experience in a supervisory capacity preferred.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications including Excel, Word and Outlook
• Must be able to read, write and speak the English language.
• Must possess excellent customer service skills.
• Must be able to read, write and speak the English language

Working Conditions / Physical Requirements

• Moderate physical activity required by handling objects up to 50 pounds occasionally and/or up to 20 pounds frequently.
• Possible exposure to chemicals, blood borne pathogens and other infectious diseases.
• Sits, stands, bends and moves intermittently during working hours.
• Is subject to frequent interruptions.
• Interacts with residents, family members, visitors frequently.

jobs.title: Senior Data Platform Engineer — Kafka & PostgreSQL
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to run the PostgreSQL and Apache Kafka platform behind k0rdent-ai — our multi-tenant control plane for enterprise GPU infrastructure. Every cluster provisioned, every GPU-hour consumed, and every tenant action is recorded on this platform, so it must be reliable, secure, and recoverable.

This is a hands-on DevOps / SRE role for stateful systems. You will deploy and operate PostgreSQL (CloudNativePG) and Kafka (Strimzi) on Kubernetes using operators, Helm, and GitOps — across cloud and bare-metal clusters, in a global control plane and multiple regions. You will own automation, upgrades, observability, backups, and disaster recovery, and give product teams self-service access to databases and topics through code.

Main Responsibilities

• Run PostgreSQL and Kafka on Kubernetes: Deploy, upgrade, scale, and operate CloudNativePG and Strimzi clusters with Helm charts and operator custom resources, across cloud and bare-metal Kubernetes.
• GitOps & Infrastructure as Code: Manage everything declaratively with Argo CD (or Flux), Helm, and Terraform; build CI/CD pipelines for database and Kafka changes, schema migrations, and operator upgrades.
• High Availability & Disaster Recovery: Design and operate high availability within each region and cross-region disaster recovery — PostgreSQL replica clusters, backups and point-in-time recovery, Kafka MirrorMaker 2 — with defined RPO/RTO targets and regular failover drills.
• Self-Service Platform: Give product teams self-service provisioning of databases, users, topics, and ACLs through code, with secure defaults and guardrails.
• Observability & Operations: Build monitoring and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) for replication lag, backups, consumer lag, and capacity; participate in on-call and lead incident reviews.
• Security & Multi-Tenancy: Implement TLS/mTLS, secrets management (Vault/OpenBao), network policies, Kafka ACLs, and per-tenant isolation; integrate database and Kafka access with our identity platform (Keycloak / OIDC).
• Data Movement & CDC: Operate the outbox and change-data-capture pipelines (Debezium, Kafka Connect) that keep databases and event streams consistent between the global control plane and regions.
• Automation & Tooling: Write automation and small services in Go or Python to remove manual work, and partner with application teams on schema standards and performance troubleshooting.

Must Have

• Experience: 8+ years in DevOps, SRE, platform, or infrastructure engineering, including 3+ years running stateful systems (databases or message streaming) in production.
• Kubernetes: Strong hands-on Kubernetes operations — StatefulSets, persistent volumes and storage classes, pod disruption budgets, scheduling and affinity, network policies, and cluster upgrades — on cloud and/or bare-metal clusters.
• Operators & Helm: Production experience running PostgreSQL and/or Kafka through Kubernetes operators (CloudNativePG, Zalando, or Crunchy PGO; Strimzi, Confluent for Kubernetes, or similar), and authoring and maintaining Helm charts. Depth with one operator matters more than the specific product.
• GitOps & IaC: Day-to-day use of Argo CD or Flux, Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar) in a declarative, review-driven workflow.
• PostgreSQL Operations: Practical PostgreSQL administration — replication and failover, backup and point-in-time recovery, connection pooling (PgBouncer), version upgrades, and performance troubleshooting.
• Kafka Operations: Running Kafka in production — brokers, topics and partitions, replication, consumer groups, monitoring, and capacity planning.
• Reliability & DR: Designing and testing high availability and disaster recovery for stateful systems, with defined RPO/RTO.
• Automation: Strong scripting and programming in Go (preferred) or Python, plus Bash.

Nice to Have

• Cross-region replication (CloudNativePG replica clusters, Kafka MirrorMaker 2) and global/regional multi-site architectures.
• Debezium, Kafka Connect, and transactional outbox / CDC patterns.
• Identity integration for data platforms (Keycloak, OIDC, LDAP/Active Directory).
• Observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, VictoriaMetrics).
• Secrets and security tooling (Vault/OpenBao, cert-manager, mTLS).
• Bare-metal infrastructure, Ceph or object storage, or GPU/AI infrastructure.
• Contributions to CloudNativePG, Strimzi, or related open-source projects.
• Experience in SOC 2 or ISO 27001 environments.

Education and Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

What does Mirantis offer you?

• Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry;
• Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies;
• Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation;
• Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued;
• Professional development and training;
• Attend conferences and working groups;
• Company outings, happy hours, hackathons, and tech talks;
• Receive a competitive compensation package with a strong benefits plan.
