jobs.title: Sr. Manufacturing and Weld Engineer
jobs.description:
About Re:Build Optimation

At Re:Build Optimation, we specialize in delivering custom-engineered process equipment and automated systems to clients across the globe. With nearly 40 years of experience in complex chemical process systems, we have built a reputation for precision, reliability, and innovation. Our multidisciplinary team of 70+ engineers, designers, and programmers, combined with 150,000 square feet of fabrication space and over 70 skilled tradespeople, allows us to provide full turnkey solutions—from initial concept through fabrication, installation, and commissioning.

As part of Re:Build Manufacturing, we leverage the strength of a national industrial powerhouse while maintaining the agility and personalized service of a niche firm. We serve industries ranging from traditional and green energy to chemicals, pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, glass, and advanced manufacturing, offering tailored solutions that optimize efficiency and performance.

At Re:Build Optimation, we believe in a collaborative approach, working closely with our clients to develop solutions that align with their unique operational goals. Our deep industry expertise and end-to-end capabilities make us the ideal partner for companies seeking cutting-edge automation, process control, and engineered systems.

Who We Are Looking For

We're looking for a seasoned manufacturing and welding engineer who can bridge the gap between design intent and shop floor reality. You bring deep hands-on experience with welded assemblies and fabrication processes, coupled with the technical knowledge to optimize how things are made. You're equally comfortable interpreting complex engineering drawings, solving production issues, and collaborating with design teams to improve manufacturability.

This role serves as a welding domain expert for Re:Build Optimation and the broader Re:Build Manufacturing network—helping project teams navigate code requirements, select welding processes, design tooling, and build scalable production methods. You thrive on variety: qualifying weld procedures, leading design-for-manufacturability reviews, and setting up automated welding work cells.

What You Get To Do

• Design and improve manufacturing processes, developing efficient methods that reduce cost, waste, and cycle time using lean and Six Sigma principles

• Lead Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Manufacturing for Design (MFD) initiatives to improve producibility and part quality

• Develop, optimize, and qualify weld processes across multiple methods including electron beam, laser beam, GTAW, orbital tube, GMAW, and SMAW

• Serve as welding domain expert, providing guidance on code requirements, welding techniques, and destructive/non-destructive testing

• Design weld tooling and fixtures to reduce distortion and improve consistency in welded assemblies

• Select and specify manufacturing equipment, tooling, and fixtures—including automation, robotics, and CNC systems

• Support new product introduction by partnering with design teams to ensure efficient manufacturing and scalability

• Collaborate with quality and testing partners to define requirements and processes for welded assemblies

• Solve production issues using root-cause analysis and implement corrective actions

• Evaluate make vs. buy opportunities and manage key vendor relationships for welding and testing processes

• Develop work instructions, process documentation, and standards that support safe and consistent execution

What You Bring To The Team

• Bachelor's degree in Welding Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field

• 10+ years of experience with design, fabrication, manufacturing, and/or testing of welded assemblies

• Strong knowledge of CAD/CAM software and ability to interpret engineering drawings, GD&T, and specifications

• Experience setting up automated/robotic welding work cells and modifying designs for automated welding compatibility

• Demonstrated experience applying DFM/MFD principles and optimizing manufacturing processes, tooling, and fixtures

• Hands-on experience with lean manufacturing and root-cause problem-solving methods

• Fundamental understanding of SMAW, GMAW, GTAW, laser, and electron beam welding processes

• Hands-on experience with carbon steels, stainless steels, aluminum, titanium, and/or high-nickel alloys

• Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively with multi-functional teams

• Experience in custom equipment fabrication, machine building, or mid-to-high-volume/high-mix environments

• Strong commitment to safety, including alignment to OSHA and site-specific protocols

Preferred:

• Master's degree in engineering or equivalent experience

• Lean/Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt), PMP, AWS CWEng, or CWI certification; NDT Level 1 or 2

• Ability to develop complete weld procedures independently

• Fluent knowledge of ASME BPVC (Section VIII, Divisions 1 & 2) and experience with design tools like DesignCalcs

• Experience with ASME Authorized Inspection Authorities (AIAs)

• Experience supporting mid-to-high-volume production of large structural weldments

• Prior experience mentoring engineers, apprentices, or technicians

The base salary range for this position is $94,000 – $141,000 per year. This range represents the Company’s good faith estimate of the base compensation for this role at the time of posting.  Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to proven experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for annual incentive compensation and/or long-term incentives, subject to Company plans. The Company offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, retirement, paid time off, and other benefits.

The BIG payoff

We are a company who is going to make a difference in the industries and the communities in which we choose to operate.  Every employee of Re:Build will share ownership in the company and will share in the financial rewards of the success we achieve together, at all levels of the company!

We want to work with people that reflect the communities in which we operate

Or for any other reason.

Re:Build is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. jobs.title: Principal Investigator
jobs.description:
Company Description

We are Olsson. We engineer and design solutions that improve the world around us. As a company, we promise to always be responsive, transparent, and focused on results – for our people, our clients, and our company.

We’re a people-centric firm, so it’s no surprise our greatest asset is our people. The impact this creates is an environment that encourages our people to grow and be creative with their talents. This approach builds a culture that is uniquely Olsson. It allows us to grow our people as we grow our business. This, in turn, creates a lasting impact on the world around us.

Job Description

At Olsson, we help our clients navigate complex regulatory landscapes with ease. We ensure proactive compliance with key environmental laws, including the National Historic Preservation Act (NHPA). Projects span the U.S. and include transportation, energy, and other infrastructure projects that require compliance with the NHPA and the National Environmental Policy Act.

As the Principal Investigator you will plan, oversee, and support cultural resources investigations and overall responsibility for archaeological investigations. These investigations and coordination with federal agencies may be performed by Olsson’s staff archaeologists or through the use of subconsultants. The Principal Investigator will scope, plan, direct, and oversee this work.  Additionally, this role emphasizes technical excellence, mentorship, regulatory expertise, and high‑level review of deliverables. The Principal Investigator provides strategic direction on environmental design, analysis, and compliance activities across the firm, with a focus on technical performance, innovation, and regulatory rigor.

Key responsibilities:

• Serve as a firmwide subject matter expert, providing internal and external leadership on cultural resources compliance.

• Provide strategic direction and consultation to project teams and clients on complex issues, regulatory pathways, and technical methodologies.

• Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal environmental regulations, including NHPA, ARPA, and NEPA requirements. Plan, scope, prepare and review field investigations analyses, technical reports, and documentation.

• Maintain a strong external reputation as a technical leader, contributing to the profession through publications, conference presentations, and participation in scientific or regulatory working groups.

• Promote efficiencies and uphold quality standards, ensuring deliverables meet the highest levels of scientific rigor and regulatory defensibility.

• Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including regulatory agencies, scientific partners, and industry organizations, to stay informed of evolving policies and opportunities for collaboration.

• Represent the firm in professional organizations, advisory committees, or regulatory forums to elevate both the environmental discipline and the firm’s visibility.

• Lead and manage projects from early planning through implementation, including scoping, technical strategy, budgeting, scheduling, and quality oversight.

• Mentor and develop staff, fostering technical growth, scientific excellence, and consistency across the firm.

We have one current opening and will consider candidates located in any of our office locations or remote.

Qualifications

You are passionate about:

• Working collaboratively with others.

• Having ownership in the work you do.

• Using your talents to positively affect communities.

You bring to the team:

• Strong communication skills.

• Ability to contribute and work well on a team.

• Graduate degree (e.g., M.A, M.S, or Ph.D.) in archaeology, anthropology, or closely related field from an accredited institution.

• 12+ years of relevant post-education experience in Section 106/110 Compliance.

• Experience in cultural resource management in the Midwest or South.

• Experience in leading and mentoring others.

• Innovative and proactive approach to problem-solving.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Commitment to continuous learning and professional development, including participation in professional organizations.

#LI-DNP

Additional Information

Olsson specializes in engineering and design, client advisory services, planning, field services, and environmental. Improving the world has been our mindset from the very beginning, back when Olsson first opened for business in 1956. And it will be our mindset for years to come.

As an Olsson employee, you will:

• Receive a competitive 401(k) match

• Be empowered to build your career with tailored development paths

• Have the possibility for flexible work arrangements

• Engage in work that has a positive impact on communities

• Participate in a wellness program promoting balanced lifestyles

In addition, full-time employees will receive our traditional benefits package (health care, vision, dental, paid time off, etc.) and the opportunity to participate in a bonus system that rewards performance.

Olsson is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We encourage qualified minority, female, veteran, and disabled candidates to apply and be considered for open positions. We do not discriminate against any applicant for employment or any employee because of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender, disability, age, military status, or other protected status.

Please read this Notice carefully to understand our privacy practices.

jobs.title: Process & Mechanical Engineering Team Lead
jobs.description:
About Re:Build

At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions.

We operate an advanced, end-to-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation.

The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. (link to The Re:Build Way principles)

About Re:Build Optimation

At Re:Build Optimation, we specialize in delivering custom-engineered process equipment and automated systems to clients across the globe. With nearly 40 years of experience in complex chemical process systems, we have built a reputation for precision, reliability, and innovation. Our multidisciplinary team of 70+ engineers, designers, and programmers, combined with 150,000 square feet of fabrication space and over 70 skilled tradespeople, allows us to provide full turnkey solutions—from initial concept through fabrication, installation, and commissioning.

As part of Re:Build Manufacturing, we leverage the strength of a national industrial powerhouse while maintaining the agility and personalized service of a specialized firm. We serve industries ranging from traditional and green energy to chemicals, pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, glass, and advanced manufacturing, offering tailored solutions that optimize efficiency and performance.

At Re:Build Optimation, we believe in a collaborative approach, working closely with our clients to develop solutions that align with their unique operational goals. Our deep industry expertise and end-to-end capabilities make us the ideal partner for companies seeking cutting-edge automation, process control, and engineered systems.

Who we are looking for

The Process and Mechanical Engineering Team Lead maintains a dual focus on high-level project execution and departmental leadership, reporting to the Director of Process & Mechanical Engineering & Design. The Team Lead provides the primary interface & day-to-day management of the process & mechanical engineering team. They are also a critical connection with the Optimation leadership team and drive continuous improvement initiatives on the team. The Team lead is responsible for providing hands-on design support to the drafters & designers, making workload allocation decisions, and end-to-end talent management including performance management, professional development, hiring, and onboarding. The Team Lead is critical in cross-functional collaboration, estimating, design reviews, and other related tasks to support delivery of project work on-time, on-budget, with superior quality.

What you get to do

Team Leadership & Management

• Provide day-to-day leadership and oversight of the process and mechanical engineering team

• Manage team workload allocation to optimize resource utilization and meet project demands

• Lead all aspects of talent management, including performance management, coaching, and professional development

• Drive recruiting, hiring, and onboarding efforts to build and sustain a high-performing team

• Foster a collaborative, accountable, and development-focused team culture

Technical & Engineering Leadership

• Provide hands-on engineering support and technical guidance to team members

• Ensure consistency, accuracy, and quality across all process and mechanical build work

• Lead and participate in build reviews to uphold engineering standards and guidelines

• Drive continuous improvement of design tools, standards, and workflows to increase efficiency and reduce rework

Project Execution & Support

• Collaborate with project managers and design & engineering leads to support successful project delivery; directly support project execution as needed when workload exceeds capacity

• Lead estimating efforts for process & mechanical engineering scopes of work, including scope definition and resource planning

• Ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards

• Identify and mitigate risks related to engineering scope, schedule, and execution

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Act as a key liaison between the engineering team and other functional groups, including engineering, project management, and leadership

• Support alignment between design execution and broader business objectives

• Lead and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal operations

• Identify opportunities to standardize processes and improve overall team performance and scalability

What You Bring

• 7-10+ years of experience in chemical, process and/or mechanical engineering, preferably in an engineering services or industrial environment

• Deep understanding of engineering workflows to ensure team workloads are balanced, deadlines are realistic, and departmental capacity is optimized

• Ability to identify & address potential bottlenecks before they occur and manage the group’s capacity to prevent burnout while meeting project schedules.

• Must have a high-level grasp of the labor hours needed for different stages of process engineering. This knowledge is essential for giving upper management accurate project bids. It also ensures the team avoids unattainable delivery targets.

• Strong written and verbal communication, organization, and team management skills

• Strong design skills using programs like AutoCAD 2D/3D and SolidWorks (preferred)

• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team environment.

• Experience gathering, documenting, and communicating technical project requirements.

• Experience estimating engineering design project costs.

• Ability to be on-site at our offices in Rochester, NY and/or Rush, NY

• Willingness to travel to client sites and suppliers as needed (typically 25%)

Preferred

• Prior experience leading and mentoring technical teams.

• Experience interviewing, onboarding, and delivering performance evaluations.

• Prior relevant experience with design of industrial equipment and/or automation solutions.

• Experience working with ISO9001 or similar quality system a plus.

• Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement tools & methodologies a plus.

The base salary range for this position is $106,563 - $159,845. This range represents the Company’s good faith estimate of the base compensation for this role at the time of posting.  Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location. In addition to hourly rate, this role may be eligible for annual incentive compensation and/or long-term incentives, subject to Company plans. The Company offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, retirement, paid time off, and other benefits.

The BIG payoff

Re:Build Optimation offers an opportunity to work on innovative industrial automation projects in a collaborative and forward-thinking environment. Our team values ingenuity, technical skills, and a dedication to excellence. If you are passionate about shaping the future of manufacturing systems, we encourage you to join us and have an impact. All Re:Build employees will have ownership in the company and share financial rewards.

We want to work with people that reflect the communities in which we operate.

Re:Build Manufacturing is pleased to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. Or for any other cause.

jobs.title: Traffic Monitoring Operator
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a highly motivated and dependable Traffic Operations Specialist in Lansing, MI.

Job Summary

Applicants will need to be professional, reliable, self-motivated, and able to follow strict standard operating procedures.  Applicants will also need to confirm their willingness and ability to work in a 24/7/365 operating environment.

This position is responsible for monitoring, detecting, and reporting traffic incidents on Michigan’s roadways, and coordinating with response agencies to manage the clearance of traffic incidents.  The primary responsibility of this position is to use intelligent transportation system devices to detect and verify incidents, coordinate a response, and communicate the impacts to stakeholders.  Once the Operator has confirmed a traffic incident and coordinated with the appropriate jurisdiction for response, the operator then distributes traveler information through a variety of communication platforms such as digital message signs, websites, social media, and media outlets.

Responsibilities

• Managing and logging traffic incidents in an advanced transportation management system software
• Coordinating and dispatching incident response crews to incidents in a safe, timely and efficient manner.
• Detecting, confirming, and tracking equipment failures affecting control room operations (e.g., central system, computers, CCTV cameras, digital message signs, etc.)
• Coordinating with local, regional, and statewide stakeholders on all control room activities by providing essential and timely incident information and status
• Informing first responders of traffic related incidents involving injury and assisting with coordination of lane closures and diversion routes.
• Coordinating incidents with local municipalities for resolution and information dissemination.
• Dispatch, coordinate and communicate by radio with MDOT’s Safety Service Patrol.

Minimum Requirements

• HS + 1 or more years prior experience as a Traffic Monitoring Operator or other related experience.
• A valid driver's license is required, along with the ability to pass a Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check in accordance with company policy
• Background and drug/alcohol screening required

Preferred Qualifications

• Associates Degree
• Prior experience working in a fast paced, technology infused, environment
• Demonstrated reliability
• Geographic familiarity with State of Michigan Interstate system
• Computer proficiency: Office (Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook)
• Scheduling flexibility

• Sponsorship is not available for this position

AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

jobs.description:
Roadie, a UPS company, is a leading logistics and delivery platform that helps businesses tackle the complexities of modern retail with unmatched delivery coverage, flexibility and visibility. Reaching 97% of U.S. households across more than 30,000 zip codes — from urban hubs to rural communities — Roadie provides seamless, scalable solutions that meet a variety of delivery needs.

With a network of more than 310,000 independent drivers nationwide, Roadie offers flexible delivery solutions that make complex logistics challenges easy, including solutions for local same-day delivery, delivery of big and bulky items, ship-from-store and DC-to-door. For more information, visit www.roadie.com.

As Roadie’s Workforce Manager, you’ll lead workforce planning and real-time operations for our 24/7 Support organization. Working across Roadie and our BPO partners, you’ll ensure the right coverage across phone, chat, and email to deliver a great user experience.

You’ll develop our Real-Time Analysts and scheduling resources, anticipate demand, and guide teams through daily challenges and peak periods. If you enjoy solving complex operational puzzles, developing people, and seeing your decisions make an immediate impact, you’ll thrive in this role.

What You’ll Do

• Lead and develop Roadie’s Real-Time Analysts and scheduling resources through clear priorities, coaching, and accountability

• Own forecasting, staffing, and headcount planning across Support channels, internal teams, and BPO partners

• Build schedules that align staffing with demand and maintain consistent queue coverage

• Guide real-time operations by monitoring service levels, adherence, occupancy, utilization, backlog, and handle time, taking action as needs shift

• Anticipate staffing and scheduling gaps, communicate their business impact, and recommend practical solutions

• Partner with Support Managers, Vendor Managers, Salesforce, Engineering, and other technical teams to improve routing, workflows, automation, and self-service

• Assess how proposed operational and technology changes will affect contact volume, staffing needs, queue performance, and the user experience

• Develop workforce and contingency plans for peak season, high-volume periods, and unexpected staffing or system challenges

• Serve as a workforce leadership resource for our 24/7 operation, including during outages and service disruptions, as business needs require

• Lead postmortems after significant service-level misses or disruptions, turning findings into actionable improvements

• Deliver reporting and analysis that helps leaders make informed decisions about staffing, headcount, and operational performance

• Oversee WFM platform configuration and partner with technical teams to strengthen workforce tools, routing, and reporting accuracy

What You Bring

• 5+ years of contact-center workforce management experience across forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, and real-time operations

• Proven success developing workforce analysts or schedulers through coaching, clear expectations, and accountability

• Experience supporting 24/7, multichannel operations and partnering with BPOs across sites or time zones

• Strong analytical judgment, with the ability to anticipate risks, uncover root causes, and turn data into practical recommendations

• Strong understanding of queue management and routing, including how process changes, automation, and AI deflection affect staffing and service levels

• Clear communication, sound judgment under pressure, and strong ownership and follow-through

• Advanced proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets and working knowledge of Calabrio, Salesforce, Amazon Connect, or comparable platforms

• Experience planning for peak demand and managing workforce responses to outages or service disruptions

• A bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience

• Experience building WFM processes from the ground up or supporting high-growth or gig-economy operations preferred

Why Roadie?

• Competitive compensation packages

• 100% covered health insurance premiums for yourself

• 401k with company match

• Tuition and student loan repayment assistance (that’s right - Roadie will contribute directly to your existing student loans!)

• Flexible work schedule with unlimited PTO

• Monthly 3-day weekends

• Monthly WFH stipend

• Paid sabbatical leave- tenured team members are given time to rest, relax, and explore

• The technology you need to get the job done

This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S.

jobs.title: Procurement Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As Procurement Manager, you will lead procurement, material planning and supply readiness to support our production schedules as we scale. You will own the operating mechanisms that turn demand into executable material plans, including Clear to Build (CTB) analysis, MRP execution and purchase order management. Leading a team of Buyers and Material Planners, you will work closely with Strategic Sourcing, Planning, Engineering, Quality, Finance and our suppliers to remove material constraints before they impact manufacturing.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Manage and develop a team of Buyers and Material Planners, setting priorities and giving them the tools and training to execute.

 - Own Clear to Build analysis and translate demand into executable material plans for production.

 - Identify material constraints before they impact production, and drive cross functional actions to resolution.

 - Improve the quality of MRP inputs, including lead times, safety stocks, order policies, MOQ and planning parameters.

 - Hold suppliers accountable for delivery performance, and drive recovery plans when commitments are at risk.

 - Represent material readiness in production, S&OP, shortage and operational review meetings.

 - Monitor and report key indicators on supplier performance, material availability and supply risks.

 - Resolve downstream issues with receiving, finance and accounting teams.

 - Maintain procurement master data in the ERP system and build scalable processes as the company grows.




CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

 - Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Supply Chain or a related discipline.

 - Experience: 5+ years of supply chain experience in progressive roles, ideally in a manufacturing environment.

 - Proven Leadership: 2+ years managing or leading procurement, planning or materials teams.

 - Technical Expertise: Strong practical knowledge of MRP logic, BOM driven material planning, inventory management and production supply.

 - Material Readiness: Demonstrated experience developing or operating Clear to Build processes in a manufacturing environment.

 - Scaling Experience: Experience supporting NPI, engineering changes and production ramps, and building scalable processes in a rapidly changing environment.

jobs.title: Counsel – Drug, Device and Consumer Products

POSITION SUMMARY

Barnes & Thornburg is seeking an experienced litigation Counsel with substantive experience in drug, medical device, consumer product and/or related product liability litigation. The Counsel will manage complex matters, developing litigation strategy, drafting substantive legal work, advocating for clients, and working collaboratively with partners, associates, experts, and clients. The ideal candidate is a strong legal writer and advocate who can take ownership of matters and deliver high-quality work with sound judgment and minimal supervision.

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Manage significant aspects of complex drug, medical device, consumer product and/or product liability matters from inception through resolution.

 - Develop and execute litigation strategies in collaboration with partners and clients.

 - Draft pleadings, motions, briefs, discovery responses, memoranda, and other substantive work product.

 - Prepare for and participate in depositions, hearings, oral arguments, mediations, and other proceedings.

 - Analyze scientific, medical, technical, and factual evidence and translate complex information into persuasive legal arguments.

 - Manage discovery, including developing case-specific strategies, reviewing and analyzing evidence, and coordinating with eDiscovery professionals and vendors.

 - Work with expert witnesses and consultants on case development, reports, testimony, and trial preparation.

 - Communicate directly with clients regarding case status, strategy, risks, and significant developments.

 - Supervise, mentor and delegate assignments associates and other legal professionals.

 - Collaborate effectively with partners and cross-functional teams to advance client and matter objectives.

 - Contribute to trial preparation and, as appropriate, trial execution.
   
    

EXPERIENCE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES REQUIRED

 - J.D. from accredited law school and admission to and in good standing with applicable state bar(s)

 - 8+ years of relevant experience in drug, medical device, consumer product, product liability, toxic tort, or related complex litigation. Experience managing asbestos or talc litigation preferred.

 - Excellent organization, detail orientation, problem-solving, and time management skills, with ability to work independently and as part of a fast-paced, high-performing team.

 - Demonstrated ability to independently manage significant litigation responsibilities and exercise sound strategic judgment.

 - Strong aptitude for emerging legal AI tools for document review, analysis, eDiscovery among other applications.

 - Experience handling complex scientific, medical, technical, or expert-driven issues.

 - Strong deposition, motion practice, discovery, and case-management experience.

 - Strong client-management and communication skills.

 - Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

 - Experience with federal and/or state court litigation; MDL experience is a plus.

 - Trial preparation and/or trial execution experience are preferred.

 - CA state court trial experience.

 

WORKING CONDITIONS

jobs.title: Sr. Marketing Analyst (Brazil & Argentina ONLY)
jobs.description:
About Niche

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.

About The Role

**We are currently recruiting for this role in Argentina and Brazil only.  We will not be considering US based candidates at this time.  All interviews are being held remotely. If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.**

**Only applications/resumes written in English will be accepted.**

We are looking for an experienced, analytically rigorous, and collaborative Senior Marketing Analyst to own how Niche measures and improves the performance of its marketing engine, on both sides of the marketplace. This is a senior individual contributor role on the Analytics team, embedded day to day with the marketing and growth teams and reporting to the Manager of Operational Analytics.

The Senior Marketing Analyst is the analytical owner of two connected domains:

• B2B marketing and pipeline analytics: how marketing-sourced demand becomes qualified leads, opportunities, and closed business.

• B2C growth and registration analytics: how students and parents find Niche across acquisition channels, register, and convert into engaged users.

This is a deeply embedded role. You will sit in marketing, B2B, SEO, and lifecycle meetings and workflows, develop first-hand awareness of how data is actually being used, where the gaps are, and what's needed before it becomes a problem. You will be a strategic partner to marketing leadership rather than a reporting function: proactively surfacing insights, pairing them with recommendations and clear next steps, and staying with the work through the decision it informs.

What You Will Do

B2B Marketing & Pipeine Analytics

• Build the measurement foundation for how Niche markets to schools and districts: define which metrics matter, how they are calculated, and where the reporting lives, so the business can see what is actually working

• Bring rigor to questions such as which channels and campaigns produce pipeline that closes, what a marketing-sourced lead is actually worth, and where demand generation investment should go next

• Develop leading-indicator reporting that gives marketing and sales leadership early signal on pipeline health rather than a retrospective read

• Own the B2B attribution model in Marketo Measure, including touchpoint and channel definitions and the data flow between Marketo, Salesforce, and Snowflake. Partner with Marketing and Sales to keep campaign tracking and lead and opportunity attribution reliable over time

• Support new business forecasting and pipeline reviews with clear, documented methodology and honest confidence levels

B2C Growth & Registration Analytics

• Own registration and acquisition measurement end to end: registration funnel performance, campaign and channel attribution, and the connection between how a user arrived and what they went on to do on the platform

• Measure paid acquisition efficiency: cost per registration, cost per qualified lead, and how spend translates into users who actually convert. Partner with Growth Marketing on media mix and budget decisions, and build the forecasts behind them

• Serve as the analytical partner to Growth Marketing and Lifecycle: size opportunities, design and read out growth tests, troubleshoot tracking, and maintain the reporting the team runs on day to day

• Build and maintain the marketing dashboards and self-serve views that let growth, lifecycle, and leadership answer their own recurring questions

• Own organic search analytics: measure performance by page type, path, and traffic source (profiles, rankings, entity search), and quantify the impact of product decisions and algorithm updates

• Build the monitoring and daily reporting that surfaces organic traffic shifts before they become surprises, and keep traffic definitions consistent across dashboards and the semantic layer

• Partner with Product and Data Engineering to define the event tracking and data models this measurement depends on

Analytical Rigor & Influence

• Model analytical rigor on marketing data: reproducible SQL, documented methodology, validated results, and a clear line between correlation and causation

• Review and pressure-test analyses from across the analytics team and from business partners, and sharpen how findings are framed and communicated

• Act as the subject matter expert on acquisition-funnel data sources and methodology: when analyses from Business or Product Analytics start at the top of the funnel, make sure they start from the right source, the right definition, and a method that will hold

• Mentor analysts informally and share techniques across the analytics team

• Partner with Data Engineering as the voice of the business: write clear measurement requirements, contribute directly to dbt models and the company-wide self-serve semantic layer, and QA what gets shipped

• Champion AI-assisted analytics in your own work and help colleagues adopt it by building and maintaining the skills, workflows, and context that make these tools reliable on Niche's data

• Present findings and recommendations to senior leadership with clear insight and a clear "so what"

What We Are Looking For

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Marketing, or a related field. A Master's degree is a plus

• 5+ years of experience in marketing analytics, growth analytics, data analytics, or a closely related data function.

• Demonstrated experience owning marketing measurement end to end, from tracking implementation through to reporting and recommendation.

• Hands-on experience with consumer acquisition data: web analytics and paid media platforms (GA4, Meta, Google Ads, or equivalent), including campaign and channel attribution and its limitations.

• Direct experience with B2B marketing and pipeline analytics: lead and MQL lifecycle, multi-touch attribution, campaign and channel contribution to pipeline, and conversion through to closed business.

• Experience working with marketing automation, CRM, and attribution data (e.g., Marketo, Marketo Measure, Salesforce) and diagnosing problems in how they connect.

• Proven ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insight for non-technical stakeholders, and to say plainly when the data won't support the question.

• Experience in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with shifting priorities, and resilience in the face of ambiguity and change.

• Senior proficiency in SQL; comfortable writing, reviewing, and troubleshooting complex queries independently.

• Strong proficiency in data visualization and dashboarding platforms such as Streamlit, Tableau, Looker, or similar.

• Working knowledge of a modern data stack: Snowflake, dbt, and version-controlled analytics work.

• Comfortable with experimentation and quantitative methods: designing and reading out A/B and growth tests, sizing effects honestly, and knowing when a result is signal and when it isn't.

• A genuine practitioner of AI-assisted analytics: comfortable using tools like Claude Code in your own work, and rigorous about validating what comes back.

• Comfort operating as a senior IC: influencing without authority, working self-directed on complex and ambiguous problems, and mentoring peers.

Nice to Have

• Experience with Python or R.

• Direct experience with SEO analytics: indexation, page-level organic performance, and technical SEO measurement.

• Experience contributing to a semantic layer or self-serve metrics layer.

• Background in SaaS, education technology, or marketplace analytics environments.

• Experience in the education sector or working with schools and colleges.

Interview Process

Candidate experience is a top priority for our talent and hiring teams.  We believe in providing a transparent, authentic and comprehensive interview process where you have the opportunity to learn about us while we get to know you and your experience.  The interview process is outlined here:

• Video Interview with Talent Acquisition Partner - 30 Minutes

• Video Interview with Hiring Manager - 45 Minutes

• Team Interview - 3 separate 30 Minute Interviews

• Case Study & Presentation

• Hiring Manager follow-up - 30 Minutes

**We are currently recruiting for this role in Argentina and Brazil only.  We will not be considering US based candidates at this time.  All interviews are being held remotely. If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.**

**Only applications/resumes written in English will be accepted.**

We’re Cleerly – a healthcare company that’s revolutionizing how heart disease is diagnosed, treated, and tracked. We were founded in 2017 by one of the world’s leading cardiologists and are a growing team of world-class engineering, operations, medical affairs, marketing, and sales leaders. We raised $223M in Series C funding in 2022 which has enabled rapid growth and continued support of our mission. In December 2024 we received an additional $106M in a Series C extension funding. Cleerly has created a new standard of care for heart disease through value-based, AI-driven precision diagnostic solutions with the goal of helping prevent heart attacks. Our technology goes beyond traditional measures of heart disease by enabling comprehensive quantification and characterization of atherosclerosis, or plaque buildup, in each of the heart arteries. Cleerly’s solutions are supported by more than a decade of performing some of the world’s largest clinical trials to identify important findings beyond symptoms that increase a person’s risk of heart attacks.

jobs.description:
FULL-TIME JOB VACANCY
WASHINGTON, DC, DIRECTOR
Advocacy Department
Washington, DC, Office
Application Deadline: November 1, 2026

HRW is seeking is seeking a highly strategic and effective leader with compelling communication and interpersonal skills for the position of Washington, DC, Director to formulate and execute, with a keen sense of prioritization, advocacy strategies on the full range of US foreign policy and national security issues and countries addressed by the organization. As a key advocacy strategist for HRW and principal HRW representative in the US on foreign policy and national security, the successful candidate will need to stay closely attuned to the US political landscape and translate that into clear, actionable opportunities to turn HRW research into tangible human rights impact in relation to US foreign policy and national security practice. The role also calls for close coordination with the US Program on domestic issues that are overlapping or converging.

The Washington, DC, Director will have a strong track record of effectively engaging and cultivating relationships with key stakeholders including high-level policy makers within the Executive branch, members of Congress, and working closely and collegially with other civil society organizations. They will be confident in engaging on mediums that reach the wider public and have a sophisticated grasp of the media landscape in addition to being a compelling public speaker. They will also assist with fundraising efforts as needed.

This position is based in Washington, DC. The successful candidate must be willing to work from the office as needed and reports to the Chief Advocacy Officer (“CAO”). It supervises a Washington, DC-based Advocacy Coordinator.

Responsibilities:

1. Lead HRW’s advocacy in the US on the foreign policy and national security front and work with HRW colleagues to formulate and execute advocacy and media strategies on a range of foreign policy and national security issues and countries, and with the US Program on converging or overlapping domestic issues as needed;
2. Promote and coordinate the work of HRW in the US to influence decisionmakers, mainly key high-level government officials in the White House, Department of State, Department of War, Department of the Treasury, and other departments and agencies as necessary, building access to and staying in regular contact with key policymakers and departments, working with members of Congress and providing evidence to congressional committees, speaking at public events and seminars, influencing think tanks and other policy/advisory bodies, representing the organization in the human rights movement on a national and international stage and otherwise leveraging the US to be a more consistent actor for human rights worldwide;
3. With the US Senior Media Officer, strategize on promoting HRW’s work effectively to traditional and social media in the US, building relevant relationships and contacts with journalists and media outlets to ensure HRW is as influential as possible, writing and speaking on human rights issues, telling compelling stories, crafting succinct soundbites and messages, and deploying diverse and innovative storytelling skills to promote human rights values to the broader public, maintaining leading role in advancing growth and engagement of the US audience. Help HRW colleagues understand how and when to seize press and advocacy opportunities in the US, both on global and domestic issues;
4. Coordinate closely with HRW advocates around the globe, at the UN (based in New York and Geneva), at the EU (based in Brussels), and elsewhere as well as advocates in regional and thematic teams in HRW. Collaborate with the various parts of HRW, including the Advocacy and Media teams around the globe, to identify and create opportunities that support research and advocacy efforts involving the US;
5. Provide US political analysis, perspective, and guidance to the organization on appropriate policy responses; coordinate talking points and provide analysis for various global events and meetings related to US policy and core human rights concerns and respond to and/or anticipate relevant news events and policy debates by inserting HRW’s voice and research.
6. Work in partnership with the US Development colleagues to build relationships with donors and financial prospects by representing HRW – sharing research, advocacy and impact – in an authentic and inspiring way;
7. Work with non-governmental organizations, civil society partners, and other key actors on collaborative advocacy efforts, strengthening strategic partnerships as appropriate;
8. Contribute to internal HRW policies and strategic debates. Provide regular information, political analysis, perspective, and guidance on the UK’s human rights policies to the organization, and the foreign and security implications derived from them, in particular to regional and thematic divisions and HRW’s other advocates;
9. Provide leadership, motivation, and mentorship to direct reports, setting, clear expectations, performance objectives, and providing regular and constructive feedback; and
10. Perform other responsibilities, as required.

Qualifications:

Education: A graduate degree in international relations, journalism, law, social sciences or equivalent work experience is required.

Experience: A minimum of ten years of policy advocacy work experience, including at least four years of management experience, is required. Work experience in an international environment, with culturally diverse teams and across multiple time zones, is a strong advantage.

Related Skills and Knowledge:
1. Substantial knowledge of US government departments and agencies, and direct experience performing policy advocacy with one or more of these bodies is strongly desired.
2. Significant human rights experience and expertise, and a demonstrated commitment to human rights.
3. Excellent political and strategic judgment and analytical and strategic-thinking capabilities.
4. Effective, concise public speaker and possess excellent speaking, writing, and editing skills in English.
5. The ability to work quickly and effectively under pressure; the capacity to pay close attention to detail while working in a fast-paced environment and juggling multiple tasks.
6. Strong coordination skills and the ability to work effectively independently, as part of a team, and in partnership with other organizations.

Salary and Benefits: HRW seeks exceptional applicants and offers competitive compensation and generous employer-paid benefits. The salary range for this role is US$ 133,000 – 157,000.

How to Apply: Please apply immediately or by November 1, 2026 by visiting our online job portal at https://careers.hrw.org and attaching a letter of interest and a CV or resume. No calls or email inquiries, please. Only complete applications will be reviewed and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

If you are experiencing technical difficulties with your application submission or if you require accommodations during the application process, please email recruitment@hrw.org. Due to the large response, application submissions via email will not be accepted and inquiries regarding the status of applications will go unanswered.

Human Rights Watch is strong because it is diverse. We actively seek a diverse applicant pool and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Human Rights Watch does not discriminate on the basis of disability, age, gender identity and expression, national origin, race and ethnicity, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, or criminal record. We welcome all kinds of diversity. Our employees include people who are parents and nonparents, the self-taught and university educated, and from a wide span of socioeconomic backgrounds and perspectives on the world. Human Rights Watch is an equal opportunity employer.

Human Rights Watch is an international human rights monitoring and advocacy organization known for its in-depth investigations, its incisive and timely reporting, its innovative and high profile advocacy campaigns, and its success in changing the human rights-related policies and practices of influential governments and international institutions.

jobs.title: 2027 Quantitative Developer Intern
jobs.description:
The Role

We are seeking exceptional interns to join our Quantitative Research team in the Austin metro area.  As an intern, you will work with other researchers and developers on various research projects, including the design of novel predictive signals and the enhancement of our algorithms for prediction, trade execution, portfolio construction, and risk management. You will have an opportunity to meaningfully contribute to multiple areas of our quantitative trading business.

What You’ll Do

As a Quantitative Developer Intern, you will help develop and improve the software used in our quantitative research. You will gain insight into building scalable software, using parallel computing to train machine learning models and process large datasets.  You will have the opportunity to use AI tools to improve your productivity in coding and analysis. Over the 10-week internship program, you will collaborate with senior team members to learn what it takes to be a successful Quantitative Developer. Additionally, you’ll network and socialize with colleagues throughout the internship.

What You Need

• Currently pursuing a bachelor’s, master’s, or doctoral degree in a quantitative or technical field such as statistics, mathematics, physics, electrical engineering, or computer science (ideally with one academic year remaining after the internship)

• Excellent programming skills in one or more languages such as Python, C, C++, Java, SQL, or R

• Familiarity with machine learning algorithms and software frameworks

• The ability to communicate research ideas clearly and succinctly

• Creative problem-solving skills; experience working with production software is a plus

• Strong attention to detail

• Previous financial industry experience is a plus but it is not required

Our Internship

Kick-start your career in finance with the Schonfeld Summer Internship! Over the course of 10 action-packed weeks, you will have the opportunity to build solutions that tackle real-world challenges and leave a lasting impact on the firm. As an intern, you’ll join a close-knit team that is ready to support your growth and accelerate your career. We will pair you with a dedicated manager and a mentor who’ll guide your development over the course of the internship and beyond. Throughout the program, you will have the chance to connect with senior leaders through a series of learning sessions, attend hands-on skills workshops, network at social events and get a behind-the-scenes look at how various functions power the firm. We’ll empower you to bring your ideas to life and make an impact.

Who We Are

Schonfeld is a global multi-manager hedge fund that strives to deliver industry-leading risk-adjusted returns for our investors. We leverage both internal and external portfolio manager teams around the world, seeking to capitalize on inefficiencies and opportunities within the markets. We draw from decades of experience and a significant investment in proprietary technology, infrastructure and risk analytics to invest across four main strategies: Quant, Tactical, Fundamental Equity and Discretionary Macro & Fixed Income.

Our Culture

At Schonfeld, we’ll invest in you. Attracting and retaining top talent is at the heart of what we do, because we believe that exceptional outcomes begin with exceptional people. We foster a culture where talent is empowered to continually learn, innovate and pursue ambitious goals. We are teamwork-oriented, collaborative and encourage ideas—at all levels—to be shared. As an organization committed to investing in our people, we provide learning and educational offerings and opportunities to make an impact. We encourage community through internal networks, external partnerships and service initiatives that promote inclusion and purpose beyond the firm’s walls.

The annual base pay for this role is expected to be between $175,000 and $220,000. Internship pay will be prorated based on the internship start and end dates. The expected base pay range is based on information at the time this post was generated. Actual compensation for the successful candidate will be determined based on a variety of factors such as skills, qualifications and experience and level of education.

jobs.title: Sustainability Team Member
jobs.description:
About CookUnity:

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

Summary

Execute daily operational tasks related to recycling, compost, waste audits, and donation management within the Austin facility, ensuring compliance with processes and sustainability standards.

Responsibilities:

• Daily Waste Audits: Perform daily bin audits across all kitchens and document findings on the Daily Audit Bin Form.

• Correct Waste Disposal : Ensure proper waste disposal procedures are followed in all kitchens.

• Overproduction Processing: Classify, weigh, and process overproduced food — routing it to charity donation's, compost, or internal reuse (family meal).

• Food Waste Handling : Classify, weigh, and dispose of food waste, including donations, compost, garbage, and family meals.

• Facility Walkthroughs : Conduct daily walkthroughs of kitchens, green stations, fulfillment, and market areas to identify contamination in recycling and compost streams.

• Contamination Control — Check recycling and compost streams to ensure they are free of incorrect materials.

• Material Sorting — Separate and move recyclable and compostable materials according to facility standards.

• Donation Management: Collect, weigh, record, and pack donations; receive donation partners and hand off prepared products.

• Donation Coordination: Coordinate donation pick‑ups with partnered non‑profit organizations.

• Walk-In Raw Ingredient Collection: Support the weekly walk-in collection process — pulling, logging, sorting, and routing recoverable raw ingredients across all 20 refrigerators.

• Too Good To Go Sales: Coordinate the sale of surplus meals through the Too Good To Go platform — including setup, customer handoff, and close-out logging.

• Return Packaging Program: Coordinate logistics and shipping with local carriers to send returned packaging materials off-site for cleaning and sanitization.

• Daily Reporting: Complete daily trackers for recycling, compost, and donation volumes.

• Zero Waste Compliance: Follow all safety, cleanliness, and Zero Waste process standards.

• Operational Feedback: Provide daily feedback to staff to reinforce correct waste‑sorting behaviors.

• Green Leader Support: Support team members as a Green Leader, promoting “Go Green” practices.

• Waste Diversion Supplies: Ensure stations have the correct supplies (stickers, posters, bins) for proper waste diversion.

• Green Station Maintenance: Coordinate with the cleaning team to keep the Green Stations clean and in order.

General Schedule and Workdays

Full Time (5 days a week – 36 to 40 hrs weekly).

Available to work weekends.

Qualifications

• Operational Experience: Previous experience in warehouse, food production, cleaning, or other hands‑on operational roles. Comfortable working in kitchens, warehouse areas, and food production spaces.

• Physical Requirements: Ability to safely lift and move 20 lbs or more throughout the shift..

• Basic Reporting Skills : Ability to complete daily trackers and simple audit forms.

• Communication Skills: Ability to give clear feedback to staff and communicate deviations or contamination findings. Spanish and English

• Interest in Waste Reduction: Genuine interest in recycling, composting, waste diversion, or environmental practices (no prior experience required).

• Language: Basic English required; Spanish is a strong plus.

JOB REQUIREMENT

• Bilingual – Spanish and English (mainly spoken).

• Basic knowledge of Google Docs/sheets.

• Experience operating both: Forklift; Pallet Jack Forklift experience a plus (certification support available on the job).

Compensation

All final pay rates will be determined by candidates experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data.

Pay Range for this position

$19—$19 USD

If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time!

CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

A quick note for all candidates
We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us:

• Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: careers.cookunity.com

• Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page.

• We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.

• We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away.

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

jobs.title: Membership Director - Miami
jobs.location: Soho Beach House Miami, 4385 Collins Ave, Miami Beach, FL 33140
jobs.description:
Job Purpose:

The Membership Director, Miami is responsible for overseeing the development, acquisition and retention of Soho House members. This role drives membership growth, leads and manages the local Membership team, ensures a high standard of member experience, and significantly contributes to the overall success of the business.

The Director will work closely with House, regional and global teams to meet quarterly and annual membership targets, build and nurture a vibrant member community, and ensure the membership experience reflects Soho House’s unique creative spirit.

They will have a strong understanding of the market and its creative and cultural landscape, an extensive local network, and the ability to build meaningful relationships across the city. They will combine strong commercial and strategic thinking with a highly visible, hands-on approach to members and the market.

Main Responsibilities

Membership Recruitment & Retention

• Deliver the full membership budget each year, in line with weekly revenue targets and quarterly and annual targets for both new application approvals and member retention.

• Develop and deliver a comprehensive membership strategy with clear plans across acquisition and retention, monitoring performance and adjusting throughout the year as needed.

• Develop strategies for key renewal groups. Manage and execute retention plan, both offsite and onsite to mitigate churn.

• Make strategic decisions and adjustments to ensure membership targets are achieved or exceeded, identifying opportunities to accelerate growth or address areas of underperformance.

• Drive membership growth by leveraging an extensive personal network within the creative industries while continuously developing new communities and pipelines for prospective members.

• Ensure member outreach, approvals and the overall membership demographic reflect the House Identity Plan, with particular focus on demographics and creative communities that are reflective of the local market.

• Maintain a detailed understanding of the membership base, including applications, approvals, conversion, renewals, leavers, engagement and retention.

• Collect, analyze and act on retention metrics, member feedback and survey data to continuously improve member satisfaction and identify opportunities for growth.

• Work closely with the Member Success team to develop and deliver retention actions, with particular focus on members at highest risk of leaving.

• Maintain a strong understanding of the competitive landscape and ensure Soho House continues to attract and retain a relevant, high-quality creative membership.

Team Leadership & Management

• In close partnership with the Area General Manager, lead the Membership team, ensuring clear roles, responsibilities and accountability across the function.

• Recruit, lead and inspire a high-performing Membership team that represents the profile and diversity of the membership community.

• Set clear performance goals and provide regular feedback, mentorship and direction to ensure the team delivers membership targets, high-quality members and an exceptional member experience.

• Establish clear working rhythms across outreach, applications, Committee, introductions, member engagement, retention and renewals.

• Ensure the team maintains a strong presence within the House and develops meaningful relationships with members and prospective members.

• Foster a collaborative, inclusive and results-driven team culture.

• Identify development opportunities within the team and support succession and career progression.

Committee Development & Oversight

• Build, grow and manage the Membership Committee, ensuring it is balanced across age, ethnicity, gender, industry, experience and community representation and reflects the House Identity Plan.

• Develop strong individual relationships with Committee members and ensure they understand their role in identifying, proposing and engaging prospective members.

• Motivate and engage Committee members to actively participate in the membership process and deliver against Committee proposal targets.

• Ensure the Committee remains connected to the evolving creative and cultural landscape and continuously introduces new communities and perspectives to the House.

• Use tracking metrics to regularly review the composition, engagement and effectiveness of the Committee, making changes where required to maintain strong performance.

• Lead Committee meetings and maintain a consistent cadence of engagement with Committee members outside of formal meetings.

Membership Quality Control

• Oversee the membership application and approval process to ensure all approved members meet Soho House’s standards of quality and creativity.

• Maintain a consistent and high calibre of membership, ensuring the community reflects the identity, values and creative spirit of Soho House.

• Maintain oversight of membership quality across new applications, renewals and the existing member base.

• Ensure the application pipeline is being actively managed and that prospective members are appropriately engaged ahead of approval.

• Regularly review the composition of the membership base and identify areas where additional outreach or greater representation is needed.

• Partner with regional Membership leadership on complex membership decisions or where additional review is required.

Member Introductions & Membership Journey

• Ensure all new members receive a high-quality introduction to the House, its community, values, rules and membership experience.

• Regularly host member introductions to set the standard for the Membership team and personally engage with new members.

• Ensure introduction attendance and follow-up are consistently monitored and managed by the team.

• Work cross-functionally to develop engagement strategies for members during their first year, with particular focus on improving Year 1 retention.

• Ensure a seamless member journey from application and approval through onboarding, engagement, renewal and ongoing membership.

• Identify opportunities to improve the member journey based on feedback, engagement and retention data.

Outreach & Member Engagement

• Develop and lead a proactive outreach strategy, building a strong and consistent pipeline of prospective members aligned with the House identity and membership targets.

• Actively engage across the creative and cultural landscape, building meaningful relationships with established and emerging talent, cultural leaders, community connectors and prospective members.

• Maintain an extensive and evolving network across art, music, fashion, film, design, media, technology, food, hospitality and other relevant creative industries.

• Identify new communities, industries and networks where Soho House should have greater representation and develop targeted outreach plans to engage them.

• Build and maintain relationships with key cultural figures, global talent and ambassadors who can contribute meaningfully to the House and wider membership community.

• Maintain a strong external presence, attending relevant cultural and industry moments and ensuring Soho House remains connected to the people and communities shaping the city.

• Develop strong relationships with existing members and maintain a visible presence in the House, gathering feedback and maintaining a first-hand understanding of member sentiment.

• Identify members at risk of leaving and personally engage where senior intervention can support retention.

• Work with the Membership team to develop targeted member engagement and retention initiatives throughout the membership lifecycle.

• Identify opportunities around key cultural moments to support member acquisition, engagement and retention, working with the relevant internal teams to bring these opportunities to life.

• Serve as a key ambassador for Soho House, strengthening relationships with the wider creative community and ensuring the membership continues to evolve alongside the city.

Member Conduct & Behaviour Management

• Lead efforts to address member behaviour and conduct issues, working closely with the Membership and House teams to handle sensitive conversations.

• Ensure all behavioural and conduct-related concerns are documented, followed up and resolved promptly and professionally.

• Provide clear direction to the Membership team on appropriate handling and escalation of member behaviour issues.

• Ensure member-related issues are managed consistently and in line with Soho House policies, working with the Membership Behaviour Committee, Legal, P&D and regional leadership where required.

• Personally lead sensitive or complex member conversations where senior intervention is appropriate.

• Maintain strong judgement and discretion while balancing the interests of individual members, the wider community and the business.

House Presence & Member Experience

• Spend significant time in the House throughout the week, including appropriate evenings and weekends, maintaining a visible and approachable presence with members.

• Build strong relationships with the membership community and maintain a first-hand understanding of member sentiment and the overall House experience.

• Be present during key House moments and major events, hosting and supporting the team with membership management and member engagement.

• Regularly gather feedback from members and identify recurring themes or opportunities to improve the membership experience.

• Work closely with the Area General Manager and Operations team to address issues affecting member satisfaction and retention.

• Support House teams by providing feedback and guidance to continuously enhance the member experience.

Cross-functional Collaboration

• Work closely with the General Manager, Operations, Member Events, Member Relations, Member Success, Partnerships, Marketing and regional Membership leadership to ensure the membership strategy is reflected across the wider House experience.

• Partner closely with the Member Events team, sharing member insight, feedback, demographic data and knowledge of the creative community to help inform programming that is relevant to members and supports acquisition and retention goals.

• Maintain clear alignment with Member Events around key cultural moments, priority communities and opportunities for prospective and existing member engagement, while respecting clear ownership of event strategy and execution.

• Work with Operations and the Area General Manager to ensure member feedback and recurring themes are understood and addressed, particularly where the House experience is impacting satisfaction or retention.

• Partner with Member Relations, Membership Strategy, and Member Success to identify churn risks and develop targeted strategies for members or groups requiring additional engagement.

• Work with Partnerships to identify relevant local relationships and opportunities that can add value to the membership proposition and strengthen Soho House’s position within the local market.

• Collaborate with Marketing and Communications teams on relevant member communications, outreach and key membership moments.

• Represent the membership perspective in cross-functional House planning and decision-making, ensuring member needs, feedback and business objectives are considered.

• Maintain close communication with regional Membership leadership, sharing performance, risks, opportunities and market insight and ensuring we remain aligned with wider North American membership priorities.

Performance, Reporting & Administration

• Maintain a detailed understanding of membership performance across applications, approvals, conversion, membership base, renewals, leavers, retention and revenue.

• Use membership data, Salesforce reporting, member feedback and market insight to identify trends, risks and opportunities and translate them into clear actions.

• Provide regular performance updates and recommendations to House and regional leadership.

• Maintain clear forecasting around membership growth, renewals and attrition and proactively flag areas of risk.

• Ensure the Membership team maintains accurate and comprehensive records across Salesforce and other membership systems.

• Ensure membership applications, renewals, member feedback, behaviour and outreach activity are documented accurately and consistently.

• Manage the local Membership budget and ensure investment is directed towards initiatives that support acquisition, engagement and retention.

• Ensure all Membership processes and administrative standards are delivered accurately and efficiently by the team.

Experience Required:

• Strong leadership skills with a proven track record of managing high-performing teams (inc remote and different markets) and large budgets with over 10 years experience.

• Extensive network and experience in creative industries.

• A minimum of 5 years experience managing teams in different markets within USA, including a strong knowledge of consumer behaviour, cultural insights, and ability to translate into revenue growth.

• Demonstrated expertise in driving and retaining membership and/or sales into a similar business.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and inspire others, with extensive experience building and leading presentations.

• Experience engaging and presenting to C level/senior leadership beneficial.

• Data-driven approach to membership management, with the ability to interpret and act on key metrics.

• Passion for creativity, community building, and hospitality.

Why work with us...

Soho House offers competitive compensation packages that feature global benefits and perks. Whether you’re seeking entry-level employment or a new opportunity to expand your profession, we offer training to develop the technical and managerial skills necessary to enhance your career.

• Career Development: Soho House can progress your career domestically or internationally as well as managerially or technically

• Soho Impact: Empowering the Soho House Community to make positive change, through mentoring, apprenticeship, local outreach and sustainability

• Learning & Development: An extensive range of internally and externally run courses are available for all employees.

• Cookhouse & House Tonic: Celebrating our passion for food and drink. Check out our monthly calendars and get involved in trips, training's and events. Available to all.

• Team Events: From fitness sessions to cinema screenings and art classes, each month we hold a series of fun events which you can sign up to.

• Team Meal: Whilst on duty in our Houses & Restaurants you will be provided with a substantial meal free of charge.
